title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
About Kustomer

Kustomer is the AI-native customer experience platform that turns every interaction into a lasting relationship and a measurable business outcome. By unifying customer data, conversations and AI-native workflows into a single connected timeline, Kustomer helps teams cultivate customers, not tickets, resolving issues faster and delivering more personalized service across every channel. Today, Kustomer is the core platform for leading customer service brands like Sweetgreen, Starz, Vuori, Goldbelly and Cotopaxi.

Founded in 2015 by serial entrepreneurs Brad Birnbaum and Jeremy Suriel, Kustomer raised nearly $200M in funding culminating in a Series E before being acquired by Meta in a deal that closed in 2022. In 2023, Kustomer's founders and original investors, Battery, Redpoint, and Boldstart Ventures, spun the company back out with a $60M investment as an independent, privately held business ready to focus more deeply on AI. In 2025, Norwest led our Series B, bringing our total funding to $90M. This momentum allowed Kustomer to double down on AI-native innovation and build a sharper roadmap for the future of customer experience. Our Krew is a remote-friendly team spread across the U.S. with hubs in NYC and London. We gather in person each year at our annual Kustomer Kick-Off event and always look for Krew members who are curious, collaborative, and ready to shape the future of Customer Experience.

About the Role
Kustomer’s AI agent resolves routine questions, and our support partners handle the next layer of straightforward requests. This role handles what’s left: complex, ambiguous technical issues across webhooks, APIs, workflows, integrations, and AI agent behavior. You’ll be the final escalation point before Engineering. You’ll also make Tier 1 and 2 stronger by turning each hard case into a runbook, a fix, or a product improvement.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Owning technical issues end to end, from reproduction through root cause and resolution, within defined SLAs

  • Diagnosing failures in webhooks, REST API integrations, workflows, and automations using logs, payloads, and developer tools

  • Troubleshooting AI agent behavior, such as misrouted or incorrect resolutions, knowledge gaps, and failed actions or integrations, and recommending configuration or knowledge fixes

  • Escalating to Engineering with clear reproduction steps, evidence, and impact, and following through to resolution

  • Identifying recurring issue patterns and partnering with Product and Engineering on fixes, tooling, and self-service improvements

  • Writing runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and escalation playbooks for our AI agent and BPO partners

  • Coaching and enabling Tier 1/2 and BP

title: Partner Success Manager (EMEA)
description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

title: Golang Engineering Manager, Commercial Systems
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Golang Engineering Manager, who strives for accountability for the development of an internal product, who has high engineering quality standards, continuously develops their skills as well as skills of their direct reports, and who has the drive to deliver. This is an exciting opportunity to work with great people and exciting open-source solutions on innovative engineering solutions supporting Canonical's growth.

The Commercial Systems unit is conceived as six engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business and Golang plays an integral role in it. We are looking for software engineering managers for these teams:

The Billing team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that provides a standardized and scalable capability to turn metrics into billable amounts, enable customers to see their current spend with Canonical at any time, and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely billing. The service further integrates with other engineering, business, payment systems. This team is an excellent match for those interested in growing their skills in the billing and payment processing domain.

The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches. This team is a great opportunity for those interested in security and with a strong focus on engineering quality and reliability.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Accountability for the design and development of an internal product
  • Leading a team of software engineers

description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including

title: Founding Legal Engineer
description:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.


About the role

You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice.

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. description:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager you will take ownership of the industrialization perspective throughout the product development process. Working closely with R&D, engineering and external manufacturing partners, you will ensure that manufacturing considerations are integrated into product design from the earliest development stages.

You will challenge existing design decisions where necessary, identify more suitable manufacturing technologies and processes, and drive the transition from engineering concepts and prototypes to manufacturable, scalable products.

This is a key role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of engineering, product development and manufacturing – and who is equally comfortable discussing technical trade-offs with R&D engineers, negotiating with suppliers and engaging directly with people on the production floor.

Agents write more code every month. Human brains stay the same. CodeSpeak is building a program model that sits one level above code, so people can see how a program works and changes over time without reading much of it. Around him is a team that has built the tools other engineers rely on, at Google, Databricks, Perplexity, JetBrains, Sourcegraph, and Elastic. When it comes to program analysis and developer tooling, these are some of the best people in the world. CodeSpeak is backed by Accel and by funds that also invested in Hugging Face and Mistral, and funding covers several years.

As Founding Design Engineer you will decide how it looks, then build it and ship it. The core engineering team has just been hired, and nobody on it has design-engineering skills. An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options

For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team.

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK.

You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care.

 

What you will be doing:

  • Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

Job Summary   The Key Leader role is an essential part of the store leadership team, impacting salesfloor team members and guest (i.e., customer) experience every day. Key Leaders are responsible for leading by example and providing support to Educators, facilitating an outstanding guest experience in the store, and overseeing all operations of the retail floor. Key Leaders leverage key performance indicators and metrics to prioritize responsibilities while adapting to day-to-day business adjustments and challenges.   Key Responsibilities Of The Job    Leadership and People Management     Support ongoing learning and development of team members by providing direct feedback, coaching, mentoring, and career path guidance, and addressing performance concerns.  Provide team members recognition, gap assessment, and overall performance documentation to support and reinforce career and personal growth.  Develop, maintain, and disseminate product and general company knowledge through appropriate communication channels.     Guest (i.e., Customer) Experience     Provide salesfloor leadership to team members, including planning salesfloor coverage and making decisions to maintain efficiency and effectiveness of salesfloor operations.   Support team members (e.g., leading by example or coaching) with ensuring a great guest experience that values guests’ time, including assessing guest needs, providing technical product educations, and supporting in-store transactions and omnichannel programs (e.g., buy online/pickup in store, phone sales, and ship from store options).  Interact with and assess guests’ unique needs to provide customized, effective purchase and return solutions and support.   Provide technical product education by articulating the value and benefit of the product.   Resolve guest feedback and address guest concerns or escalations to make it “right” for guests.  Move dynamically on the floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team, and guests.      Working With Others     Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and celebrating differences to ensure a supportive and engaging experience for all team members and guests.  Establish supportive and productive relationships with all team members.

title: Senterleder SATS Colosseum
description: Vi søker senterleder til SATS Colosseum! 🙌  Brenner du for å inspirere mennesker til et sunnere og gladere liv? Vil du lede et team som virkelig betyr noe hver eneste dag?  Hos SATS jobber vi for å skape positiv forandring ved å motivere medlemmene våre og gi dem en treningsopplevelse som skiller seg ut. Som senterleder går du foran med engasjement og tydelig retning, og har ansvaret for at senteret ditt leverer gode resultater både i drift og økonomi. Du har spesielt fokus på skikkelig god service, målrettet salgsinnsats og et høyt nivå på renhold, slik at medlemmene våre får de beste rammene og opplevelsene.  SATS Colosseum er Nordens største treningssenter med beliggenhet på Majorstuen i Oslo. Her tilbys medlemmene et bredt treningstilbud både for egentrening og trening med personlig trener, samt en av Oslos største og mest varierte gruppetreningsplaner.  🌟 Dine ansvarsområder   Gå foran som leder!   Du får det overordnede ansvaret for den daglige driften i ditt senter og sørger for en livlig, imøtekommende og energifylt atmosfære for både medlemmer og ansatte.   Skap resultater!   Du tar eierskap for senteret ditt, inkludert resultater og utvikling, og har det fulle økonomiske ansvaret. Du jobber strategisk for å nå salgs- og inntektsmål, samtidig som du styrer kostnadene effektivt.   Bygg et fremragende team!   Du rekrutterer, onboarder, inspirerer og utvikler et dedikert team som konsekvent leverer service i verdensklasse og skaper ekstraordinære opplevelser for medlemmene våre.   Skap en kultur preget av kvalitet!   Gjennom synlig og involverende ledelse sørger du for at alle detaljer, fra kundeservice til renhold, sikkerhet og vedlikehold av utstyr, holder høyeste standard.   Sett trivsel i fokus!   Som leder har du ansvar for arbeidsmiljøet i senteret ditt, og du sikrer en trygg, positiv og motiverende atmosfære for både ansatte og medlemmer.   Sørg for et skinnende rent senter!   Sammen med teamet ditt bruker du tid daglig på å gjøre rent, slik at senteret alltid møter SATS’ høye standarder. Uansett når medlemmene trener, skal de bli møtt av et ryddig og innbydende senter.  🤩 Hvem er du?  Du er utadvendt, vennlig og karismatisk, og har en naturlig evne til å bygge sterke relasjoner, både med medlemmer og kollegaer. Du tar initiativ, er handlekraftig og trives med å ta ansvar, samtidig som du har et skarpt blikk for struktur og systematikk i hverdagen. Du engasjerer og motiverer andre med energien og arbeidsgleden din, og du leder ved å være et inspirerende forbilde.    Du har solid erfaring med salg og ledelse og motiveres av å skape gode resultater.  Det er et krav at du snakker og skriver flytende norsk og engelsk.  Du kan identifisere deg med våre verdier: Members First, Accountable, Professional & Extraordinary.  Du trives med fleksible arbeidstider, da vaktene varierer, inkludert tidlige morgener, sene kvelder, helger og helligdager. Dette sikrer at det alltid er en leder til stede i de travleste periodene, samtidig

description: ترجم الكلام هذا الى الانقليزية:  المسمى الوظيفي: مدير خدمة العملاء   الهدف الوظيفي:  إدارة وتطوير عمليات خدمة العملاء في شركة تايقو، وضمان تقديم تجربة متميزة للعملاء عبر مختلف قنوات التواصل، من خلال الإشراف على فريق خدمة العملاء، وتحسين جودة الخدمات، ومعالجة الشكاوى، بما يحقق رضا العملاء ويعزز ولاءهم للشركة.  المهام والمسؤوليات:  1. الإشراف على فريق خدمة العملاء ومتابعة أدائهم وتحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية.  2. إدارة استفسارات العملاء وشكاواهم المتعلقة بالشرائح والباقات وعمليات الشراء والتفعيل.  3. التنسيق مع شركات الاتصالات ومزودي الخدمة لمعالجة المشكلات وضمان سرعة حلها.  4. تطوير إجراءات وسياسات خدمة العملاء وتحسين تجربة العميل داخل التطبيق.  5. مراقبة مؤشرات الأداء، مثل رضا العملاء وسرعة الاستجابة ومعدل حل الشكاوى.  6. إعداد التقارير الدورية وتحليل ملاحظات العملاء وتقديم توصيات لتحسين الخدمات.  7. تدريب فريق خدمة العملاء وتطوير مهاراتهم لضمان جودة الخدمة والالتزام بالمعايير المعتمدة.  8. الإشراف على بناء أنظمة خدمة عملاء  المؤهلات والخبرات:  - درجة البكالوريوس في إدارة الأعمال أو تخصص ذي صلة.  - خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في خدمة العملاء، منها سنتان في منصب إشرافي أو إداري.  - يُفضل وجود خبرة في قطاع الاتصالات أو التطبيقات الرقمية أو التجارة الإلكترونية.  - مهارات قيادية وتحليلية واتصال فعّال، مع القدرة على إدارة الشكاوى وحل المشكلات.  - إجادة استخدام أنظمة إدارة علاقات العملاء وإعداد تقارير الأداء. description: ÚNETE A LEROY MERLIN COMO LÍDER DE RELACIÓN CLIENTE TIENDA Y TRANSFORMA LA EXPERIENCIA DE CLIENTE Y EQUIPO      En Leroy Merlin, buscamos a un líder apasionado y dinámico para el puesto de Líder de Relación Cliente Tienda. title: Account Manager

title: Key Account Manager (Online & Wholesale)
description: Hos Noella er vi drevet af ambitioner, stærke relationer og en passion for mode, salg og vækst. Vi udvikler os konstant, og oplever fortsat stor fremgang på tværs af vores markeder. Derfor søger vi nu en energisk og målrettet Key Account Manager (Online & Wholesale), som får en central rolle i vores salgsorganisation.     Du bliver en vigtig del af teamet med ansvar for vores største og vigtigste kunder - særligt vores online key accounts. Dette er en rolle med stort ansvar og stor indflydelse, og du bliver bindeleddet mellem vores interne teams og vores key accounts - helt fra at et produkt er klar fra designafdelingen, til det er solgt ind til kunderne, og med efterfølgende fokus på gennemsalget. En stor del af dit arbejde vil foregå fra back office / digitalt. Vækstmuligheder, salgsinitiativer og omsætningsøgning er centralt.       Dine primære arbejdsopgaver • Overordnet ansvar for udviklingen af eksisterende key accounts – primært online, men også fysiske kunder. Dette indebærer også nye key accounts og new business.  • Daglig kontakt og opfølgning med wholesale kunder og samarbejdspartnere.  • Ansvar for merchandising af online key accounts - herunder visuel præsentation, arbejde med data og optimering.  • Koordinering og kvalitetssikring af B2B nyhedsbreve, kampagner og øvrige salgsmaterialer.  • Tæt samarbejde med salgsorganisationen, agenter, back office og marketing samt deltagelse på messer.  • Analyse af salgs- og produktperformance med fokus på at identificere vækstmuligheder og optimere salget.  • Løbende opfølgning på efterspørgsel, resultater og budgetter.  • Forberedelse af kundemøder, salgspræsentationer og sæsonoplæg.  • Udvikling af eksisterende kunder gennem kommercielle initiativer, stærke relationer og omsætningsøgende aktiviteter.  • Aktivt salg af lagervarer med fokus på at optimere lageromsætningshastigheden.       Din profil Vi forestiller os, at du:  • Har erfaring fra en lignende salgsorienteret stilling, gerne fra mode- eller livsstilsbranchen.  • Er struktureret, detaljeorienteret og har en stærk kommerciel forståelse.  • Trives med ansvar og tager naturligt ejerskab for dine accounts.  • Har et godt analytisk blik og forstår, hvad der driver salg og gennemsalg.  • Arbejder selvstændigt, men motiveres af at skabe resultater sammen med et ambitiøst team.  • Har interesse for mode og forstår dynamikken i wholesale og online salg.  • Er en stærk relationsskaber med gode samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.  • Behersker engelsk flydende - både skriftligt og mundtligt.       Det tilbyder vi • En spændende stilling med stort ansvar og mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel.  • En central rolle i et internationalt modebrand med høj vækst.  • En dynamisk hverdag med korte beslutningsveje og stor indflydelse.  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.  • En uformel kultur med højt engagement, et stærkt fællesskab og plads til idéer.       Om Noella Noella er et internationalt fashion brand med både B2C- og B2B

title: CRM & Lifecycle Manager
description: We are looking for a CRM & Lifecycle Manager to join Hårklinikken as we continue to develop and grow our global ecommerce business.     We operate six Shopify sites across the US, UK, EU, Denmark, Iceland and the UAE, with the US representing our largest growth market and subscriptions playing a central role in our model.     You will own the CRM and lifecycle journey across our markets, building the communication, flows and experiences that help turn first-time clients into long-term relationships. From onboarding and treatment support to subscriptions, repeat purchase, loyalty and win-back, you will help clients stay engaged, consistent and cared for throughout their journey with us.     Working hands-on in Klaviyo and Recharge, you will use data and customer insights to understand where clients engage, where they drop off and what helps them stay. You will continuously test and improve the lifecycle journey, with a particular focus on the first 90 days and subscription retention.     Success in this role means improving 90-day retention, increasing the number of subscribers who stay for at least three deliveries, strengthening repeat purchase rates and growing CRM revenue across markets.     You will track cohorts and LTV by market and share what you learn, helping those insights shape our wider acquisition and ecommerce activities. You will also collaborate closely with Brand, our clinics and our Client Care Teams, particularly around campaigns, the client journey, loyalty and client feedback.     You will work closely with our Content Marketing Manager, providing clear briefs for CRM campaigns and customer communications.      Key Responsibilities     Klaviyo . Build and run flows, segments, campaigns and SMS across six markets, working with our Content Marketing Manager who develops copy from your briefs.   The first 90 days . Own the onboarding journey for new clients, helping them start their treatment right and stay with it.   Subscriptions in Recharge . Manage sign-ups, retention, churn and win-back, testing what helps subscribers stay longer.   Consultation to treatment . Develop booking reminders and post-consultation flows that help turn consultations into lasting treatments, both in our clinics and at home.   Loyalty, reviews and client feedback . Work closely with our Client Care Team to understand where clients get stuck and what brings them back.   The campaign calendar . Coordinate the campaign calendar so CRM, the site and paid media go live at the same time with the same message.       Core Competencies   This role requires strong CRM and lifecycle experience combined with a hands-on, structured and analytical approach. description: Job Description: BESS Service Manager    1. Basic Job Information    Job Title : BESS O&M Service Manager   Department : Europe Service Management Dept. Based on power station operating data, battery attenuation rules and system operating problems, collaborate with R&D, engineering and quality teams to promote product iteration, program upgrade, structural optimization and O&M process improvement, so as to continuously enhance the stability, safety and service life of energy storage power stations and optimize long-term project operation quality.   3.4 Customer Relationship & Satisfaction

description: Haemme asiakasratkaisuinsinööriä kaukolämmön palvelutuotanto- ja myyntitiimiin vastaamaan asiakaslähtöisestä ongelmanratkaisusta, asiakasyhteistyöstä ja palveluiden kehittämisestä.      Saat päävastuun palvelutuotantotiimimme lisäarvo- ja olosuhdevalvontapalveluista ja pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten niitä kehitetään, tuotteistetaan ja viedään asiakkaiden käyttöön. title: Senior Customer Program Manager
description: Req ID: 142306  Remote Position: No  Region: Asia  Country: Malaysia  State/Province: Johor  City: Johor Bahru   Summary   The  Senior Customer Program Manager  serves as the primary liaison and commercial owner for designated customer accounts. About Zuuvi   Zuuvi is the creative infrastructure layer for enterprise brands — the operating system that  connects brand strategy to creative execution, without the designer bottleneck. description: Department:  Customer Support   Employment Type:  Permanent   Location:  Madrid   Reporting To:  Christian Wolf   Description    Department:  Customer Support   Employment type:  Full-time   Location:  Madrid   Workplace:  Hybrid (with up to 2 days home office per week)   About Osapiens   osapiens helps global companies build transparent, compliant, and sustainable supply chains.  Our platform powers 2 500 + enterprise clients — from leading DAX and S&P 500 companies, to key players in manufacturing, to most major retailers, and all the way down the supply chains to cacao farmers in some of the most remote regions of the world.  If our systems are down, imports into Europe could halt, production lines across industries would stop, and thousands of trucks could no longer deliver worldwide. Our holistic platform for supply-chain transparency, resilience, and automation helps businesses grow responsibly — with sustainability and scalability always in focus. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

As Hardware Technical Program Manager (TPM), you will serve as the central technical liaison driving joint vehicle programs between our engineering teams and Volkswagen, Audi, and Porsche. Based out of our Berlin hub, you will bridge the gap between our US-based core engineering teams and our European brand partners, aligning complex hardware requirements, program roadmaps, and architectural decisions.

Rather than managing tier-level supply chains, your focus is entirely collaborative and strategic: orchestrating alignment across brand engineering groups, manufacturing plants, and internal hardware teams to turn ambitious vehicle programs into production reality.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

 

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the hardware integration partner for VW, Audi, and Porsche

title: Head of Supply Chain (m/f/d)
description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

About this opportunity

As our Head of Supply Chain, you will play a critical role in ensuring the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of our supply chain from Asia into our EU, UK and US warehouse network, driving operational excellence to support our ambitious growth plans.

You'll lead our entire supply chain operations from sourcing of raw materials and our cosmetic products to final delivery of orders at our customers’ door step. You ensure smooth procurement, manufacturing, and logistics processes via air and sea shipments (incl. import) to our warehouses and efficient delivery to our B2C and B2B customers. If you're a strong Operations leader, passionate about building efficient and scalable processes and enjoy solving complex supply chain challenges in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to have you on board.

title: Process Automation Engineer - Internship (f/m/d)
description:
We are Metrify Smart Metering, Germany’s largest competitive smart metering operator, and a new strategic spin-off initiative by Enpal.

Are you ready for one of the great infrastructure challenges of the 2100s? title: Product Specialist
description:
Become the person who knows Cosuno best, and the one our customers want in the room.

YOUR MISSION

Cosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person. You'll know how every workflow behaves, which workarounds exist and where the product is heading. You'll lead the customer meetings that need deep product knowledge, from custom development projects to strategic conversations with our enterprise customers. You'll report directly to our Head of Product.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Be the go-to product expert. Sales, Customer Success and Account Management come to you first when a customer question goes beyond the standard. You answer all of them and turn recurring questions into answers everyone can find.

  • Lead customer meetings. Run feedback sessions, roadmap conversations and workshops with our customers, including our largest enterprise accounts.

  • Find solutions within the product. Sit down with customers, understand the problem behind the request and find creative ways to solve it with what we already have.

  • Turn feedback into decisions. Back customer requests with usage data, check them against our product principles and give our PMs clear, prioritized input. When we won't build something, you explain to the customer why.

description:
TL;DR: Conduct’s first dedicated analyst relations hire. You’ll build the function from the ground up and shape how the world’s most influential technology analysts, and the CIOs and boards who rely on them, see Conduct.

WHY CONDUCT

We believe the world’s largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don’t.

Every process change and every new product line runs into SAP systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

We’re building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we’ve closed game-changing SI partnerships, and just raised a $60M Series A.

We’re a small, talent-dense team doing our life’s work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world’s largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

title: Candidature Spontanée
description:
🚀 Arkane Cloud recrute — Postulez en candidature spontanée

Vous rêvez de construire l'infrastructure de demain ? Vous êtes passionné par l'IA, les GPU et les défis techniques qui comptent vraiment ? Arkane Cloud cherche des talents pour accélérer sa croissance.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Chez Arkane Cloud, on construit un Cloud Service Provider spécialisé dans les infrastructures GPU dédiées à l'IA. Notre mission : rendre le déploiement d'applications et de modèles IA radicalement plus simple.

On propose des instances GPU haute performance, une plateforme serverless pour les workloads IA, et le déploiement/hébergement de modèles en production avec des APIs compatibles OpenAI.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Impact immédiat — Vous arriverez tôt dans l'aventure. Ce que vous posez aujourd'hui, c'est ce sur quoi toute l'équipe va s'appuyer demain.

Défis techniques réels — Mise en production de modèles IA, optimisation d'inférence (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang), infrastructure Kubernetes GPU, autoscaling serverless. Des problèmes qui comptent vraiment.

Infra dernière génération — Vous avez à disposition une infrastructure GPU de pointe pour expérimenter, tester et déployer en production.

Équipe expérimentée — On cherche des talents avec de vraies années d'expérience. Vous allez apprendre auprès de personnes qui ont résolu les problèmes les plus difficiles du cloud et de l'IA.

Flexibilité — Deux jours de présence sur site tous les quinze jours (mercredi/jeudi). Tous les frais sont pris en charge par l'entreprise.

description:

Je nach Testprojekt können unter anderem folgende Tätigkeiten auf dich zukommen:

  • Apps, Websites und Software ausprobieren

  • Zuverlässige Internetverbindung
  • Sorgfältige und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse

Für einzelne Testprojekte können zusätzliche Voraussetzungen gelten, beispielsweise ein bestimmtes Betriebssystem oder spezielle Geräte. Diese werden jeweils vor der Teilnahme beschrieben.

title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Hiring now

We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake.

Role Overview

This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer.

description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

Vertalen van analyses en KPI-inzichten naar concrete verbeteracties.  Bevorderen van eigenaarschap, betrokkenheid en ontwikkeling binnen teams.  Ondersteunen van teamleiders bij het behalen van hun doelstellingen.  Bijdragen aan regionale managementbesluiten en organisatieontwikkeling.    In deze functie combineer je leiderschap, klantmanagement en bedrijfsvoering. Je bent zichtbaar voor klanten, toegankelijk voor medewerkers en resultaatgericht in de uitvoering.  Wat je krijgt  Bij Trigion werk je in een organisatie waarin samenwerking, ontwikkeling en continue verbetering centraal staan. Je krijgt de ruimte om impact te maken op zowel klantresultaten als medewerkerstevredenheid.  Daarnaast ontvang je:    Salaris tussen €4.000 en €5.000 bruto per maand (op basis van fulltime dienstverband en ervaring).  27 vakantiedagen per jaar.  Leaseauto.  Tantièmeregeling tot 25% van het jaarsalaris.  Laptop en telefoon.  Thuiswerkvergoeding.  Goede pensioenregeling.  Collectieve verzekeringen.  Ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden.    Wie je bent    Minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau.  Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie.  Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en klantrelaties.  Ervaring met het sturen op KPI’s en operationele resultaten.  Sterke coachende en verbindende leiderschapsstijl.     Jij herkent jezelf daarnaast in het volgende     Je bent toegankelijk, pragmatisch en empathisch.  Je weet mensen in beweging te krijgen en te enthousiasmeren.  Je bouwt gemakkelijk vertrouwen op bij klanten en collega's.  Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en stuurt op resultaat.  Je vertaalt strategie naar concrete acties en zichtbare verbeteringen. title: Product Manager
description:
The Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join Wpromote’s Technology team and help shape Polaris IQ, our marketing intelligence platform that gives clients more intelligent investment decisions and actions to grow their brand and their bottomline, with solutions across brand health, audience, creative, media, and measurement.

You’ll own multiple applications within Polaris IQ and lead the development & design group responsible for delivering the roadmap across those areas, building solutions that serve both Wpromote’s marketing experts and our clients. Sitting at the intersection of digital marketing, client delivery, and technology, you’ll work closely with our marketing services teams, clients, Engineering, Design, and other partners to understand how marketers work, identify opportunities, and turn them into clear product decisions and requirements.

The ideal candidate brings curiosity, strong judgment, and an innovative mindset to how technology, data, and AI can improve the way marketers work. You’re comfortable navigating competing priorities, using research and data to make decisions, and independently moving work forward. You understand how a digital marketing agency operates and the work our teams do for clients. For someone with digital agency experience, this role could be a great opportunity to apply that knowledge while taking the next step into Product.

You Will Be

  • Owning multiple applications within Polaris IQ, leading the squad responsible for delivering your roadmap, and contributing to the broader Wpromote Product roadmap

  • Conducting user research, analyzing market and product data, and developing clear use cases and recommendations to evaluate and prioritize opportunities

  • Translating user and business needs into requirements, workflows, acceptance criteria, and prioritized work for Engineering and Design

  • Partnering across Engineering, Design, R&D, Product Marketing, Sales, and Client Services to deliver, launch, and drive adoption of valuable and reliable product experiences

  • Representing Polaris IQ in client conversations, sales demos, internal meetings, and cross-functional planning

  • Using product usage, adoption, feedback, and business performance data to evaluate success and guide future decisions

  • 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, marketing technology, or a digital agency, with a strong understanding of how agency teams deliver marketing services for clients

  • Experience translating user or business needs into product requirements, priorities, workflows, or deliverables

Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

title: Machine Learning Data Scientist posting
description:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use.

This role is focused on research, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects.

We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions.

How you’ll work

  • You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform.

  • You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence.

As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

To support the ramp-up of our production activities in Munich, we are looking for a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Technician - Level 2 with strong practical experience in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT). Ultrasonic testing (UT) experience is an advantage.

title: Creative Director (m/w/d)
description:
Über Teaching Socials

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 25 High-Performern hat innerhalb von 2 Jahren ein konstantes Monatswachstum von über 750.000 € aufgebaut. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System – und du sorgst mit deinen Videos dafür, dass aus Ideen Reichweite, aus Zuschauern qualifizierte Leads und aus Personal Brands messbare Ergebnisse werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content-Strategie: Du entwickelst für jeden Kunden einen Content-Plan für die nächsten Wochen und leitest daraus einen klaren Produktionsplan für die Cutter ab.

  • Ideen und Skripte: Du findest die Themen, Hooks und Titel für alle Hauptvideos auf YouTube und schreibst die Skripte selbst.

  • Dreh: Du begleitest Drehs, verstehst Kamera, Licht und Ton und greifst selbst zur Kamera, wenn es nötig ist.

  • Schnitt und Qualität: Du gibst jedes Video frei, bevor es zum Kunden geht. Was nicht gut genug ist, geht zurück.

  • Cutter-Führung: Du führst das Cutter-Team, gibst regelmäßig konkretes Feedback und machst jeden Editor messbar besser.

  • Shortform und Ads: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus jedem Longform-Video verwertbare Clips und Ad-Creatives entstehen.

  • Kundenkommunikation: Du führst die Weeklys mit unseren Kunden, erklärst, was produziert wird und warum, und vertrittst deine Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn der Kunde anders denkt.

Was für dich drin ist:

  • Starkes Team: Familiäres Umfeld, gemeinsame Erfolge und Geburtstage

  • Schnelle Wege: Deine Ideen werden intern umgesetzt, statt in endlosen Entscheid

description:

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. title: Senior M&A Manager | Buy & Build

​

description:

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
About Virtual Identity

 

Virtual Identity (VI) is a digital agency built on Human-Centered Business Growth: combining empathy for people with insight from data to drive real digital success. With around 140 colleagues across Freiburg, Munich, Vienna, and Porto (and remote), we cover the full spectrum from Consulting and UX Research to UX/UI Design, Software Development, and Digital Marketing — always learning in close collaboration with our clients.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at VI, you sit at the intersection of client, product, and engineering. You're not building in isolation from a backlog handed down by someone else — you go into deep, sustained virtual immersion with the client, understand their real operational problems, and ship working software that solves them, fast. You prototype, integrate, and iterate directly with the people who will use what you build, then help harden it into something production-ready with our delivery teams.

You also bring a well-founded understanding of agentic engineering — not just using AI coding assistants, but genuinely understanding how agents plan, use tools, and fail, and applying that thinking to how you build, integrate, and automate in the field.

This role suits someone who's equally comfortable in a client workshop, a codebase, and a data pipeline — and who gets energy from ambiguity rather than needing it resolved before starting.

 

What you will do:

  • Embed with client teams to observe workflows, diagnose bottlenecks, and identify where custom software can create outsized impact.

title: Senior Materials Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials.

  • Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations.

title: Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders), you will own the development of safety-critical electronics for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. You will design compact, high-density mixed-signal hardware that accurately monitors, controls and protects large lithium-ion battery assemblies during charging, ground operation and flight.

This is a hands-on role covering the complete hardware lifecycle: requirements, architecture, circuit design, prototype bring-up, verification, qualification, production release and certification evidence.

Working closely with BMS software, battery systems, safety, PCB layout, mechanical integration, thermal systems, testing and manufacturing, you will turn the propulsion battery’s safety and control concepts into flight-ready, certifiable electronic hardware.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own the architecture and detailed design of battery management units, cell-monitoring electronics and associated sensing, communication and protection circuits.

  • Translate system, interface and safety requirements into complete, traceable and verifiable hardware requirements.

  • Design accurate measurement circuits for cell voltage, temperature, pack voltage, current and other battery sensors.

  • Develop high-density mixed-signal electronics incorporating battery-monitoring AFEs, balancing circuits, microcontrollers, watchdogs, memory, isolated communications and power supplies.

title: Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders) you will lead the electrical design of the battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and junction box of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will own everything electrical on and within these units, from cell interconnections and busbars to protection and safety devices, internal HV and LV wiring, and the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces. Through electrical modelling and analysis, you will close the design before it moves to test and provide the engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is electrically safe, robust, and certifiable.

Within the Airborne Electronics team, you will collaborate with Electronic Hardware Design and Power Electronics, and work closely with the Electrical Systems Architect and the HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration, Thermal Systems, Cell Technology, Safety, and Certification teams to ensure that the design of each unit is fully aligned with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the electrical/electrothermal design of HV equipment for an 800 V class propulsion battery system, covering topology, segregation, protection, isolation, precharge, and safe disconnection within each unit.

  • Align the electrical design of each unit with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system, working closely wit

You will establish and maintain a consistent, traceable, and certification-compliant requirements framework across the aircraft development lifecycle. Working closely with Overall Aircraft Design, Safety, Verification and Validation and Configuration Management, you will enable system and discipline owners to develop high-quality requirements by providing requirements engineering expertise, guidance and quality assurance.

As a senior member of Central Engineering, you will provide requirements engineering expertise across the organization, guide requirement owners in applying effective methods, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes.

title: Senior Mass Properties Engineer (all genders)
description:

title: Velocity Account Executive - SMB (English)
description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

Engineering Manager

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Sicherstellung einer zuverlässigen Verarbeitung von Inserts, Updates und Deletes
  • Berücksichtigung von Schema Evolution, Datenkonsistenz, Datenlatenz, Recovery und Reconciliation
  • Aufbau von Monitoring-, Logging- und Fehlerbehandlungsmechanismen für einen stabilen Produktionsbetrieb
  • Technische Abstimmung mit TigerData und bei Bedarf direkt mit Snowflake
  • Unterstützung bei der Implementierung, Validierung und Produktivsetzung der End-to-End-Lösung
  • Dokumentation der technischen Architektur sowie Wissenstransfer an das interne Team

Dein Profil:

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Datenintegrations- und Replikationslösungen
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse und praktische Projekterfahrung mit Snowflake

You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
description:
Background

Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.

Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you!

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while giving them access to the key financial information they need to make the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon in Europe!). In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:

  • 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

  • 💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor

  • 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe

title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Valence)
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airb

Social Media ist für dich kein Kanal, auf den man eine Kampagne am Ende noch irgendwie draufadaptiert. Sondern ein Ort, an dem Marken Teil von Kultur werden können.

Du weißt, was Menschen zum Stoppen, Teilen, Kommentieren oder Weiterschicken bringt. Du erkennst einen guten Insight oder einen Trend, bevor daraus eine Idee wird – und eine gute Idee, bevor daraus Content wird. Und du kannst beides: konzipieren und schreiben.

Wir suchen einen Senior Konzepter Social Media, der oder die Social Media versteht, Ideen entwickelt und Marken wie Oberbräu und der AOK Baden-Württemberg eine Stimme gibt, die man nach zwei Sekunden nicht wieder vergessen hat.

Damit bringst du uns weiter

  • Du entwickelst Social-first-Ideen und kreative Konzepte für Marken, Kampagnen und Always-on-Kommunikation
  • Du übersetzt Strategie, Cultural Insights und Plattformmechaniken in Ideen, die Menschen tatsächlich interessieren
  • Du konzipierst und textest vom ersten Gedanken bis zur fertigen Umsetzung: Hooks, Headlines, Captions, Scripts, Formate und Kampagnenideen
  • Du denkst nicht einfach TikTok oder Meta – du verstehst, warum Menschen sich dort wie verhalten
  • Du entwickelst Ideen gemeinsam mit unseren anderen Crafts weiter
  • Du präsentierst deine Konzepte überzeugend – intern genauso wie bei unseren Kunden
  • Du gibst Feedback, schärfst Ideen und hebst gemeinsam mit anderen die kreative Messlatte

Das wünschen wir uns von dir

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Konzeption, Copywriting und Kreation, idealerweise in einer Kreativ-, Social- oder Digitalagentur
  • Ein sehr gutes Gespür für Sprache, Tonalität, Storytelling und Marken
  • Erfahrung mit Social-first-Kampagnen, Content-Formaten und Bewegtbild
  • Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, was eine starke Markenidee von einem kurzfristigen Trend unterscheidet
  • Ausgeprägtes Interesse an Popkultur

title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Safety and Biosecurity
description:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

title: Technicien d'essais sur avion H/F
description:
Dans le cadre de nos différentes activités, nous sommes aujourd’hui reconnus comme des acteurs incontournables dans le domaine des essais aéronautiques sur FAL A320/A330/A321, avant la livraison des avions neufs. Sous-traitant du plus grand constructeur d'avions, notre ambition est d'acquérir de nouveaux marchés et contribuer au quotidien à la satisfaction de nos clients. Pour cela, nous pouvons compter sur nos équipes qui contribuent au quotidien à la performance et à la croissance de notre structure.

Sous la responsabilité du chef d’équipe, les techniciens d’essais aéronautiques réalisent les essais nécessaires en vue de l'attestation de conformité du produit.

Vos missions

𝐑𝐞́𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐝𝐞𝐬 𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐬 :

- Dérouler les procédures de test sur A320/A330/A321,

- Procéder à la pose & dépose des outillages et équipements nécessaires à la réalisation des essais,

- Réaliser les essais fonctionnels sur les systèmes de l'avion en vue de l'attestation de conformité,

- Rechercher les pannes (recherche de plan, trouble shooting, sonnage, mesure de tension, etc.).

𝐒𝐮𝐢𝐯𝐢 𝐝𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐭𝐞́𝐬 :

- Rédiger les différents avis suite aux problèmes rencontrés,

- Assurer le suivi informatique des essais (attestation des essais, réalisation de reprise d'essais, archivage, etc.),

- Procéder à l'amélioration continue des process industriels,

- Participer aux passages avion pour transferts des points vers les postes suivants,

- Piloter l'activité des assistants essais sur le poste.

Vos compétences

Le type de profil que nous recherchons :

- Formation aéronautique (avionique, mécanique, système) ou électrotechnique, idéalement BAC+2

- Connaissances dans les essais systèmes : commandes de vol, trains….

- Connaissance de la FAL

- Un bon relationnel et une capacité à travailler en équipe

- Un réel intérêt pour le secteur aérona

title: Senior QARA Engineer
description:
🏨 L’entreprise

Resilience Care, acteur majeur de la télésurveillance médicale et partenaire de la recherche clinique, est une société française fondée en 2021 avec une mission : mieux soigner.
Notre entreprise propose des solutions de télésurveillance en oncologie, gastro-entérologie et psychiatrie, basées sur la collecte d’ePRO associées à des techniques d’IA. Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

This role works across both sides of Pairs. You bring in companies worth our diligence, and you grow the network of investors who back them directly.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
At Signal AI, we use cutting-edge AI technology to offer clarity on decisions that shape businesses and society. We value restless curiosity, creative thinking, and diverse perspectives as we strive to become AI-native. We believe that AI is a collaborator, not just a tool, and we invite passionate individuals to join us on our journey as we continue to learn, experiment, and grow together.

About the role

Engineers at Signal AI are expected to bring a strong product mindset to their work. They’re comfortable with complex problems and proactively look for ambiguous ones rather than wait for others to resolve them, and work wherever the product needs them across the full stack. Engineers work closely with other disciplines, including applied research and design, as part of teams that own revenue-critical products from ideation through to production.

Owning a product end to end means much of an engineer’s time goes on understanding the problem: talking to colleagues in research, design and product, testing assumptions, and deciding what is worth building.

Our engineering teams are organised around the needs of the business. We value collaboration and teamwork, and we believe the best solutions to complex problems come from working together. You will work primarily within a small cross-functional team, contributing to its architecture and to engineering standards. You will provide clear, focused technical plans for current and future solutions, and you will keep the long-term technical vision in view.

AI-assisted development is part of everyday work across the organisation. We expect engineers to use tools like Claude Code to move quickly across the entire software development lifecycle, so more of their time is spent on the product questions that matter.
