Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

Sona's Customer Success function is being built from the ground up. $Millions of ARR is moving from Implementation to Customer Success, we're heading into our first year of renewals at scale, and there's meaningful seat expansion across the base. We need CSMs who can shape what good looks like, not operate inside a playbook someone else wrote.

You'll own a book of around 20-25 enterprise accounts across social care, hospitality and retail, partnering with Support, Product and Sales to own the post-live customer experience end to end. title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will partner directly with Digital Native companies to design, build and deploy AI-powered products and systems. Working alongside customer product and engineering teams, you will take ideas from early experimentation through evaluation, production launch and scale, connecting technical decisions to user experience and measurable business impact.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

You should be comfortable being accountable for outcomes you cannot delegate.

title: 사업 운영 매니저 (Business Operations Manager)
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     토스플레이스의 Business Operations Manager는 Enterprise Sales Team에 속해 있어요.  토스플레이스의 사업 모델과 POS 기반 제품 구조를 깊이 이해하고, 고객·대리점·내부 조직 등 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며 실행을 만들어내는 팀이에요.  단순히 계약을 만드는 것에 그치지 않고, 고객사의 실제 환경에 맞게 솔루션이 적용되고 비즈니스 성과로 이어지는 것까지 함께 고민해요.  Business Operations Manager는 이 팀 안에서, 세일즈 이후의 전 과정을 책임지며 솔루션이 고객사에 빠르게 안착하고 안정적으로 운영되도록 만들어요.  도입부터 운영, 그리고 성과 개선까지 이어지는 전 과정에서 문제를 해결하고 실행을 리딩하는 역할을 담당해요.       합류하면 함께 할 업무예요     토스플레이스 제품 도입을 위해, 설치부터 안정화까지 고객사와의 협업 여정을 관리하고, 이 과정에서 발견되는 문제를 주도적으로 해결해요.  이 과정에서 다양한 내외부 이해관계자들과의 커뮤니케이션 및 긴밀한 협업이 필요해요.  도입 이후 발생하는 운영 이슈를 해결하고, 안정적인 운영 환경을 만들어요.  고객에게 더 효과적으로 솔루션을 제안할 수 있도록, 제품 이해를 돕는 가이드 자료를 제작해요.  토스플레이스 솔루션에 대한 이해도를 높이기 위한 데모/시연 프로그램을 기획하고 운영해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     오프라인 결제 산업(VAN, POS 솔루션 등)에 대한 실무 이해도를 바탕으로 고객사 관리 업무를 수행하셨던 분이 필요해요.  프랜차이즈 본사나 VAN 대리점에서 포스를 깊이 있게 다뤄보고 운영해보신 분들도 좋아요.  복잡도 높고, 신규 기능이 빠르게 개발되는 환경에서 고객사에게 정확하고 깔끔한 가이드를 제공하실 수 있어야 해요. 이를 위해 포스 솔루션 이해도는 필수에요.  원활한 커뮤니케이션 역량을 바탕으로 고객사의 요구사항에 기민하게 대응하고, 내부 이해관계자들과도 의견을 조율할 수 있는 분을 찾고 있어요.  고객사 운영 과정에서 발생하는 다양한 문제와 요구사항을 정리하고 해결할 수 있는 역량이 필요해요.       토스플레이스로의 합류 여정     서류 접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사

title: Customer Service Team Manager - French Bilingual
description: ABOUT QUINCE   Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.  What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.   OUR CULTURE   Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.    We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.  Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.   Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.     If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.   The Role:     Customer Service Team Manager   We are seeking a French-bilingual  Customer Service Team Manager  to build and lead our founding French Customer Experience team, based in our Center of Excellence in Barcelona on a hybrid schedule. With a strong heritage, established retail partnerships and a clear purpose to “Reconnect to nature”, the company enables more people to grow, wherever they live, through high-quality, practical and innovative products. Today, Nelson Garden operates across the Nordic region, with its headquarters in Tingsryd, Sweden, and commercial operations in Finland, Norway and Denmark.     As part of its continued development in Denmark, Nelson Garden is now looking for a Key Account Manager to join a Nordic commercial team. The role offers the opportunity to take ownership of an important Nordic market, developing relationships with the Danish leading grocery retailers while identifying new opportunities for growth. title: (Senior) Account Manager

The company is the market leader in driving performance using Deep Learning across the entire purchase funnel. title: Key Account Manager - Estaciones de Servicio
description: En Logista, tendrás la oportunidad de llegar tan lejos como te propongas. Aprenderás a diario y aportarás valor en un entorno profesional, sólido, diverso, sostenible y tecnológico colaborando con equipos de alto rendimiento. Si buscas dar un salto profesional, vivir nuevas experiencias y estar en constante crecimiento, este es tu lugar. A nosotros nos motiva que consigas éxitos y sobre todo disfrutes del camino ¿y tú?  ¿te animas a sumarte a este viaje?       Logista  es el distribuidor líder a comercios de proximidad en Europa y está esoecualiuzada en la distribución a canales de proximidad. Sirve regularmente a más de 200.000 puntos de venta en España, Francia, Italia, Portugal, Polonia y Países Bajos. Facilita el mejor y más rápido acceso al mercado de una amplia gama de productos de conveniencia, farmacéuticos, recarga electrónica, libros, publicaciones, tabaco y loterías, entre otros. Esta filial permite a los puntos de venta complementar su oferta principal y mejorar sus ventas y rentabilidad gracias a una amplia gama de productos y servicios adaptados al punto de venta y a sus clientes finales, como artículos de fumador y relacionados con el tabaco, productos de papelería, confitería, alimentación, accesorios de tecnología, tabaco, etc.     Reportando al Responsable Nacional del canal de Estaciones de Servicio,  el/la Gestor/a de Cuentas  se responsabilizará de gestionar clientes a nivel comercial, así como del control, la planificación y coordinación de las diferentes áreas implicadas en el desarrollo del proyecto. Trabajo de campo  Gestión, planificación y control de diferentes proyectos  Interacción con diversas áreas internas de la compañía, ejerciendo como nexo entre estas áreas y el cliente (Transporte, Almacén, Bback office, calidad para la gestión de auditorías internas y externas)  Reporting actividad diaria y resolución de incidencias. Deseable experiencia como KAM en compañía fabricante y/o mayorista-distribuidora. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. At Deliveroo, You’ll Do Work That Matters, Solving Real-world Problems In a Three-sided Marketplace That’s Constantly Evolving. Pratique et facile d'accès, Lucie ouvre ses portes à toute heure et à toutes celles et ceux qui veulent bien manger, avec une large gamme de plats cuisinés, de salades, de sushis, de pokébowls ou encore d'encas sucrés super gourmands !   Rejoindre l'aventure LUCIE, c'est avant tout prendre part à une aventure humaine, relever de nombreux challenges en équipe et contribuer à la croissance d'un concept innovant. Lucie vous propose un environnement de travail inédit, mêlant agilité et engagement.    	Et si vous pilotiez l'expérience client de demain ?    Aujourd'hui, l'équipe grandit : nous recherchons nos futurs Managers expérience client H/F.    Vous aurez pour missions de :   - Accueillir, conseiller et orienter le client en audio/vidéo dans son parcours d'achat - Garantir au client une expérience d'achat de qualité  - Piloter et animer une équipe sur site en charge d'accueillir, conseiller et accompagner les clients à distance. - Garantir une expérience client fluide dans nos boutiques et conforme à nos standards de qualité - Accompagner, former et développer les compétences des collaborateurs - Organiser l'activité quotidienne et assurer la performance opérationnelle - Suivre les indicateurs, remonter les incidents et contribuer à l'amélioration continue du service Nous recrutons pour des postes de jour. Les horaires sont organisés selon un rythme alternant d'une semaine à l'autre, entre :  - Semaine du matin : 6h30 - 15h00 - Semaine d'après-midi : 14h00 - 22h30 - 1 week-end travaillé sur 3    Le planning est communiqué à l'avance afin de permettre à chacun d'anticiper son organisation.    	Votre profil :  - Expérience en management d'équipe opérationnelle ou supervision d'activité - Excellent relationnel et sens du service client - Leadership, réactivité et esprit d'équipe - Aisance avec les outils digitaux - Organisation, autonomie et capacité à gérer les priorités   Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  - Un poste à responsabilités dans un environnement innovant - Une équipe à accompagner et à faire grandir - Un projet ambitieux en pleine évolution - Un cycle de travail pensé pour vous : alternance travail / repos sur un rythme régulier et prévisible, avec de vrais blocs de jours off consécutifs  - Un planning stable et lisible sur plusieurs semaines - Une politique sociale engagée : 13ème mois, chèques cadeaux en fin d'année - Des moments de partage et de convivialité - -15% dans toutes les boutiques Lucie Envie de relever le défi ?    Rejoignez-nous et participez à la construction de l'expérience client de demain !

description: Som Service Delivery Manager hos Atea får du ansvaret for relationen omkring den samlede serviceleverance til en række kunder. Du bliver den, der skaber sammenhæng mellem kundens forretning, serviceaftalen og de teams i Atea, der leverer IT-infrastruktur og managed services.     Det kræver, at du både kan udfordre, skabe overblik og få forskellige interesser til at mødes. Til gengæld får du en rolle med betydelig selvstændighed, tæt adgang til kunderne og mulighed for konkret at påvirke både leverancen og samarbejdet.      Dine primære opgaver      Du får et tydeligt ansvar for dine kunder og kvaliteten i deres serviceleverance. Det betyder, at du blandt andet skal:   Eje den samlede serviceleverance og sikre, at den matcher kundens aftaler, behov og forventninger.  Drive service governance og skabe fremdrift gennem opfølgning på SLA’er, aftaler og indsatser.  Opbygge en tæt dialog med kunden og være den primære kontakt, når leverancen skal udvikles, eller noget kræver handling.  Have overblik over servicekontrakten og håndtere fakturering og rentabilitet sammen med account teamet.  Tage styring på eskalationer og samle de rette specialister omkring en løsning.  Identificere forbedringsmuligheder og udvikle kundens services i tæt samarbejde med kunden og interne specialister.       Om dig   Du har erfaring fra en kundevendt rolle inden for IT og managed services og er vant til at tage ansvar for en leverance, der involverer flere interessenter. Du kan eksempelvis arbejde som Service Delivery Manager, IT Service Manager eller IT-chef i dag.     Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:   Har erfaring med større serviceaftaler inden for IT og forstår dynamikken mellem kunde, kontrakt og leverance.  Har en solid forståelse for IT-infrastruktur og managed services, uden at du nødvendigvis selv er teknisk specialist.  Kan opbygge troværdige kunderelationer og samtidig tage de svære dialoger, når forventninger, økonomi eller leverance udfordrer samarbejdet.  Arbejder struktureret og kan bevare overblikket over SLA’er, økonomi, rapportering og opfølgning.  Har økonomisk forståelse og kan indgå i dialog om fakturering og rentabilitet.  Kommunikerer sikkert på dansk og engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.      En relevant videregående IT- eller forretningsmæssig uddannelse, eksempelvis cand.it. eller cand.merc., kan være en fordel, ligesom ITIL eller PRINCE2 kan være relevant. Din dokumenterede erfaring med serviceleverancer og kunder vejer dog tungere end din uddannelsestitel.     Rollen er derimod ikke et naturligt næste skridt, hvis du primært motiveres af selv at arbejde teknisk. Her lykkes du gennem dit ejerskab for kunden og leverancen og gennem din evne til at få andre til at lykkes sammen.      Derfor skal du vælge Atea   Du træder ind i et Service Delivery Management-team med 20 kolleger fordelt på Ballerup, Aarhus og Riga. Her får du erfarne kolleger at sparre med, samtidig med at du har frihed til selv at tilrettelægge arbejdet omkring dine kunder.

title: Serviceleder til brandsikring (ABA)
description: Vil du stå i spidsen for den daglige drift og samtidig udvikle stærke kunderelationer? Vi søger en serviceleder til vores brandsikringsafdeling i Søborg med ansvar for teknikere, kunder og ABA-service.       Din rolle som serviceleder   Du bliver en central del af vores brandsikringsafdeling, som oplever stor vækst. Du får ansvar for den daglige ledelse og koordinering af serviceteknikerne og bliver bindeleddet mellem kunderne, teknikerne og vores servicecenter.  Du sikrer, at serviceopgaverne planlægges, prioriteres og gennemføres til tiden, med høj kvalitet og en sund økonomi. Samtidig udvikler du medarbejderne, styrker kundesamarbejdet og skaber vækst gennem serviceaftaler og tillægsarbejder.      Dine primære opgaver    Daglig ledelse, planlægning og disponering af serviceteknikere  Opfølgning på årseftersyn, fejlmeldinger og akutte opgaver  Personaleledelse, oplæring og kompetenceudvikling  Kundekontakt, rådgivning og forventningsafstemning  Budgetopfølgning, fakturering og sikring af en sund indtjening  Kvalitetssikring, servicerapporter og dokumentation       Dine sekundære ansvarsområder    Salg og udvikling af serviceaftaler samt tilbud på tillægsarbejder  Teknisk støtte til serviceteknikerne og faglig eskalation  Koordinering med servicecenter, projektledere og eksterne samarbejdspartnere  Opfølgning på kapacitet, ressourceudnyttelse og arbejdsgange       Hvem er du?    Du har solid erfaring med ABA-anlæg og gerne også AVA, ABV eller ABDL  Du har erfaring som serviceleder, servicekoordinator eller erfaren ABA-servicetekniker  Du er en tydelig og motiverende leder, som følger op og skaber retning  Du arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag  Du har kommerciel forståelse og erfaring med økonomisk opfølgning  Du er serviceminded og kommunikerer professionelt med kunder og medarbejdere  Du er fortrolig med Office-pakken og digitale service- og dokumentationssystemer       Hvad tilbyder vi?    En selvstændig lederstilling med stort ansvar og tydeligt mandat  Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af vores serviceafdeling og dens arbejdsgange  Et stærkt fagligt miljø med dygtige og hjælpsomme kollegaer  Korte beslutningsveje og en uformel omgangstone  Løbende efteruddannelse gennem SIF Akademi  En attraktiv lønpakke med pension og gode personalevilkår  Firmabil, telefon og nødvendigt IT-udstyr  En arbejdsplads med mere end 100 års erfaring inden for tekniske installationer       Lyder det som noget for dig?   Send din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV til job@sif.dk, med emnet  "Serviceleder– att.: CBR".   Kontakt afdelingschef  Christian Bjørn Rasmussen  for en uforpligtende snak på 26 32 29 20 eller skriv en mail på CBR@sif.dk.     Vi gør opmærksom på at alle indsendte ansøgninger håndteres i henhold til vores privatlivspolitik.

title: Customer Success Team Lead (German-speaking)
description: Remote within EU time zones     Fluent German and English required    At Secfix, we're at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.  Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with the exception of our DACH sales team, which is based in Munich. We're a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader.  We've raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital.  This is where careers are made!   About The Role   Our CSM team has grown to five Customer Success Managers, each running a book of customers through ISO 27001, SOC 2, TISAX, NIS 2 and DORA. As the team keeps growing, we're creating a dedicated Team Lead role: a manager who works alongside the CSMs every day and makes their coaching and development a priority! You'll be the line manager for all CSMs and run 1:1s, feedback loops, onboarding, and provide inputs to performance reviews and career development, while keeping a reduced portfolio of your own customers (because we don't think you can coach CSMs well on work you don't do).    You've managed or formally coached CSMs before for at least 1 year and want to keep doing it; this isn't a first step into management  4+ years as a Customer Success Manager in B2B SaaS, ideally with mid-market or DACH Mittelstand customers  Fluent German and English as our CSM team works with customers in both  Comfortable with a revenue component: you've carried an upsell or NRR target yourself and can coach others toward one  You've built automations

title: フィールドサービスマネージャー｜Field Services Manager
description: 職務概要（job Summary）   フィールドサービスマネージャーは、ユニバーサル・スタジオ・ジャパン内で利用される各種IT機器およびサービスをサポートするフィールドサービスチームを統括頂きます。  本ポジションでは、POSシステム、ワークステーション、タブレット端末、モバイルデバイスなどの現場配備されたテクノロジーソリューションの運用を担当します。  24時間365日の安定したサービス運用基盤を整え、サービス提供のマネジメント、テクノロジー施策の推進を担います。また、多岐にわたるカウンターパート（パーク運営部門、アプリケーション開発チーム、インフラチーム、サイバーセキュリティチーム、ヘルプデスク、ベンダーおよびビジネス部門）と連携し、パーク全体で信頼性の高いテクノロジーサービスを提供します。   所属チーム（DEPARTMENT）   Global Technology & Innovation  Global Technology & Innovation（GTI）は、約70名規模・8つの機能別チームで構成されており、テーマパークビジネス全体におけるデジタルトランスフォーメーションを推進しています。  チームは、ゲスト体験を向上させるデジタルプロダクトから、企業活動を支えるエンタープライズシステムまで、幅広い領域の企画・導入・運用を担っています。  主な担当領域には、eコマース、チケッティング・入場管理システム、Web・モバイルアプリケーション、ゲームおよび新技術を活用したゲスト体験、フォト認証テクノロジー、アトラクション予約プラットフォーム、飲食プラットフォームとのデジタル連携体験などがあります。また、財務、人事、購買、バックオフィス業務などを支えるコーポレート／エンタープライズシステムの企画・導入にも携わり、パーク運営全体をテクノロジーで支えています。    主な業務内容（RESPONSIBILTIES）       プロジェクトおよびサービス運用管理（30%）   テクノロジープロセスおよびガバナンス基準に沿って、プロジェクトおよび運用活動を管理・実行。  ビジネスステークホルダーおよび社内チームと連携し、テクノロジーの展開、導入、運用準備を支援。    テクニカルサポートおよびベンダー管理（25%）   現場に展開されるハードウェアおよびテクノロジーソリューションに対して、技術的なリーダーシップとサポートを提供。  高いシステム可用性を確保し、ベンダーとの関係およびサービスパフォーマンスを管理。     ステークホルダー管理およびビジネスパートナーシップ（20%）   ビジネスステークホルダー、サービスプロバイダー、テクノロジーチーム、シニアリーダーシップにとって信頼されるパートナーとして行動します。  フィールドテクノロジーサポートおよび運用ベストプラクティスに関するSubject Matter Expert（SME）としての役割を担う。     継続的改善およびサービスエクセレンス（15%）   運用上のギャップ、再発インシデント、プロセス上の非効率を特定し、プロセス、テクノロジー、サービス全体の改善を推進します。  改善活動をリードし、Root Cause Analysis（RCA）およびProblem Managementの実践を活用して、運用品質、サービス品質、ユーザー体験を向上。    パフォーマンス管理およびレポーティング（10%）   運用KPI、サービストレンド、パフォーマンス指標を追跡・分析し、定期レポートおよび随時レポートを通じてITリーダーシップへのレポート。     マネジメント業務    フィールドサービステームのメンバーをリード、コーチング、育成し、運用およびビジネス目標の達成を支援。  パフォーマンス管理、目標設定、コーチング、キャリア開発活動を実施。  会社方針および適用される法令に従い、管理監督を担う。 Haemme nyt Istekille      ASIAKASPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ Länsi-Suomen alueelle      Haluatko rakentaa asiakkaan menestystä ja erinomaista asiakaskokemusta? Vastaat kokonaisvaltaisesti nimettyjen vastuualueittesi asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta ja asiakastyön toteutumisesta yhteistyönhallintamalliin perustuen. Ymmärrät ja kartoitat asiakkaan tarpeita sekä johdatat ne tavoitteellisesti läpi myyntiprosessin. Välität asiakkaan tarpeet ja odotukset sisäisille sidosryhmille, jotta pystymme tarjoamaan asiakaslähtöisiä ratkaisuja. Työskennellessäsi meillä pysyt alan kehityksen kärjessä ja saat itsellesi vakavaraisen sekä luotettavan työnantajan.   Jatkuvasti kehittyvä työympäristö  - Eteenpäin meneminen on meille tärkeää ja siksi kehitysaskeleita otetaan sitä mukaan, kun kehitettävää löydetään. Avulias ja ammattitaitoinen työtiimi  - Ketään ei jätetä yksin, vaan yhdessä tekemällä päästään parhaaseen mahdolliseen lopputulemaan. title: Client Success Associate - Dutch Speaking
description: Job Description    About the Role   The Client Success team follows a Client for Life Philosophy, and individuals in this role ensure that every Gartner client receives  value far exceeding their investment. Associates seek to understand and surface client’s business priorities, breakdown  challenges, and identify the most effective ways to support the client in making the right decisions for their business. They are  responsible for onboarding clients, proving the concept of Gartner services, and stimulating client engagement of products that are  used by large client teams.   What You Will Do     Partner with clients ranging from senior C-levels to more junior client professions in IT, HR, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Sales practices to ensure they are successful in the use of their Gartner subscription.  Deliver value to decision makers and drive Gartner growth by working as part of a service team where responsibilities can include: Introducing Gartner services and capabilities to prospective & new clients, account management or connecting clients with the Gartner expert community.  Identify client priorities and understand how to align Gartner's resources to provide best in class service that enables clients to achieve their priorities and maximize the return of investment on their Gartner memberships.  Collaborate with internal Gartner stakeholders to drive service delivery & business results, share best practices and design innovative solutions to overcome obstacles.  Leverage insights & metrics to drive continuous client engagement, satisfaction, retention and growth.     What You Will Need     Bachelors degree is preferred along with 6+ months relevant professional and/or internship experience.  Proven track record of success fueled by a passion for delighting clients  Strong communication, collaboration, prioritization, critical thinking, and influencing skills  Ability to use Dutch (Reading, Writing and Speaking) at a Business or Native level     Who Are We?   At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.  Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.  Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.   What Makes Gartner a Great Place to Work?   Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

title: Entry level Customer Success Manager (€30-€60k salary + commission)
description: We’re looking for entry level graduates, non-graduates and career changers as Tangent’s network grows globally across London, Barcelona, Berlin, Amsterdam and more. The starting salary is €30-€60k + commission.       What is Tangent      Tangent has created a new way to apply for jobs where industry expert mentors already working in the best companies provide free mentoring and support through the application process. On Tangent jobseekers sign-up and then connect with mentors for help with their CV, applications, industry advice and even support with salary negotiations. In today’s job market it’s almost impossible to get hired without the help of a mentor, they’ve been through the process in their career and want to give back by volunteering.     Tangent is a social impact platform built to help socially diverse backgrounds break into tech. Only 9% of tech employees come from low socioeconomic backgrounds, despite them making up 39% of the total population! That's worse than law, consulting and banking! We’re on a mission to change this and we need your help!     No previous experience or a degree is required, just a passion for the mission - helping jobseekers get hired with the help of a mentor      What you’ll do:        Client Onboarding:  Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and successful introduction to Tangent's services.   Relationship Management:  Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with assigned clients, acting as their trusted advisor.   Understanding Client Needs:  Proactively understand your clients' business objectives, challenges, and desired outcomes.   Value Demonstration:  Demonstrate the value of Tangent's services by providing regular updates, insights, and best practice recommendations.   Adoption and Engagement:  Drive product adoption and engagement through training, support, and proactive communication.   Problem Solving:  Identify and resolve client issues promptly and effectively, escalating where necessary.   Retention and Growth:  Work to reduce churn and identify opportunities to expand client accounts.   Feedback Collection:  Gather client feedback and share insights with the product and development teams to improve our services.   Advocacy:  Encourage clients to become advocates for Tangent through testimonials, case studies, and referrals.   Performance Tracking:  Monitor client health metrics and proactively address any potential issues to ensure success.   Reporting:  Prepare and deliver regular client reports, highlighting key achievements and areas for improvement.       Why Join Tangent?        Competitive Salary and Commission:  Earn a competitive base salary plus uncapped commission based on performance. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package.   Make a Real Impact:  You'll be directly contributing to our mission of helping jobseekers get hired with the help of a mentor   Career Growth:  We're a rapidly growing company with plenty of opportunitie

title: Asiakaskokemuspäällikkö (määräaikainen perhevapaan sijaisuus)
description: Rakennamme yhdessä tulevaisuuden Fenniaa asiakasarvo edellä, jotta asiakkaamme, omistajamme, voivat yrittää ja elää. Visiomme on olla vetovoimaisin, vastuullinen toimija. Neljä arvoamme, reilu, vastuullisesti rohkea, kehittyvä ja yhdessä, ohjaavat sitä, miten saavutamme tavoitteemme.  Fenniassa työskentelee rohkeita edistäjiä eri aloilta, devaajista asiakaspalvelun rautaisiin ammattilaisiin. Jos olet vastuullisesti rohkea ja reilu tiimipelaaja, joka haluaa kehittää asioita yhdessä, voisit sopia joukkoomme. Lue tarkempi tehtävän kuvaus alta ja ryhdy toimeen.  Haemme asiakaskokemuspäällikköä määräaikaiseen perhevapaan sijaisuuteen Fennian Henkilöasiakasliiketoiminnan Asiakasymmärrys-tiimiin. Toivomme, että pääset perehtymään tehtävään jo joulukuussa ja tarttumaan toimeen tammikuussa. Työsuhteen kesto sijaisuuden tarpeen mukaisesti (arvio noin 12kk).  Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten Fennia ymmärtää asiakkaidensa tarpeita, odotuksia, käyttäytymistä ja kokemuksia sekä kehittää palveluitaan tämän tiedon pohjalta.  Tehtävässä tuotat asiakas- ja asiakaskokemusymmärrystä henkilöasiakasliiketoiminnan johtamisen ja kehittämisen tueksi. Hyödynnät monipuolisesti asiakasymmärrystä, asiakaskokemusdataa, tutkimuksia sekä liiketoimintadataa tunnistaaksesi asiakkaiden tarpeisiin liittyviä ilmiöitä, kehityskohteita ja kasvumahdollisuuksia. Definire e monitorare KPI di qualità, condurre review e retrospettive, promuovere il miglioramento continuo dei processi.  Presidiare la gestione dei rischi e la conformità a procedure interne e requisiti del cliente.  Misurare la soddisfazione (survey, review periodiche, KPI condivisi) e trasformare i feedback in piani d'azione concreti. title: Senior OTC Sales Trader
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

About The Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced OTC Sales Trader to join our OTC Trading team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and executing large-scale cryptocurrency trades for institutional and high-net-worth clients, providing exceptional client service, and driving business growth through strategic sales initiatives.

What You'll Do:

  • Execute OTC cryptocurrency trades on behalf of institutional clients, high-net-worth individuals, and partners with a focus on accuracy, speed, and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients to understand their trading needs and provide tailored solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with the trading desk, risk management, and compliance teams to ensure smooth trade execution and adherence to regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor market trends, liquidity, and pricing to provide clients with competitive and timely trade opportunities.
  • Identify new business opportunities and contribute to the growth of the OTC trading desk.
  • Prepare and present regular reports on trading activity, client feedback, and market insights to senior management.
  • Ensure all trades comply with internal policies and external regulatory requirements.
  • Provide excellent client support and resolve any trade-related issues promptly.

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Proven experience (8+ years) in OTC trading, sales trading, or institutional sales within the cryptocurrency or traditional financial markets in MENA.
  • Strong understanding of cryptocurrency markets, blockchain technology, and digital asset trading.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with strong attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in trading platforms and tools; experience with OTC trading desks is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.

title: Director of Ad Sales - West
description:

Join us to build Duolingo Ads, Duolingo’s direct ad business. Most learners use our free, ad‑supported app—so great ads are core to our mission. We’re hiring a Head of West Coast Sales to open and scale our West Coast region. You will set regional strategy, build and lead a high‑performing team, and own revenue outcomes across priority verticals and agency holding companies. As a player/coach, you’ll cultivate senior‑level relationships, shape pricing and packaging with leadership, and close high‑impact deals that both delight learners and drive revenue while leading a team of sellers. This is a high‑ownership, early‑stage opportunity to help define how ads show up for hundreds of millions of learners while building a repeatable, data‑driven go‑to‑market.

You will...

  • Own West Coast revenue targets and forecasting; build a healthy, predictable pipeline across named accounts and agency groups, and deliver against quarterly goals.

title: Account Executive - Enterprise
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

title: Senior Data Scientist/ML Ops Engineer (all genders)

With a mission to empower 15.6 million house owners across Germany and the broader DACH region, we at Aroundhome are building a platform where every strategic decision is powered by data. We’re a team of around 250 people, and to take the next step, we’re looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Data Scientist (all genders) to bring machine learning into the heart of our product.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build Aroundhome’s first machine learning model in production: the logic that decides which partners each homeowner is matched with. You will start from the problems homeowners and partners actually have, and own the solution end to end, in a small new team with a product manager, an engineer and the team lead.

Responsibilities:

  • Make Every Match Count: Improve our matching logic with deployed models that make the most efficient use of partner capacity, raise match rates, and account for regional supply and demand.
  • Prove Impact: Measure every improvement against our current logic in controlled experiments designed for a two-sided marketplace, before it scales.
  • Build the Data Foundation: Create the datasets and pipelines your models need, together with our engineer and the Data Engineering team. In the first months, this is a big part of the role.
  • Shape Our ML Stack: Decide with the team how and where models run, and set the practices for machine learning at Aroundhome.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

title: Analog Layout Engineer (Lead)
description:
At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

 

Kandou’s architecture is not just an incremental improvement — it’s a foundational shift in how AI hardware is built for the future.

 

Job title: Analog Layout Engineer (Lead)

Location: EU/CH/UK

 

Responsibility

  • Position in custom layout and verification of analog circuits, cells, blocks, and IP for multi-Gigabit high speed chip to chip communication links (SerDes up to and beyond 28Gb/s and/or memory IO) in advanced semiconductor technology nodes

  • Layout and verification of very high-speed analog circuits

  • Interact closely with the design team to understand requirements and implement solutions

  • Support IP and chip level integration

title: Product Specialist
description:
About Juicebox

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams win the talent war.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside 5,000+ customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR with 20%+ monthly growth, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over $116M in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.

The Role

We're hiring our founding London-based Product Specialist to sit at the heart of customer support and product quality. You’ll respond to live support requests, investigate bugs in real time, and work closely with engineering and product to ensure issues are resolved quickly and clearly. You’ll play a key role in keeping our customers unblocked, and helping our team stay fast, focused, and close to user pain.

You'll define what great support looks like in an AI-first world at a hypergrowth company becoming a category leader. The foundation is already in place: customers love the product, relationships are strong, and commercial results speak for themselves.

About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

title: Database Engineering Intern
description:
We are looking for a Database Engineering Intern to work on the data layer of our production software. You will work alongside the developer who owns our data layer on data modelling, query optimisation and documentation.

Our stack is PostgreSQL, Supabase, PostgREST and row-level security, with TypeScript, React, Vite, Vitest, Deno edge functions and GitHub Actions around it. Every change goes through a pull request with automated type, lint, format, build and test checks.

Duration: 6 months; Start: flexible

Tasks

  • Get familiar with our database structures and document how they are modelled.

  • Analyse table and column usage and prepare migrations where structures are no longer needed.

  • Improve our data models: reduce duplicated values and work with references and views.

  • Optimise data access so that more work happens in the database and less in the application.

  • Measure query performance and add indexes where they make a difference.

  • Review our database access policies.

Requirements

  • You are studying computer science, data engineering or something similar.

  • Comfortable in SQL: joins, aggregates, indexes, and reading a query plan.

  • You are happy to spend time reading existing code before changing it.

  • PostgreSQL specifics (indexing strategies, EXPLAIN, constraints, triggers) and experience with Supabase or a similar API-over-Postgres layer are a plus.

  • Coursework or a project in data modelling and normalisation.

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools.

title: Creative Director (m/w/d)
description:
Über Teaching Socials

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 25 High-Performern hat innerhalb von 2 Jahren ein konstantes Monatswachstum von über 750.000 € aufgebaut. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System – und du sorgst mit deinen Videos dafür, dass aus Ideen Reichweite, aus Zuschauern qualifizierte Leads und aus Personal Brands messbare Ergebnisse werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content-Strategie: Du entwickelst für jeden Kunden einen Content-Plan für die nächsten Wochen und leitest daraus einen klaren Produktionsplan für die Cutter ab.

  • Ideen und Skripte: Du findest die Themen, Hooks und Titel für alle Hauptvideos auf YouTube und schreibst die Skripte selbst.

  • Dreh: Du begleitest Drehs, verstehst Kamera, Licht und Ton und greifst selbst zur Kamera, wenn es nötig ist.

  • Schnitt und Qualität: Du gibst jedes Video frei, bevor es zum Kunden geht. Was nicht gut genug ist, geht zurück.

  • Cutter-Führung: Du führst das Cutter-Team, gibst regelmäßig konkretes Feedback und machst jeden Editor messbar besser.

  • Shortform und Ads: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus jedem Longform-Video verwertbare Clips und Ad-Creatives entstehen.

  • Kundenkommunikation: Du führst die Weeklys mit unseren Kunden, erklärst, was produziert wird und warum, und vertrittst deine Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn der Kunde anders denkt.

Was für dich drin ist:

  • Starkes Team: Familiäres Umfeld, gemeinsame Erfolge und Geburtstage

  • Schnelle Wege: Deine Ideen werden intern umgesetzt, statt in endlosen Entscheidungsschleifen zu versanden

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once:

title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

title: Financial Controller
description:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

 

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

 

Does this sound like you?

You’re a qualified accountant who enjoys being close to the numbers and close to the business. You’ve run month-end, the balance sheet, and financial controls end to end, and you know what good controls look like in both complex and fast-growing environments. You stay calm under pressure, explain finance simply to people outside it, and you’re always looking for smarter, more automated ways of working.

title: Principal of backend
description:
About SchemeServe

SchemeServe is insurance software like no other.

Hosted in the cloud for MGAs, brokers and insurers, the SchemeServe platform boasts unique flexibility, unstoppable innovation and truly Obsessive Support.

Started in 2000 by our CEO, Adam, SchemeServe has grown from strength to strength, never having taken outside investment. We're proud of how far we've come and how loyal we've stayed to our Core Values.

We're fully remote (we were doing it before it was fashionable!), although we get together twice a year for Team Retreats.

We prize self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and challenging themselves. Free books? Mentoring? Professional development? You got it.

We also offer flexible working, paid charity days, a fantastic, relaxed and open company culture and free biscuits through the post.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer

UK Remote

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal



This is a deeply technical role.

title: Studentenjob als Software-Tester (m/w/d) 40-60 %
description:
Werde Teil des Wistar-Expertenteams und eröffne dir neue Entwicklungs-Perspektiven!

Für uns sind alle Menschen wertvolle Unikate. Deshalb spielen weder Geschlecht noch Religion oder Herkunft eine Rolle. Die Freude an der Arbeit und kreativen Problemlösungen sollen deine wichtigste Motivations-Zünder sein!

Aufgaben

  • Durchführung von Tests für IT-Applikationen im Zusammenhang mit Änderungsanträgen sowie Regressionstests gemäß vorgegebenen Richtlinien
    und Vorlagen

  • Planung und Ausführung von manuellen Tests während der Release-Tests

    Auswertung der Testergebnisse mit dem Testmanager

    Durchführung, Auswertung sowie Erstellung von Maßnahmenkatalogen,
    Checklisten und Risikobeschreibungen)

  • Interaktion mit Kunden und Unterstützung bei IT-Problemen

  • Du befindest dich im Studium zum Software-Engineer, Informatiker oder Wirtschaftsinformatiker

Benefits

  • Flexibles Arbeiten neben dem Studium, vorwiegend im Home-Office

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Het Customer Succes team is verantwoordelijk voor het beheren en het uitbouwen van het huidige klantportfolio, dat gebruik maakt van onze verzuimsoftware. Samen met vier Customer Success Managers help je bestaande klanten om efficiënter en effectiever gebruik te maken van onze softwareoplossing. Als CSM heb je twee belangrijke doelstellingen waar we actief op sturen: klantwaarde en klanttevredenheid. Je hebt jouw eigen klanten waarmee je vooral op tactisch en strategisch niveau een langdurige klantrelatie opbouwt. Jij bent de “trusted advisor” voor de beslissers bij de klant en samen kijken we continue naar extra mogelijkheden en kansen, en helpt jij samen met alle collega’s de klanten het optimale uit de software te halen.      Functieomschrijving   Als Customer Success Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onboarden van nieuwe klanten, ondersteund door een projectteam. Je onderhoudt relaties met klanten op verschillende niveaus binnen hun organisatie, met de focus op klanttevredenheid, -behoud en groei van de portefeuille. Je zorgt voor omzetgroei door upsell/cross-sell en analyseert zowel klantdoelstellingen als die van je eigen organisatie om deze te bereiken.     Je fungeert als eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten en wijst hen op beschikbare resources, zoals kennisbanken, trainingen en handleidingen. Daarnaast monitor je de opvolging van taken, ondersteund door de binnendienst, en analyseer je klantfeedback om producten en klanttevredenheid te verbeteren. Je onderhoudt nauw contact met klanten en interne opdrachtverantwoordelijken, zoals de Lead of Project Manager.     Je bent alert op ontwikkelingen bij klanten die kunnen leiden tot het reduceren of beëindigen van de dienstverlening en onderneemt initiatieven om klanttevredenheid te verbeteren waar nodig. Je houdt jezelf op de hoogte van relevante trends, ontwikkelingen in de markt, productkennis en processen.     Tot slot bewaak je, met ondersteuning van de binnendienst, de naleving van gemaakte afspraken, zoals vastgelegd in DAP, SLA's, werkopdrachten en bijbehorende KPI's. Je stelt DAP's op, waarbij klantbehoeften vertaald worden naar concrete afspraken, en rapporteert over prestaties aan in- en externe stakeholders.      Over jou    HBO werk en denkniveau (bij voorkeur Bedrijfskundig, IT, Commerciële Economie);  Je hebt bij voorkeur minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld als Account Manager, SLA en/of Delivery Manager, Consultant of Project Manager;  Je hebt kennis van (markt- en klant)ontwikkelingen in het vakgebied van bedrijfsgezondheid en sociale zekerheid;  Je hebt kennis van projectmanagement en IT-beheer methodieken;  Je bent klantgericht;  Je beschikt over commercieel inzicht;  Je bent communicatief vaardig, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;  Je bent in staat om vanuit een helikopter view te werken;  Je legt makkelijk contact en is in staat relaties op te bouwen en te onderhouden.      Deze eisen en vaardigheden geven een richting van het profiel dat wij zoeken

title: Bank Implementation Manager
description: We’re looking for a Bank Implementation Manager to join our team and help clients connect their banks, set up workflows, and get the most out of our platform from day one. We welcome high performers who thrive in dynamic, client-focused environments.     At Cobase, we’re helping companies take back control of their banking and treasury operations.  Many mid-sized and large businesses manage multiple banks, dozens of accounts, and complex finance structures often spread across countries, currencies, and entities. It’s messy, inefficient, and hard to manage. That’s where we come in.  Cobase offers a single platform where finance teams can handle payments, cash management, and other treasury functionality all connected to their ERP or accounting system. No more jumping between portals or spreadsheets.  We work with international corporates, growing groups, and private equity-backed companies who want to simplify their financial operations and increase control.      The role: help our customers hit the ground running.   We’re looking for a Bank Implementation Manager to join our team and lead clients through onboarding and setup. We value proactive, high-performing professionals who thrive in dynamic environments.  In this role, you’ll partner with banks to ensure Cobase is up and running quickly connecting banks, configuring payments and reporting, and establishing payment products. Positioned at the intersection of finance, technology, you’ll play a key role in delivering a seamless start for our clients.      What you will do:    Act as the main point of contact for banks during onboarding of our clients  Coordinate bank integrations with both client stakeholders and bank teams  Establishing technical connectivity such as SWIFT, SFTP, EBICS and API  Troubleshoot issues and collaborate with our support and product teams when needed  Gather and share feedback to improve our platform and services  Partner with some of worlds most dynamic finance teams and banks.          What we are looking for:    Result-oriented mindset with a “get things done” approach  Strong communication skills and a structured way of working  Fluent in English and at least one other language  Comfortable working with technology, banking, or finance tools  Ability to engage confidently with both IT and Finance stakeholders  Prior experience in treasury, payments, ERP, or financial implementation is a strong advantage  Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience  Hands-on, proactive, and eager to take ownership       Must to have EU citizenship with the right to work in the Netherlands.

title: Customer Service Manager
location: Haderslev, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Leder af genbrugs- og kundevejledere med fokus på mennesker, drift og borgeroplevelser    ReQT Consulting søger for Provas Forsyningsservice A/S - Haderslev kommunes forsyningsselskab       Vil du stå i spidsen for en vigtig kundeservicefunktion, hvor mennesker, ledelse og samfundsansvar går hånd i hånd?      Hos Provas får du muligheden for at sætte retningen for en kundeservicefunktion med stor betydning for både borgere, medarbejdere og den daglige drift. Du bliver leder for den kundeservice og -vejledning som sker ved telefonen og pr. mail samt på genbrugspladserne – og du får en central rolle i at skabe fællesskab, struktur og stærke samarbejder på tværs.     Vi søger en nærværende, kompetent og tydelig leder, der trives i arbejdet med mennesker, motiveres af udvikling og formår at skabe følgeskab i ”medledende” teams. Du bliver en del af et stærkt ledelsesfællesskab i en organisation med højt engagement, stor samfundsmæssig betydning og fokus på at skabe den bedst mulige oplevelse for borgerne (som vi også kalder kunderne).         Er du vores nye kollega?   Vi forestiller os, at du kommer fra en rolle, hvor du har arbejdet med ledelse og kundeservice tæt på en drift- eller serviceorganisation. Du er nysgerrig og motiveres af at få mennesker, samarbejder og processer til at fungere i praksis og trives i en rolle med mange kontaktflader.  Som leder skaber du tillid og følgeskab gennem tydelig kommunikation, involvering og nærvær. Du evner at lade medarbejderne bringe deres kompetencer i spil, hvor du understøtter gennem afbalanceret retnings- og rammesætning, når situationen kræver det. Du arbejder coachende og faciliterende og formår at skabe struktur, engagement og stærke fællesskaber.  Derudover har du erfaring med ledelse, interesse for adfærdsdesign og brugeradfærd samt lyst til at arbejde i en organisation præget af udvikling, forandringer og med fokus på den gode borgeroplevelse. Du kommer til at indgå i et stærkt lederfællesskab på tværs af virksomheden, hvor vi sammen tager ansvar for helheden.         Om Provas   Provas er Haderslev Kommunes forsyningsselskab, der leverer drikkevand og håndterer spildevand, affald og genbrug for kommunens 56.000 indbyggere. Indsatserne har stor betydning for fremtidige generationer ved at sikre et bæredygtig vandkredsløb og genbrug af ressourcer.     Provas er en moderne virksomhed med godt 80 ansatte. Omkring halvdelen arbejder i den fysiske drift, og resten arbejder overvejende på kontoret. Der er et fladt hierarki, så i dagligdagen er topledelse ikke et tydeligt begreb. Ledelsesstilen hos Provas er inddragende og støttende, og der er en tydelig involvering af medarbejderne, så alle udvikler sig med opgaverne og i fællesskab finder de bedste løsninger.      I Provas arbejdes der både med hovedet og med hjertet. Derfor lægges der stor vægt på, at medarbejderne har talent for at lytte, samarbejde og anerkende et godt argument.         Dit nye job er en nøglerolle …   Som leder af vores genbrugs

CX프로덕트실과 협업한 운영 문제의 제품·정책 반영      - 데이터로 발견한 문제의 화면 플로우·기능 정의서 등 프로덕트 조직이 이해할 수 있는 형태로의 구체화      - 상담 시스템 전환·고도화, AI 상담 확대, IVR(자동응답) 개편 과정의 운영 요구사항 정의·반영 및 전환 시점 운영 리스크 사전 점검    3. 중대 이슈 선제 대응 체계 수립      - 여러 주체가 얽힌 복합 이슈 대응 및 재발 방지를 위한 운영 체계 재설계      - 리스크 조기 감지 방법 및 에스컬레이션 경로 설계·운영      - 신규 유형 민원 대응 기준 수립·문서화를 통한 구성원 간 판단 기준 일원화    4. 유관 조직 협업을 통한 과제 실행력 확보      - 사업·정책·프로덕트·딜리버리 등 유관 조직과의 협업 및 공감대 기반 과제 완수      - 운영 성과 정기 리뷰 및 리더십 커뮤니케이션, 지표 변동 시 문의 유형 구성 변화와 실제 성과 변화를 구분한 원인 설명    5. 팀 빌딩 및 구성원 육성      - 구성원 코칭·성과 관리 및 팀 내 우선순위 정렬      - 정답 제시보다 판단 기준과 맥락 제공을 통한 구성원의 자율적 문제 해결 지원      - 차기 리더 후보 육성           [지원자격]     - CX·고객센터 운영 분야 7년 이상 경력    - 고객 여정·상담 흐름·인입 구조에 대한 깊은 이해    - 고객센터·상담 운영 조직 리딩 경험    - 운영 비효율을 데이터로 진단해 정량적 개선 성과를 만들고, 그 개선이 유지되도록 구조를 설계한 경험    - 복잡한 상황을 구조적으로 정리하고 명확하게 커뮤니케이션하는 역량           [우대사항]     - 푸드 또는 커머스 플랫폼 CX 경험    - 여러 플랫폼·서비스 병행 운영 또는 그에 준하는 복잡도의 운영 경험    - 100명 이상 규모 CX 조직에서 운영기획·서비스기획·VOC 개선 프로젝트를 주도한 경험    - 조직 개편·업무 이관 과정에서 운영을 안정적으로 유지한 경험    - 상담 시스템 또는 AI 상담 도입·운영 경험    - 2차 민원(에스컬레이션) 대응 경험    - 이해관계가 상충하는 다수 조직 간 조율을 통해 합의를 도출한 경험    - 제품·정책 조직과 협업해 운영 개선을 시스템·정책으로 정착시킨 경험    - 문제 정의부터 개선 실행, 효과 검증까지 완결한 개선 사이클을 문의량 감소 등 정량 성과로 연결한 경험

title: Afdelingschef til Kunder og Marked hos Midttrafik
description: Kan du komme hele vejen rundt om kundens rejseoplevelse?       Kunderne skal kunne regne med Midttrafik hver eneste dag. Som afdelingschef for Kunder og Marked i Midttrafik leder du fire velfungerende teams, følger den strategiske retning for en driftsfokuseret afdeling og sikrer, at kundens perspektiv har en stemme i vores beslutninger.      Midttrafik er et fælleskommunalt trafikselskab, ejet af 18 kommuner og Region Midtjylland. Vi sikrer kollektiv trafik, der hænger sammen i hele regionen. Hos os er visionen klar: Vores kundefokus skaber nem, attraktiv og bæredygtig mobilitet for alle passagerer. Og her kommer du så ind i billedet som afdelingschefen, der fortsat holder visionen og kunden i fokus.      Opgaven, du træder ind i   Kunderne møder hver dag Midttrafik i telefonen, på skærmene og ude på ruterne. Med Strategiplan 2025–2028 har afdelingen fået en klar retning: Kunderejsen skal være nem, tilgængelig og forståelig før, under og efter turen.     Som afdelingschef får du ansvaret for, at afdelingen lever op til den ambition – både i den daglige drift og i den videre udvikling. Du bliver også en del af et chefteam med direktør Lars Berg i spidsen, hvor du sammen med to chefkollegaer er med til at sætte retningen for hele Midttrafik.      Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at    lede afdelingen Kunder og Marked gennem tre teamledere og have direkte ledelse af Markedsføringsteamet på fire personer  omsætte Strategiplan 2025–2028 til konkrete handlingsplaner og prioriteter og følge op på, at afdelingen leverer på dem  sikre stabil drift og tydelig kommunikation til kunderne, også når driften bliver forstyrret  drive den digitale udvikling i afdelingen sammen med IT & Digitalisering, så kunderne oplever nemme og sammenhængende digitale løsninger  have ansvaret for afdelingens budget, business cases, projekter og leverandørkontrakter – og samarbejde tæt med dine to chefkollegaer om Midttrafiks samlede prioriteringer  være sparringspartner for direktøren, når organisationens vigtigste beslutninger skal træffes      Det er et forholdsvis ungt lederteam, der sætter pris på en chef, som giver sparring og plads, viser vejen og hjælper med at prioritere de mange vigtige opgaver. Du står i spidsen for en afdeling med høj faglighed, så der er plads til at fokusere på den langsigtede udvikling og ledelse.  Samtidig skal afdelingen udvikle sig i takt med kundernes behov og de digitale muligheder – med blik for, at faglighed og personlig kontakt fortsat gør en stor forskel for kunderne.      Velkommen i teamet   I rollen bliver du chef for Kunder og Marked, som består af fire teams:   Trafikservice  sørger blandt andet for hurtig og forståelig information til kunderne, når driften bliver forstyrret.   Kundeservice  svarer kunderne på telefon og skriftligt.   Billetkontrol  står for administrationen af udstedte kontrolafgifter.   Markedsføring  arbejder både for, at flere vælger den kollektive trafik, og for at profilere Midttrafiks produkter.     I

Lægge planerne og prioritere vores salgsindsatser og sikre, at de bliver ført ud i livet. Altid med øje for, hvad data fortæller dig.  Finde potentialet blandt vores nye såvel som eksisterende kunder og styrke kunderejsen i et intelligent samspil med vores marketing og de retention flows der tiltrækker, vedligeholder og bearbejder leads.  Gå forrest som spillende træner og selv ringe ud til kunder hver uge.  Sætte retning for de samlede salgsindsatser, coache og salgstræne teamet, så sælgerne bliver endnu dygtigere.       Hvad vi forventer af dig:    Du har erfaring med opsøgende salg og ved, hvordan man arbejder videre med kundeporteføljen.  Du er stærk i CRM, gerne på super user-niveau, og har idéer til, hvordan systemet og processerne skal skrues sammen.  Du er kommercielt drevet og forstår hele kunderejsen.  Du sælger ordentligt og troværdigt – du er ikke typen, der oversælger.  Du taler og skriver dansk, engelsk og tysk uden problemer.       Om Zederkof og teamkulturen   I over 25 år har Zederkof leveret professionelle teltløsninger, møbler og inventar til hoteller, restauranter og eventsteder – kort sagt til steder, hvor mennesker mødes. Vi er en ejerledet grossistvirksomhed med base i Fredericia, hvor vi driver vores showroom og webshops. Efter en større digitaliseringstransformation er vi nu klar til at sætte strøm til vores markedsrette
