title: CRM Manager
description: À propos d'Ornikar Assurances ✨   Chez Ornikar, nous accompagnons chaque année des centaines de milliers de jeunes vers le permis de conduire. Cette proximité unique avec 5 millions d'élèves passés par notre auto-école constitue un avantage compétitif majeur : elle nous permet de mieux connaître les jeunes conducteurs que quiconque, de les tarifer plus finement, et de leur offrir une expérience d'assurance à la hauteur.  Nous avons récemment enrichi notre gamme avec la MRH et l'assurance Chien & Chat, pour accompagner nos clients au-delà de l'auto, tout au long de leur vie.  Dans ce contexte, le CRM joue un rôle central pour relever deux enjeux prioritaires :    construire un parcours Auto seamless qui maximise l'acquisition, l'activation des nouveaux assurés (validation des pièces, onboarding) et la rétention au renouvellement  développer le cross-sell entre nos produits pour maximiser les ventes et la fidélité client    Nous renforçons notre équipe CRM Assurance et recherchons la personne qui, aux côtés d'un·e pair CRM Manager déjà en poste, portera ces enjeux au quotidien.   Nous recherchons un·e CRM Manager 🚨   Rattaché·e à la Head of CRM & Marketing Client, vous portez en propre l'ensemble du périmètre CRM Assurance, aux côtés d'un·e pair CRM Manager. Vous travaillez au quotidien avec les squads Produit, Data et Growth.  Rejoindre l'équipe CRM d'Ornikar, c'est évoluer dans une scaleup où le CRM n'est pas une fonction support mais un pilier de croissance, dans un environnement exigeant, orienté performance, où l'exécution et l'impact priment.   Vos missions 🎯    Faire scaler le parcours CRM Auto   Notre premier levier de valeur : offrir aux nouveaux assurés Auto une expérience fluide, de la souscription au renouvellement. Une base de parcours existe déjà, votre rôle est de la faire passer un cap.   Concrètement, Vous :     Optimisez les parcours d'activation post-souscription (validation des pièces, premier prélèvement, onboarding) pour améliorer significativement le taux de validation de police  Renforcez la conversion devis → contrat via des campagnes de relance et de nurturing plus fines  Construisez les parcours de rétention et de renouvellement pour maximiser la fidélité à l'issue de la première année  Portez le test & learn sur ces parcours : hypothèse, dispositif, mesure d'incrémentalité, décision     Développer le cross-sell entre nos produits   Notre second levier de croissance : transformer nos clients mono-produit en clients multi-équipés (Auto + MRH + Chien & Chat).   Concrètement, Vous :     Identifiez et exploitez les moments propices au cross-sell (déménagement, sinistre bien géré, échéance, événements de vie)  Construisez les parcours d'activation et de nurturing cross-produits  Orchestrez les campagnes cross-sell avec les autres communications pour maintenir une pression marketing maîtrisée  Mesurez la contribution du cross-sell CRM à la croissance et à la LTV     Délivrer les cycles CRM au rythme des featu

title: Responsable CRM & Fidélisation
description: SCANDALE (anciennement Maison Close) est une maison française de lingerie et de prêt-à-porter qui célèbre l'audace, l'exigence et la créativité. Notre ambition : offrir une expérience digitale premium et innovante à travers nos sites e-commerce, nos marketplaces et l'ensemble de nos points de contact digitaux.     Au sein de l'équipe digitale, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la directrice digitale afin d’accompagner la croissance de la marque grâce aux leviers CRM.       Contexte du poste      Notre activation CRM repose sur l’exploitation de la donnée client centralisée dans un Power BI (branché à Klavyio et Shopify). Nous disposons d'une base riche, dont une base active significative, qu’on doit aujourd’hui piloter stratégiquement pour la transformer en actions concrètes et rentables, cohérentes avec notre image de marque.  Pour cela, nous recherchons un·e CRM Manager pour prendre en main ce pilotage et faire vivre notre programme de fidélité Close to You.      Vos missions       Stratégie CRM & pilotage par la donnée (PowerBI, Klavyio)    Analyser la base client pour identifier les segments à fort potentiel et construire une feuille de route d'actions priorisées par ROI  Définir et suivre les KPI clés : taux de conversion, taux de réactivation, taux de churn, CLTV, coût par contact actif...  Arbitrer les priorités entre acquisition, réactivation et fidélisation en fonction de la rentabilité réelle des actions  Accompagner le.a chargé.e de CRM sur les ciblages des campagnes CRM fonction de la segmentation    Lifecycle marketing (Klaviyo)    Concevoir, déployer et optimiser les flows : bienvenue, post-achat, panier abandonné, winback, programme VIP...  Construire et exécuter des tests A/B pour améliorer en continu la performance des campagnes  Veiller à la cohérence de chaque communication avec l'identité et le ton premium de la marque    Programme de fidélité Close to You (Yotpo)    Piloter et faire évoluer le programme dans son ensemble  :  mécaniques de récompense, paliers, communication dédiée aux membres  Analyser la performance du programme (taux d'adhésion, impact sur la fréquence et la valeur d'achat) et proposer des évolutions  Intégrer pleinement Close to You dans la stratégie CRM globale, comme un levier de rétention à part entière et non un outil isolé  Accompagner la migration du programme sur un nouvel outils (S1 2027)    Reporting & ROI (PowerBI, Klavyio)    Mettre en place un reporting mensuel clair et orienté résultats : CA généré, ROI par campagne, évolution des KPI       Profil recherché    4 à 6 ans d'expérience en CRM / lifecycle marketing / retention, idéalement en environnement DTC e-commerce (mode, beauté, lingerie ou lifestyle premium appréciés)  Maîtrise de Klaviyo (ou équivalent) et bonne aisance avec Shopify  Capacité à lire et exploiter des données Power BI sans dépendre systématiquement d'un·e analyste  Track record démontrable d'actions CRM rentables — CA attribué, taux de conversion, LTV

title: Customer Success Manager - Marché France & Espagne (H/F)
description: Flynt aide les restaurants à piloter leur performance sur les plateformes de livraison (Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat). Nous analysons en continu leurs ventes, leurs promotions et leurs annonces sponsorisées pour leur recommander précisément les bonnes actions, puis mesurer leur impact sur leur rentabilité.  Plus de 2 000 restaurants nous font déjà confiance. Nous construisons le Customer Success de demain : piloté par la donnée, outillé par l’IA et centré sur les décisions qui ont un vrai impact pour nos clients. En rejoignant l’équipe Customer Success, tu occuperas un rôle hybride entre accompagnement client, analyse de la performance et développement commercial, avec un impact direct sur la réussite de nos clients.  Ton périmètre  Selon ton profil, tu piloteras un portefeuille de comptes 100 % France, ou un portefeuille mixte France / Espagne si tu es à l’aise pour travailler au quotidien en espagnol.  Ta mission  Faire de chaque client un restaurateur qui pilote vraiment sa rentabilité et sa visibilité sur les plateformes, en t’appuyant sur la donnée et sur nos outils IA pour aller plus vite et plus loin. Ta mission s’articule autour de 4 axes :   1. Formation & accompagnement     Être l’expert du revenue management pour tes clients et faire en sorte que l’outil Flynt n’ait plus aucun secret pour eux.    T’assurer qu’ils maîtrisent l’ensemble des fonctionnalités, en particulier celles essentielles à une utilisation optimale, et que leur paramétrage soit adapté à leurs spécificités.    Construire avec eux une stratégie de rentabilité et leur proposer des scénarios concrets.       2. Pilotage de la performance & data     Analyser régulièrement les performances de tes clients (ventes, promotions, annonces sponsorisées…) pour suivre l’atteinte des objectifs définis ensemble.    Mesurer et présenter le ROI généré par Flynt lors de points de suivi et des bilans stratégiques avec les dirigeants.    Transformer tes analyses en recommandations stratégiques claires et actionnables.       3. Accélération     Utiliser ta fibre commerciale pour proposer de nouveaux produits Flynt à tes clients et leur apporter toujours plus de valeur : détection de nouveaux besoins, démos de nouvelles fonctionnalités, passage à un engagement annuel.       4. Rétention     Fidéliser tes clients et mettre en place des actions pour limiter le désabonnement : suivi des indicateurs de santé client, collaboration avec les équipes techniques pour améliorer le produit, actions de partenariat.      Ta façon de travailler  Chez Flynt, l’IA fait partie du quotidien. Préparation de rendez-vous, analyse de portefeuille, rédaction de recommandations, suivi asynchrone de tes clients : tu t’appuies sur Claude, connecté à nos outils, pour consacrer ton temps à ce qui compte vraiment, c’est-à-dire les décisions stratégiques avec tes clients.   Outils :  Claude, Salesforce, Intercom, Aircall, Modjo, Slack, Notion   Notre offre     Date de début : flexible !    CDI à temps plein

title: Growth Manager - Food Events & Growth

Arbeta nära marknad, försäljning och övriga affärsfunktioner.  Följa upp KPI:er och rapportera resultat till relevanta intressenter.     Vi söker dig som     Har erfarenhet inom growth, digital marknadsföring, CRM eller liknande områden.  Är datadriven och van att fatta beslut baserat på analys och insikter.  Har god förståelse för digitala kanaler och kundresor.  Är självgående, resultatorienterad och affärsmässig.  Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska.     Vi erbjuder   En central roll med stort eget ansvar, möjlighet att påverka verksamhetens tillväxt och arbete i en innovativ och utvecklande miljö. Om Conpassio - där erfarenhet möter passion och resultat.   Conpassio har över fyra decennier av gemensam erfarenhet inom search/rekrytering av ledare och specialister samt tillsättning av Interimskonsulter. description: Thon videreutvikler nå lojalitetsprogrammet Thon+ til en felles kunde- og lojalitetsplattform for hele konsernet. description: Christchurch based – with seasonal time as Scott Base  Ownership of asset management and maintenance  Be part of a legacy project in an iconic NZ institution    About the role   Antarctica New Zealand supports world-class science and environmental protection in Antarctica and the Southern Ocean. Public or private sector experience is equally relevant, but the expectation is the same; high delivery levels, proven team interaction and challenging the status quo.      Essential experience:    A relevant engineering degree, advanced trade qualification, or demonstrably equivalent senior operational experience  Significant experience leading operational engineering and maintenance teams, ideally in a remote, critical infrastructure or utilities environment  Proven delivery of capital works, renewals and maintenance programmes, including financial control

title: Enhetschef Kund elnät
description: Du söker nya utmaningar och ett meningsfullt arbete som gör skillnad för människor och samhället. Vi letar efter såna som du, som är fulla av engagemang, nyfikenhet och energi. För att leva och bo behöver vi en infrastruktur, förutsättningar för ett fungerande samhälle. Vi är det kommunalägda bolaget som förser Lidköpings kommun med det som kan kallas den osynliga infrastrukturen. Det handlar om vatten och avlopp, bredband och elnät men också om avfallshantering. Elnätet drivs i dotterbolaget Lidköping elnät AB. Våra 120 medarbetare har hög kompetens inom allt från teknik, drift och säkerhet till ekonomi och miljö.      Vårt uppdrag har en betydande roll i kommunens arbete med att forma ett hållbart samhälle och att erbjuda god service till medborgarna. Vi hoppas att du vill vara med på resan att forma just det samhället och att erbjuda den servicen till våra kunder i Lidköping – varmt välkommen med din ansökan till Lidköping miljö och teknik!      Ett ledaruppdrag nära kund och verksamhet   Som Kundchef Elnät får du en central roll i en samhällsviktig verksamhet där kundupplevelse, effektiva processer och regelefterlevnad går hand i hand. Du leder cirka 10 medarbetare inom kundservice, debitering, inköp och lager och ansvarar för kundresan från första kontakt till fakturering.      En viktig del av uppdraget är att utveckla arbetssätt och processer för ökad kvalitet och effektivitet. Du rapporterar till Affärsområdeschef Elnät och ingår i ledningsgruppen tillsammans med cheferna för Drift samt Projekt.       Rollen som Enhetschef Kund elnät   I rollen kommer du bland annat att:   Leda och utveckla ditt team mot ökad effektivitet och kvalitet  Säkerställa regelefterlevnad inom debiteringsprocesser och kundhantering  Ta fram förslag på elnätsavgifter för beslut av styrelsen tillsammans med Affärsområdeschef  Driva införandet av effekttaxa – en ny taxa som börjar gälla 2027  Delta i ledningsgruppen och bidra till elnätsverksamhetens strategiska inriktning och utveckling  Utveckla och dokumentera processer för bättre transparens och kvalitet  Deltaga utveckling av kund- och debiteringssystem för framtida behov och samarbeten  Säkerställa leverans till Billingen Energi  Utvärdera och utveckla samarbetsfördelarna med Billinge Energi       Vem är du?   Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av kundnära verksamhet, processutveckling, förändringsarbete och av att leda andra. Du kan idag vara chef, teamledare, arbetsledare eller motsvarande roll där du har ett tydligt ansvar för att samordna och utveckla ett team. Vi ser gärna att du har haft personalansvar i någon tidigare roll.      Erfarenhet från elnäts- eller energibranschen är meriterande, men inte ett krav. Viktigare är att du har förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i lagar, regler och marknadsvillkor och omsätta dem i tydliga processer och arbetssätt.     Du har en för området relevant eftergymnasial utbildning, alternativt motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet som vi bedömer som likvärdig.

title: Customer Success
description: Om Optiplan   Vi är ett produktbolag som utvecklar SaaS-lösningar för samhällsutveckling inom områden som skolskjuts, skolplacering och turbundna resor. Vår vision är medborgarnytta, effektivitet och förenkling i skolans vardag. Med smarta algoritmer och produktinnovationer strävar vi efter att skapa rättssäkra och effektiva flöden som sparar tid och resurser för kommuner. Vår ambition är att kombinera affärsnytta med samhällsnytta i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö där alla medarbetare bidrar till både teknisk innovation och samhällsutveckling. Vi erbjuder även konsulttjänster inom verksamhetsutveckling och optimering.  Vi är sedan 2025 en del av Nordtech Group och befinner oss i en fas av stark tillväxt och produktutveckling.  Nu vill vi stärka vårt Customer Success-team med en kollega som vill bidra till att våra kunder får ut mesta möjliga av våra produkter, och som därmed gör nytta för samhället.   Din roll hos oss   Som Customer Success har du en central roll i att våra kunder får en trygg implementering och en god användarupplevelse av våra produkter över tid. Du följer kunden genom hela resan, från implementation till utbildning och support. Du bevakar hur kunderna använder produkten och hittar möjligheter till förbättring, i nära samarbete med produktutveckling och affärsutveckling.  Du blir en del av teamet för Optiplan Elevresor, som optimerar skolskjutsen från elevens lagstadgade rätt till den faktiska resan: lägre kostnader för kommunen, tryggare resor för barnen och färre körda kilometer.   Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:      Genomföra implementeringsprojekt hos nya kunder: uppsättning, utbildning och användarstöd   Ge support och utbildning till befintliga kunder   Driva dialogen mellan kund och utvecklingsteam vid avtalad systemutveckling   Projektleda konsultuppdrag   Ta fram artiklar och utbildningsmaterial till vårt Hjälpcenter   Delta på användarträffar och testa ny funktionalitet inför release     Din profil   Vi söker dig som vill hjälpa kunder att lyckas genom att lyssna in vad de faktiskt behöver. Du trivs i gränslandet mellan kund, verksamhet och teknik och värnar om samarbetet både inom CS-teamet och tvärfunktionellt med produktutveckling och sälj.  Som person är du nyfiken och vill förstå varför saker fungerar som de gör, inte bara hur. Struktur är viktigt för dig, och du behåller överblicken även när flera kundprojekt pågår samtidigt. Du tycker om att lära dig nytt och delar gärna med dig av det du kan. Hos oss är det lika naturligt att be om hjälp som att ge den.   Vi tror att du har:      Minst 2 års erfarenhet av kundnära arbete med support, utbildning eller implementering av IT-system – hos en leverantör eller som användare/systemförvaltare, till exempel i en kommun   Erfarenhet av att driva eller delta i kundprojekt   Eftergymnasial utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet   Mycket god datorvana, särskilt i Excel   Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift     Meriterande:      Erfarenhet från kommun eller offentlig

title: Customer Success Specialist (Turku)
description: Haluatko kehittyä asiakaskohtaamisten ja myynnin huippuosaajaksi? Sytytkö tavoitteista ja haluat kehittää osaamistasi jatkuvasti eteenpäin? Motivoiko sinua työ, jossa onnistumisesi näkyvät suoraan sekä asiakkaan arjessa että omassa tuloksessasi?    Etsimme nyt useampaa uutta Customer Success Specialistia Turkuun!   Customer Success Specialistina olet keskeisessä roolissa luomassa sujuvaa ja positiivista asiakaskokemusta. Työskentelet osana uutta tiimiä, jolla on tärkeä tehtävä Elisan asiakaskokemuksen kehittämisessä ja jossa jokaisen panoksella on aidosti merkitystä. Tehtävän keskiössä on asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistaminen sekä niihin sopivien, räätälöityjen ratkaisujen tarjoaminen Elisan palveluiden ja tuotteiden avulla. Tavoitteenasi on auttaa asiakasta saamaan enemmän kuin hän odotti ja tuottaa lisäarvoa sekä asiakkaalle että Elisalle.  Työ on pääasiassa puhelimitse tapahtuvaa asiakastyötä: vastaat asiakkaiden yhteydenottoihin ja kontaktoit asiakkaita myös aktiivisesti myynnillisten ulossoittojen muodossa. Aktiivinen myyntityö on keskeinen osa tehtävääsi, jossa onnistuminen perustuu asiakkaan tarpeiden ymmärtämiseen ja kykyyn viedä tilanne sujuvasti ratkaisuun. Työ on tavoitteellista ja suoriutumista seurataan selkeiden mittareiden kautta, jotka ohjaavat tekemistä ja tekevät onnistumisen näkyväksi.  Tässä tehtävässä jokainen päivä on erilainen tuoden mukanaan mahdollisuuksia uuden oppimiseen ja ongelmanratkaisutaitojesi kehittämiseen. Viihdyt tehtävässä, jos nautit vaihtelevasta tekemisestä, pidät langat käsissäsi vauhdikkaassakin arjessa ja haluat kehittää osaamistasi asiakaspalvelun ja myynnin parissa!   Entä työajat ja palkka?    Etsimme useampaa uutta työkaveria  toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan kokoaikaiseen (37,5 h/vko) työsuhteeseen. Toivomme, että pystyt aloittamaan työt perehdytyksen merkeissä 11.1.2027.   🕙 Työskentelemme vuoroissa ma-pe klo 08:45-18:15 välillä ja odotamme sinulta valmiutta työskennellä näissä vuoroissa.  📍Työskentelypisteesi sijaitsee  Turun   toimistollamme.  Työsuhteen alussa työskentelemme toimistolla sujuvan perehdytyksen varmistamiseksi. Osaamisen karttuessa sinulla on myös mahdollisuus tehdä töitä etänä yhteisiä pelisääntöjä noudattaen. Elisalla on käytössä hybridityön malli, jonka mukaan työskentelemme toimistolla keskimäärin kolmena päivänä viikossa.   💰Tehtävässä varmistat osaltasi asiakaspalvelumme myynnillistä onnistumista, ja me myös palkitsemme sinua onnistumisista ja itsesi ylittämisestä!  Pohjapalkkasi määräytyy ICT-alan TES:n mukaan (2357   €/kk), minkä lisäksi tarjoamme houkuttelevan kannustemallin, jossa ansaintamahdollisuudet ovat aidosti omissa käsissäsi. Lisäansiot vaihtelevat tyypillisesti muutamista sadoista aina useisiin tuhansiin euroihin kuukaudessa!    Mitä toivomme sinulta?   Me uskomme, että asiakaskohtaamisten ammattilaiseksi kasvetaan oppien ja kokemuksen kautta. Emme siis odota sinun olevan valmis ammattilainen – innostus ja motivaatio vievät pitkälle! Arki on ajoittain nopeatempoist

Samtidig driver du en portefølje af tværgående indsatser, hvor medarbejdere fra hele organisationen samarbejder om at løse vores vigtigste opgaver. Vi arbejder ud fra princippet test, lær og skaler det der virker med fokus på effekt og værdi. Rollen indebærer både personaleledelse i egen kompetenceenhed for pt. 19 medarbejdere og sponsoransvar i tværgående projektteams, der driver og udvikler vores sundhedstilbud. description: We’re looking for a  Head of Customer Operations B2C  to join us at Telia Norway.  I’m John Sebastian Schmidt Slørdahl, Head of Consumer, and I’m searching for an experienced and ambitious leader ready to take our B2C customer operations to the next level. Our B2C customer operations consist of around 300 great colleagues across our brands (Telia, OneCall, Mycall) and products (mobile, broadband, TV).  You will lead a large customer-facing organization with a clear ambition: deliver great customer experiences while transforming how we operate and strengthening the commercial value we create in every customer interaction.   What You’ll Do   You will have end-to-end responsibility for B2C Customer Operations, combining strong operational leadership with a significant transformation agenda.    Lead and develop our B2C customer operations, ensuring high-quality customer experiences and efficient operations at scale.  Drive a major transformation of customer operations, simplifying and standardizing how we work while accelerating digitalization, automation and the use of AI.  Strengthen the commercial role of customer operations, increasing value creation through sales, retention, loyalty and a stronger focus on customer lifetime value.  Build a high-performing organization by developing leaders and employees and creating strong engagement, accountability and a culture of continuous improvement.    The role can be based in Oslo or Trondheim, with regular presence across both locations expected.   What Will Help You Thrive In This Role   We are looking for an experienced leader who combines strong operational expertise with the ability to transform, engage and deliver commercial results. You know what excellent customer operations look like, but you are equally motivated by building what comes next.    Significant leadership experience from large-scale customer operations, customer service or other complex service operations, with responsibility for people, customer experience and operational performance.  Proven experience leading leaders and larger organizations, with a strong track record of building engagement, accountability and high-performing teams.  Demonstrated success in leading significant transformation, including changes to operating models, processes, technology and ways of working.  Strong commercial understanding, with experience connecting customer interactions to sales, retention, loyalty and customer lifetime value.  A strong customer orientation, with demonstrated ability to improve customer experience while balancing quality, efficiency and commercial outcomes.  Good understanding of digitalization, automation and AI, and how technology can fundamentally improve customer operations.  Relevant higher education is preferred, for example within business, economics, technology or a related field. Extensive and relevant leadership experience may compensate for formal education.  Fluency in Norwegian and English.     Join us

title: Head of Key Accounts  - On Trade
description: Vil du lede Red Bulls viktigste kundrelasjoner i en av våre raskest voksende kanaler?    Som Head of Key Accounts - On Trade får du ansvar for våre største kunder innen  bar, restaurant, hotell, kantine, vending, event og uteliv  – kanalen som er selve kjernen i Red Bulls merkevare og vekst i Norge. Rollen kombinerer strategi, forhandlinger og kommersiell gjennomføring.  Du blir en del av  On Trade-ledergruppen i Norge , leder to Key Account Managers og har egne strategiske kunder. Du rapporterer til Commercial Director - On Trade og jobber tett med Field Sales, Trade Marketing, Events og kollegaer i Red Bull HQ og Europa.   Alle ansvarsområdene vi gir deg tillit i:    DRIVE KEY ACCOUNT STRATEGY & COMMERCIAL GROWTH   Utvikle og gjennomføre salgsstrategien mot nøkkelkundene Bruke kunde-, salgs- og markedsdata til å sette tydelige prioriteringer og identifisere vekstmuligheter   BUILD WINNING CUSTOMER PARTNERSHIPS   Lede større kunde- og årsforhandlinger Bygge langsiktige partnerskap som skaper verdi for både kunden og Red Bull og driver lønnsom vekst   LEAD & DEVELOP THE KAM TEAM   Lede, coache og utvikle KAM-teamet, med tydelige mål, prioriteringer og fokus på resultater   Din kunnskap og ekspertise som betyr mest i denne rollen:     Har solid erfaring fra Key Account Management, salg eller kommersiell utvikling – gjerne fra FMCG, drikkevarer, HORECA eller tilsvarende bransje  Er trygg i komplekse kunde- og prisforhandlinger  Kombinerer strategi og gjennomføring – fra data til målbare resultater  Bygger sterke relasjoner og har et godt nettverk i bransjen  Vil utvikle mennesker og lykkes gjennom andre  Behersker norsk og engelsk flytende, både muntlig og skriftlig    Red Bull Norway AS er en arbeidsgiver som fremmer mangfold. Vi har sterk tro på at en mangfoldig arbeidsstyrke er en viktig faktor for suksess. Vi gjør ansettelser basert på den enkeltes erfaring og ferdigheter uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell legning, etnisitet og religion.

title: Palvelupäällikkö, Kontulan ja Myllypuron kirjastot
company: Helsingin kaupunki – Helsingfors stad – City of Helsinki
company_normalized: helsingin kaupunki – helsingfors stad – city of helsinki
description: Haemme palvelupäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen alkaen 1.1.2027. Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään eri kirjastoissa, joissa toteutetaan olemassa olevia hankkeita tai suunnitellaan tulevaisuuden palveluja ja toimintatapoja. Ensimmäisen vuoden jälkeen tehtävä jatkuu toisessa aluekirjaston toimipisteessä, jossa on meneillään rakennus-, remontointi- tai muita laajempia kehittämishankkeita.  Palvelupäällikkönä toimit kirjastonjohtajan työparina. Johdat ja kehität toimintaa valmentavan johtamisen keinoin ja rakennat yhdessä henkilöstön kanssa toimintakulttuuria, jossa ihmiset voivat käyttää osaamistaan, ottaa vastuuta ja kehittää työtään.  Toimit kahden tiimin esihenkilönä, sen lisäksi olet alueen johtotiimin jäsen. Tärkeä osa tehtävääsi on vahvistaa yhteisöohjautuvuutta ja luoda edellytyksiä sille, että tiimit löytävät yhdessä toimivia ratkaisuja asiakkaiden ja alueen tarpeisiin.  Etsimme kehittämismyönteisiä ja ihmisläheisiä esihenkilöitä, jotka innostuvat muutoksesta ja näkevät mahdollisuuksia myös keskeneräisyydessä. Arvostamme valmentavaa työotetta, hyvä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä viedä asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin.  Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto.  Valittavalta edellytämme kirjastoalan työkokemusta tai hyvää kirjastopalvelujen ja niiden toimintaympäristön tuntemusta.  Valittavalta edellytämme myös erinomaista suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa, hyvää englannin kielen suullista taitoa tai erinomaista muun kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.  Eduksi luemme aiemman esihenkilökokemuksen sekä kirjasto- ja informaatioalan opinnot.  Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen tehtävän sekä ison työnantajan työsuhde-edut ja kehittymismahdollisuudet.  Kontulan ja Myllypuron kirjastoihin kuuluu Kontulan palvelukeskuksen kirjasto sekä Aapelinkulma, johon on tulossa uusi yhteisö- ja kulttuuritila. Kontulan ostoskeskukseen suunnitellaan myös uutta kulttuuri- ja vapaa-aika toimialan Kontula-taloa, jonne kirjasto siirtyy. Talon on tarkoitus valmistua ensi vuosikymmenen alussa.  Jos sinua innostaa ajatus, että et johda vain olemassa olevaa, vaan olet rakentamassa sitä, mitä kirjasto voisi tulevaisuudessa olla, tämä tehtävä voi olla sinua varten.  Tule mukaan suunnittelemaan tulevaisuuden kirjastoja Helsinkiin!  Tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi Helsingin kaupunki kannustaa anonyymiin rekrytointiin, ja tämä rekrytointi toteutetaan anonyymisti. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin tavoitteena on kohdentaa huomio hakijan ammatilliseen osaamiseen sekä työkokemukseen. Täytä työnhakulomake normaalisti. Huomioi hakemusta kirjoittaessasi, että se noudattaa anonymiteetin periaatteita. Esihenkilö valitsee haastateltavat henkilöt anonyymin yhteenvedon perusteella eikä siinä ole nähtävissä hakijan nimeä, ikää, sukupuolta tai äidinkieltä.  Jätä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta.

title: Head of Account Operations in Amazon PPC Agency
description: Our client, a fast-growing international e-commerce company scaling multiple brands on Amazon, is looking for an experienced  Head of Account Operations  to lead its PPC, Account Management, CSM, and Catalogue Coordination functions. This is a senior leadership role with direct ownership of client retention, account health, team performance, and day-to-day operational delivery.  You'll be the primary client-facing CSM and the single point of operational accountability across the account operations function. You'll make sure the right work is being done by the right people, at the right quality, at the right time - while staying close enough to execution to step in when capacity gaps, escalations, or complex account issues require hands-on support.  This role suits someone who combines strong Amazon expertise with excellent client management, leadership, and operational discipline. You should be comfortable making decisions independently, managing multiple priorities, developing people, and taking ownership of client outcomes without needing constant CEO involvement.   About the Company:   The company specializes in high-performance Amazon account and advertising management, trusted by clients for its precision, insight, and results. With steady organic growth and a small, expert team, this is a strong opportunity to take ownership of a critical leadership function and help build a highly efficient, scalable account operations department.   Key Responsibilities:    Client & Account Leadership     Serve as the primary client-facing CSM, owning client relationships, satisfaction, retention, and long-term account health.  Lead client calls, set agendas, communicate strategy, manage expectations, and resolve escalations.  Translate client goals, requirements, and SLAs into clear priorities for internal teams.  Proactively identify underperforming accounts, relationship risks, scope creep, and resource-heavy accounts.  Identify opportunities to improve client outcomes and support organic account growth.  Maintain strong strategic alignment between client commercial goals and Amazon PPC / Account Management activity.      Strategic Account Management     Set and adapt PPC and Account Management strategy across the portfolio based on Amazon best practices and client objectives.  Regularly review account performance, strategic direction, and key risks.  Ensure PPC and Account Management teams are working toward clear commercial objectives rather than operating in isolation.  Coordinate Catalogue priorities, listing and variation work, and compliance requirements with PPC, AM, and client needs.  Step into complex account situations and provide senior-level strategic guidance when required.      People & Performance Management     Manage, coach, and develop PPC, Account Management, and CSM team members through regular 1:1s, performance discussions, and operational check-ins. Unser Ziel ist es, unserem Publikum täglich Orientierung zu bieten. Das vielfältige Portfolio umfasst neben der «Neuen Zürcher Zeitung» und der «NZZ am Sonntag» zahlreiche weitere Publikationen, Events, Podcasts sowie audiovisuelle Formate.  In einer Schlüsselposition auf Geschäftsleitungsebene übernehmen Sie die kommerzielle und strategische Verantwortung für unser B2C-Wachstum sowie die Maximierung von Kundenwert und -bindung in der Schweiz und in Deutschland. title: Head of Customer Excellence, APAC
description: Who We Are   We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing – and doing it together. We aim to improve the flow of goods, time, and energy – and we know we can’t shape the future by clinging to the past. So, we keep evolving, together.   What We Do   RELEX runs the planning decisions behind 700+ retailers and manufacturers worldwide, deciding, at real scale, what gets forecast, stocked, priced, promoted, and produced across the entire value chain. Few problems combine this much data, this much complexity, and this much real-world weight: get it right and a shelf stays stocked, a factory line doesn’t stall, food doesn’t rot in a warehouse before it’s sold. Get it wrong, and it shows up in actual losses, for some of the largest retail and manufacturing brands in the world.  We’ve grown for 76 consecutive quarters straight, and it’s accelerating: the first half of 2026 was the strongest in the company’s history, with new contract value up 83% year over year. We’re a team of 2,000+ people, headquartered in Helsinki, with offices across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.  In response to our fast growth and market expansion we are looking for Head of Customer Excellence for APAC North to lead an integrated Customer Success and Service Delivery team and be accountable for customer outcomes, service health, retention and growth, and the sustainable economics of the regional portfolio.  You will work where customer strategy, service performance and commercial judgement meet. You will help your teams focus on the right customers and interventions, make clear capacity trade-offs, and coordinate action when a risk is bigger than any single CSM or SDM can resolve.  APAC North brings together significant customer opportunity with diverse markets, cultures, languages, partners and service requirements. You will have the mandate to unite those perspectives, build a stronger regional team and make sure customer growth is backed by reliable service, clear accountability and sustainable ways of working.   What We Need You To Do And Be   Bring your ideas. Challenge ours. Grow with us.        Drive customer outcomes and account health: Own portfolio-level outcomes, health, retention and growth, ensuring customers progress through adoption, value realisation and optimisation, working closely with Customer Success Managers and commercial leaders.   Safeguard service health and continuity: Make sure material service risks are visible, clearly owned and progressed with Service Delivery, Support and technical teams.   Manage service economics: Balance cost-to-serve against customer value, contractual commitments and account complexity, and make delegated commercial decisions within the published contract approval framework, partnering with Sales on pricin

title: Director, Customer Value
description: Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with Customers across every screen.  We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.   The Challenge    We are seeking a Director of Customer Value to act as a strategic partner to senior leadership within Adobe’s most important customers across the Middle East. The role drives measurable business outcomes from Adobe investments, with an emphasis on complex, customer facing enterprises where digital experience, loyalty and personalized engagement are central to growth.  Positioned at the intersection of sales, customer success and delivery, the Customer Value Director takes a long term, outcome led view of the customer journey. The director orchestrates cross functional alignment, establishes value governance, accelerates adoption and communicates business impact. The role is accountable for the value framework and executive narrative, rather than day to day project delivery or commercial ownership. Translate priorities into a joint value roadmap linking prioritized use cases, Adobe capabilities, business owners, dependencies, milestones and measurable success indicators. Tailor value hypotheses to customer economics, such as customer acquisition, loyalty, conversion, digital channel adoption, ancillary revenue and service experience.   Work with the Adobe ecosystem to align engagement plans with strategic account priorities.      Outcome orchestration     Bring together Adobe Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, technical specialists and partners around agreed value milestones and decision points.   Proactively identify risks, misalignment, and barriers to value realization. Coordinate executive escalations when required, ensuring clear ownership, timely engagement from relevant stakeholders, and alignment on resolution plans that protect customer outcomes.   Guide customers through business change considerations, operating model alignment and adoption priorities needed to realize value. title: Head of Saudia Arabia Client Coverage, MD, State Street Investment Management
description: About State Street     Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.  Our promise to maintain an environment where every employee feels valued and is given equal opportunities to meet their full potential regardless of their identity, origin or gender infuses our day-to-day efforts. It’s also part of our commitment to inclusion, development and engagement, and corporate social responsibility. Join us.  At State Street Investment Management, our mission is to invest responsibly to enable economic prosperity and social progress. Our vision is to be the first investment call for every institutional investor and financial intermediary.  In order to achieve SSIM’s Mission and Vision, our Client Coverage Group will drive the sale of a robust mix of innovative solutions to our institutional clients, including active and beta strategies, while delivering a best-in-class service experience within a culture that values diversity, collaboration and learning.    Job Description      Overview of role:   We are looking for an accomplished investment management professional to join our dynamic, diverse SSIM Middle East & Africa (MEA) Client Coverage team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. You will be a key member of the MEA team contributing to our client relationship management, sales and business retention efforts.  You will lead an ambitious and entrepreneurial team of client-facing professionals covering Institutional, Wealth and Intermediary clients in Saudi Arabia, with a primary focus on Sovereign Wealth Funds, Central Banks, Development Funds, Pension Funds, Financial Institutions and Family Offices. Your personal focus will be on Tier 1 clients and prospects. Your product focus will span the full range of existing SSIM capabilities and you will also lead strategic projects and initiatives supporting our business growth and risk excellence efforts in the region.  You will need to collaborate with colleagues in investments, product, research, sales and marketing. The role requires energy, flexibility, curiosity and excellent interpersonal and communication skills.  We want you to develop a deep understanding of the SSIM franchise in the Kingdom and the broader region to anticipate the needs of our clients, manage business at risk and actively contribute to the region’s annual net new revenue targets. This role reports to the Head of Middle East and Africa and is part of the MEA regional leadership team and the SSIM Senior Leadership Team (SLT). title: Client Success Strategist (Mandarin & English Speaking)
description: About the Company   We are partnering with a growing technology company that provides technology solutions for independent restaurants across the US.  Its platform combines AI-powered ordering, delivery enablement, payment solutions, and point-of-sale technology to help restaurant owners simplify daily operations and grow their businesses.      About the Role   We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Client Success Strategist to manage and grow relationships with a portfolio of restaurant clients.  You will act as the main point of contact for assigned clients, helping them get the most value from the company's products and services.  This role goes beyond traditional customer support. You will take ownership of client relationships, drive product adoption, identify potential risks, and work closely with internal teams to improve client satisfaction, retention, and account growth.      Key Responsibilities    Build and maintain strong relationships with a portfolio of restaurant clients.  Take ownership of client accounts and serve as their primary point of contact throughout the post-sales journey.  Coordinate client onboarding and work closely with internal teams to ensure a smooth experience.  Proactively monitor client satisfaction, product adoption, and overall account health.  Understand clients' business goals and challenges, and recommend suitable products and solutions.  Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling based on clients' needs.  Identify potential account risks and ensure issues are properly documented, escalated, and resolved.  Collaborate with Sales, Services, and Product teams to deliver a seamless client experience.  Act as the voice of the client by sharing feedback and recommendations with internal teams.  Develop and share best practices to improve client success processes and service quality.       Requirements    Native or near-native fluency in Mandarin Chinese and professional fluency in English, both spoken and written.  Bachelor's degree or higher.  Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts.  Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.  Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.  High sense of ownership, urgency, and initiative.  Ability to build rapport with clients and communicate effectively with different stakeholders.  Comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment.  Willing to work night shifts on-site in Kuala Lumpur.       Nice to Have    2–3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or similar client-facing roles, preferably in a high-growth B2B environment.  Previous experience in a startup or entrepreneurial environment.  Experience in the restaurant, hospitality, or consumer services industry.  Strong analytical and data-driven approach to decision-making.  Experience driving customer retention, product adoption, or account growth.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager

title: Technical Account Manager, French speaking
description: About Us   Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.   How We Work   At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values   Bold  in how we dream and innovate   Responsive  to feedback, challenges and opportunities   Accountable  for results and best in class outcomes   Visionary  in future focused problem-solving   Exceptional  in execution and impact  The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a strategic customer advisor and business outcome leader who partners with enterprise customers to drive measurable security value and cyber resiliency. This is a senior, consultative role that operates at the intersection of technology and business strategy—engaging at the CISO and executive level while maintaining the technical depth necessary to guide complex Proofpoint deployments.  The TAM serves as a trusted executive consultant, proactively identifying strategic risks, architecting adoption and value realization plans, and coaching customers on aligning Proofpoint capabilities to their broader security and business frameworks. While the role has evolved to lead with strategic advisory, a strong technical and security software foundation remains essential.  Successful candidates will bring executive presence, commercial acumen, and a proven track record of driving customer outcomes at the enterprise level—combined with deep experience in Linux, messaging, and cloud security environments. Above all, they will have a passion for ensuring a top-quality customer experience.   Your Day-to-Day     Strategic & Advisory (~50%)      Drive business outcomes aligned to customer security and organizational goals, ensuring measurable ROI across the Proofpoint investment.   Serve as a strategic risk advisor—proactively identifying and mitigating renewal, adoption, and security posture risks before they impact the customer.   Act as an executive consultant—building trusted relationships at CISO/VP level, delivering strategic insights and forward-looking recommendations.   Architect adoption and value realization plans that ensure customers maximize the full breadth of their Proofpoint deployment.   Coach customers on cyber resiliency strategy—aligning Proofpoint capabilities to their broader security framework and organizational risk tolerance.   Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning sessions, articulating security value in business terms.      Technical & Operational (~50%)      Mainta

description: About Reap   Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.  Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.  Backed by leading investors including Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.   Role Overview   We are looking for a  Senior Product Manager  to own and scale Reap's client activation and onboarding experience as we expand into new markets and unlock new use cases. Client Activation is the company's #1 objective - this role sits at the centre of it.  You will design onboarding that turns regulatory complexity into a competitive advantage: fast, compliant, consistent client activation across geographies, products, and flow types, built on systems that scale and differentiate Reap in the market.  What You'll Do    End-to-end activation funnels - from application through identity verification, KYC/KYB, AML screening, risk assessment, account setup, and first value. Our core motion is B2B, with consumer use cases alongside it.  The verification and AML stack in-product - identity and entity verification (KYC/KYB), document and registry checks, sanctions and PEP screening, risk decisioning, and controls that keep us audit-ready across jurisdictions.  Vendor and orchestration strategy - select, integrate, and get the most out of KYC/KYB providers, identity verification vendors, and workflow engines.  Scalable onboarding architecture - configurable flows, rules, and decisioning that adapt to jurisdiction-specific requirements without bespoke rebuilds, plus the activation playbook that lets Reap enter new markets and launch new use cases faster each time.  Regulatory-by-design product thinking - partner deeply with Compliance and Legal to translate licensing and regulatory obligations into product requirements that don't compromise client experience.  Cross-functional orchestration - partner closely with Engineering day-to-day, and work across Ops, Compliance, and GTM to remove friction, reduce manual review, and improve conversion and time-to-activate.  Metrics and iteration - own activation funnel metrics (conversion, time-to-activation, verification speed, manual review rates, drop-off by stage and market), run experiments, and drive a roadmap grounded in data. title: Operations Manager
location: Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description: JOB PURPOSE    Tau is a behaviour change business within Taylor's Education Group, working with leading enterprises across Southeast Asia. Most corporate learning is built to be delivered. Ours is built to increase the odds that people actually change how they work.     Every journey starts with a sparking experience that makes people want to work differently: inside organisations that excel at it, reflecting with coaches, or practising in realistic simulations. Then come months of practice in their real work, through the Tau app, until the new way holds.     We carry the backing of Taylor's, one of Southeast Asia's most established education groups: in education since 1969, with around 35,000 learners in institutions in 4 countries, including Taylor's University, ranked in the top 1% of universities globally (QS World University Rankings).     The operations team is the engine room of Tau: it keeps the business running day to day, gets programmes delivered to clients, keeps our key accounts and facilitators well managed, and keeps improving how we work as we grow.     Tau is at an experimental stage. We are testing propositions, pricing, channels and delivery models, and we are growing quickly enough that instinct alone will stop being sufficient. As we scale, the processes that quietly keep a business running (vendor and client registration, delivery reporting, claims, facilitator management) cannot be allowed to become the bottleneck.     This role owns that engine room. You make sure Tau's operational backbone works reliably today, and you build the processes and, increasingly, the agentic AI-enabled systems that let it keep working as we grow. This is a hands-on builder's role: you will design processes that do not yet exist in the form we need, and improve the ones that do.     Best suited to someone who likes structure but wants room to experiment within it, enjoys being a thought partner to clients, facilitators and colleagues rather than just a coordinator, and values what good education does for people and organisations. Build, document and maintain the standard operating procedures that keep Tau compliant and audit-ready.  Act as the point of escalation for operational blockers across the business, and resolve them without waiting to be chased.  Coordinate with Group shared services (finance, legal, procurement) where Tau's operational processes meet Group requirements.       2. Own end-to-end delivery    Oversee delivery of programmes from confirmation through to completion, including logistics, materials, reporting and closeout. title: Customer Onboarding Manager
description: L’Onboarding Manager aura pour mission de cadrer, piloter et assurer l’onboarding des clients sur la plateforme Tenacy, afin de les mettre en succès dès les premières étapes de leur utilisation.  Il ou elle devra comprendre les enjeux, objectifs et cas d’usage des clients, traduire ces besoins en un plan d’onboarding clair, puis réaliser les ateliers qui permettront l’adoption effective de la plateforme.  Le rôle comprend également une dimension structurante : l’Onboarding Manager contribuera activement à l’amélioration continue de nos méthodes, outils, contenus pédagogiques et processus d’onboarding, afin de rendre nos projets plus efficaces, prévisibles et scalables.  Dans un contexte de vente grand compte, chaque client a ses propres enjeux, son organisation, son niveau de maturité et ses cas d’usage. L’Onboarding Manager devra donc trouver le bon équilibre entre standardisation de la méthode et adaptation au contexte spécifique de chaque client.    Comprendre les enjeux métier, les objectifs et les cas d’usage des clients afin d’adapter l’onboarding à leurs priorités.    Cadrer les projets d’onboarding : objectifs, étapes, parties prenantes, planning, risques et conditions de succès.    Assurer l’onboarding en réalisant les ateliers qui permettront aux clients de prendre en main de la plateforme et s’assurer qu’ils comprennent comment utiliser Tenacy au service de leurs enjeux.    Construire et améliorer les contenus pédagogiques nécessaires à l’onboarding : supports de formation, guides, trames d’ateliers, parcours types.    Identifier les patterns récurrents dans les projets d’onboarding afin de standardiser ce qui peut l’être.    Adapter la méthode aux contextes grands comptes, en tenant compte de la complexité organisationnelle, du niveau de maturité et des priorités propres à chaque client.    Contribuer à améliorer le discours, l’approche et les pratiques d’onboarding au fil des retours clients et des apprentissages terrain.    Participer à la structuration d’une méthode d’onboarding plus réplicable, mesurable et scalable.  （3）インフラ系プロジェクトマネージャー ・オンプレミスのサーバ・ネットワーク構築やパブリッククラウド(AWS)へのシステム移行など、自治体向けインフラ案件のSI（構築・運用保守）について、プロジェクト管理者として活動する役割です。上記アプリ系と同様に、提案活動から構築・運用保守まで、プロジェクトマネージャーとしてプロジェクトをけん引します。 title: SAP SuccessFactors Application Manager
description: Desde Setesca Group, consultora especializada en talento y tecnología, buscamos un/a SAP SuccessFactors Application Manager para incorporarse a un grupo consolidado del sector servicios, con una estructura organizativa de gran dimensión y un entorno corporativo internacional.  La persona seleccionada será el referente funcional de las soluciones SAP de Recursos Humanos y tendrá un papel clave en la implantación, evolución y gobierno de SAP SuccessFactors, dentro de un proyecto estratégico de transformación digital del área de RRHH.   ¿Cuál será tu misión?    Liderar funcionalmente la implantación y evolución de SAP SuccessFactors.  Actuar como interlocutor principal entre los equipos de RRHH, IT, partners tecnológicos y proveedores.  Gestionar y evolucionar los módulos de Employee Central, Employee Central Payroll y Talent.  Participar en la definición, digitalización y mejora de los procesos relacionados con Prevención de Riesgos Laborales, PRL.  Coordinar integraciones entre SuccessFactors, SAP HCM, SAP ECC o S/4HANA y otras aplicaciones corporativas.  Supervisar migraciones de datos, pruebas funcionales, validaciones y puestas en producción.  Gestionar incidencias, evolutivos, prioridades y niveles de servicio.  Garantizar la calidad, estabilidad y correcta adopción de las soluciones implantadas.  Identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer nuevas funcionalidades para optimizar los procesos de RRHH.    ¿Qué buscamos?    Experiencia gestionando o implantando soluciones SAP SuccessFactors en entornos corporativos.  Conocimientos sólidos de Employee Central y Employee Central Payroll.  Experiencia funcional en módulos de Talent, como Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, Succession & Development, Compensation o Learning.  Experiencia en procesos o soluciones relacionadas con Prevención de Riesgos Laborales, PRL.  Conocimiento de procesos globales de Recursos Humanos.  Experiencia coordinando proveedores, consultoras y equipos multidisciplinares.  Capacidad para traducir las necesidades del negocio en soluciones funcionales y tecnológicas.  Experiencia en integraciones, migraciones de datos, testing y gestión de evolutivos.  Nivel de inglés profesional para trabajar en un entorno internacional.    Se valorará especialmente    Experiencia previa con SAP HCM.  Conocimientos de SAP CPI, SAP BTP o herramientas de integración.  Experiencia en integraciones con SAP ECC o SAP S/4HANA.  Participación en proyectos internacionales o despliegues en diferentes sociedades y países.  Experiencia como Application Manager, HRIS Manager, SuccessFactors Lead o responsable funcional de sistemas de RRHH.    ¿Qué ofrecemos?    Participación en un proyecto estratégico de transformación del área de Recursos Humanos.  Una posición con visibilidad, autonomía e interlocución directa con las áreas de RRHH e IT.  Entorno corporativo internacional.  Proyecto estable y con recorrido de evolución.

title: Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.

We are looking for a Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. You will guide the function towards delivery of a subsystem that meets agreed requirements and can integrate with the wider laser system.

You do not need to be an expert in every amplifier technology. You do need strong engineering judgement, extensive technical leadership experience and enough laser understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and work effectively with domain specialists.

title: Account Executive (AE) | DACH (d/f/m)
description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

title: Senior IoT Engineer (all genders) – Embedded Linux · Python · Yocto
description:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior IoT Engineer (all genders), you join our Devices team and bridge both worlds: you own our Yocto-based Linux software platform and actively build the Python application services running on top of it. Python is your daily driver, but you go down to C/C++, drivers, and the kernel whenever hardware requires it. Neither pure BSP-only engineers nor high-level-only developers will be happy here - this is a true hybrid hands-on role.

Right now, we are building a new generalized Linux based platform for our next-generation hardware, harmonizing the software across all device types and making fleet health visible in real time. You do this in a profitable Munich scale-up with more than 250 people in five European locations: the pace of a fast-growing company and the stability to build things properly.

As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process.

WHAT TO EXPECT

  • Next-Gen OS Image: Design and build our new Yocto-based Linux image for the next hardware generation, and drive the migration of our fleet onto it.

  • Hardware Abstraction: Harmonize the software across scanners, payment terminals and screens into one maintainable codebase.

title: Microwave Design Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersec

title: Stage Marketing Associate - Growth & Events
description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Marketing

Chez Lifen, nous travaillons à mieux faire circuler les données de santé pour faciliter le travail des professionnels et améliorer la coordination des soins. Cela passe aussi par notre capacité à faire connaître nos solutions aux bons interlocuteurs.

Ce stage rejoint l’équipe Marketing pour renforcer ses actions de visibilité, d’acquisition et de génération de demandes pour les équipes commerciales. Le poste couvre aussi une dimension événementielle : webinaires, salons et autres rendez-vous qui permettent de rencontrer nos audiences et de faire avancer les projets marketing.

title: Stagiaire Chargé(e) de projet ERP
description:
Fondé à Paris en 1999, Advancy est un cabinet de conseil en stratégie de premier plan, comptant aujourd'hui plus de 300 consultants répartis dans nos bureaux mondiaux (Paris, New York, Boston, Shanghai, Francfort, Sydney, etc.). title: Growth Associate (Intern) - Ad Monetization
description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games (hypercasual, hybrid, 100% IAP, blockchain) and consumer apps.

Role

We're looking for an Ad Monetization Analyst Intern to support ad revenue optimization and growth strategies across a portfolio of mobile games & apps. Reporting to the Monetization Lead, you will use your analytical mindset, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills to help maximize performance and turn strong products into top-performing titles.

  • Manage and optimize ad monetization and performance marketing strategies across multiple networks and platforms.

  • Analyze key metrics and A/B tests to maximize ad performance, user LTV, and overall ROI.

  • Provide data-driven insights to enhance growth, monetization, and product decisions.

  • Collaborate with product, tech, and data teams on SDK integrations, dashboards, and automation tools.

title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
description:
Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.


About the Role

You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.

The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.

It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
description:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

  • Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

  • Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.

description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About the Role:

Headway is already the largest mental health network for America's leading health plans. Very few marketing leaders get to operate at a scale where their work materially shapes how mental health care works in America. This is that role.

We're looking for a Director of Payer Marketing to build and lead the function that makes Headway the most credible, trusted voice in the room whenever a payer talks about mental health. This is an enterprise B2B product marketing leader at heart — someone who translates narrative to commercial leverage, knows their audience backwards and forwards, and understands how that work builds towards outcomes: deeper relationships, stronger renewals, expanded partnerships, and better terms.

This is a player-coach role for someone who is a builder at heart. You'll set the payer-marketing strategy, build and lead a small, high-caliber team, and work hand-in-hand with our Payer/Commercial, Clinical Strategy, and Provider, Patient & Brand marketing teams.

What you'll own:

  • Set the payer marketing strategy. Define the overarching positioning, narrative, and GTM plan for Headway with health plans. The payer story is never just a payer story; it's the synthesis of everything Headway is doing across the platform.

  • Build the function from zero. This isn't a role where you inherit a playbook — you'll define the operating model, the team structure, the cadences, and the metrics that make payer marketing a true commercial lever. You'll create milestones without being handed a roadmap and build momentum in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.

  • Build the category story everyone wants to be part of.

title: Senior Product Manager - Ad Traffic Quality (all genders)
description:
JustPlay is searching for an experienced Senior Product Manager - Ad Traffic Quality to join our team to take ownership of safeguarding our players and protecting our platform’s integrity by designing, implementing, and optimizing innovative systems to detect and prevent fraud across our loyalty gaming ecosystem.

You’ll combine strategic product ownership with a hands-on, data-driven approach to solve emerging issues while building systems and tools that improve detection precision.

  • Influence product design to incorporate fraud-resilient ad experiences and sustainable monetisation practices, while minimizing friction for legitimate players.

Das baust du mit uns auf

Ein neues digitales Brokerage-Angebot entsteht nicht von allein. Dafür braucht es nicht nur eine starke Plattform, sondern auch Prozesse, Teams und einen Service, die von Anfang an mitwachsen können. Bei GENO Broker entwickeln wir das Wertpapiergeschäft der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe weiter. Als Head of Operations & Customer Experience Center gestaltest du den operativen Aufbau unseres neuen Brokerage-Angebots ZuWachs. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus einem neuen Angebot eine leistungsfähige Organisation wird – mit klaren Strukturen, starken Teams und einem Kundenerlebnis, das überzeugt.

Dein Aufgaben:

  • Du entwickelst die strategische Ausrichtung und das Zielbild von ZuWachs weiter und verantwortest gemeinsam mit den Führungskräften Ziele, Prioritäten, Budgets und Kapazitäten.

  • Du gestaltest den operativen Aufbau von ZuWachs bis zum geplanten Marktstart Mitte 2027 und entwickelst Teams, Strukturen und Kapazitäten für das weitere Wachstum.

  • Du schaffst die Grundlage für eine leistungsfähige Organisation: mit klaren Kennzahlen, wirksamem Reporting, Governance und der Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen.

  • Du steuerst unsere Service-Provider, verantwortest wesentliche Auslagerungen und bereitest strategische Make-or-Buy- Entscheidungen vor.

  • Du treibst Dunkelverarbeitung, Self-Service und KI-gestützte Servicelösungen voran und verantwortest deren Qualität, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Risiken.

title: Lead Engineer, Air
description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE is looking for a Lead Engineer, Air to take hands-on technical ownership of our first Western-facing air product, turning operational lessons from Ukraine into a reliable, manufacturable system that customers can test, deploy and reorder.

Your initial focus will be one product. You’ll bring engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and field teams together around a controlled design and a clear delivery plan, resolving the reliability and integration challenges that stand between today’s product and repeatable production.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a management-only position. You’ll stay close to the hardware, own system-level engineering decisions and ensure that changes are proven through testing and reflected in what we build.

As our air portfolio expands, there is potential to grow into broader technical leadership, including Chief Engineer, Air. Progression will depend on business need and demonstrated performance, rather than a fixed promotion timetable.

title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization
description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.

This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences.
