title: Infrastructure Software Engineering – Platform & Build
description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The Role

As an Infrastructure Platform Engineer you will be a core part of our technical team working alongside the hardware, software and research teams to solve cutting-edge problems in AI hardware, ranging from verification to simulation, alongside the best of the best (DeepMind, Apple, Meta…).

title: Senior Partner Manager (German speaking)
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

title: Health Solution Architect - CDI Paris - Theodo HealthTech
description:
L’histoire de Theodo et son succès

Depuis 2009, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Notre approche : le meilleur de la technologie, au service de la création de valeur, porté par l'approche Lean.

Notre approche unique est fondée sur 3 principes :

  • nous avons développé des expertises reconnues dans les technologies clés de la conception et du développement produit;
  • quelle que soit l’étape du projet, notre priorité à chaque décision est la création de valeur pour nos clients;
  • nous recrutons les meilleurs talents digitaux et cultivons leur ingéniosité grâce à l’approche lean.

En 15 ans, nous sommes devenus un groupe de plus de 700 Theodoers, organisé en entités spécialisées par technologie (Apps, Cloud, Data & AI) et par industrie (Fintech, Govtech, Healthtech, Consumer Products Goods). En 2025, le groupe génère 100M€ de CA.



Tes missions

La santé se digitalise. Les données de vie réelle explosent. Elles facilitent le soin et accélèrent la recherche, notamment via les entrepôts de données de santé.

Ces données sont extrêmement sensibles et réglementées. Nos clients ont donc besoin de notre expertise pour bâtir des applications sur des architectures Cloud conformes à la réglementation HDS. L'arrivée des LLM ajoute un défi : exposer ces données à des agents pour aider les soignants et les patients, sans jamais transiger sur la sécurité.

Dans notre équipe, tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au service du soin et de la recherche. Des projets utiles, pour des produits qui comptent.

Ton rôle : concevoir, convaincre et déployer

Ta mission est avant tout opérationnelle. Tu conçois, tu présentes et tu mets en place des architectures Cloud qui répondent aux besoins fonctionnels, de sécurité et de conformité de nos clients.

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Ton équipe : 
L’équipe recrutement est l’équipe la plus innovante et lean de Theodo. En interne, cette équipe est nommée "Growth Team" car notre conviction est que la croissance de Theodo passe par la capacité à recruter les meilleurs profils tech et biz du marché.
 
Depuis 2025, la Growth Team porte également l’organisation du concours d’entrepreneuriat étudiant Petit Poucet, remporté par les fondateurs de Theodo en 2007. Ce rôle te permet de contribuer à la dynamique entrepreneuriale du groupe tout en développant des compétences transverses.
 
Tes missions :
Un rôle hybride, combinant développement de partenariats, évènementiel

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
Build security platforms, not security processes

We are looking for a Staff Security Engineer to strengthen the security of our products, data and engineering platform.

This is a highly technical and hands-on role. You will work closely with Engineering teams to continuously harden our systems while helping design the next generation of our security architecture.

You will operate across two horizons:

  • Strengthen security today: continuously harden our applications, access controls and data-protection mechanisms against evolving threats.

  • Build the privacy architecture of tomorrow: move beyond traditional perimeter and access-control security by designing systems where sensitive data is cryptographically isolated, minimally exposed, and increasingly usable without being directly revealed.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Toulouse
description:
At Swile, we believe that good products can help reduce friction in daily professional life and boost employee satisfaction. Today, we provide innovative solutions in various areas such as Fintech, Travel, HR, and Employee Benefits to more than 5.5 million users in 85,000 companies in France and Brazil.
 
Your role as a Senior Software Engineer centers around creatively solving problems, ensuring a balance between speed, pragmatism and excellence. It's less about the specific technologies used and more about crafting innovative solutions to business and engineering challenges. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, your mission will be to:
  • Demonstrate proficiency in problem & data analysis 
  • Collaborate with a variety of teams to offer pragmatic solutions to real world problems and implement them end to end
  • Create, design, develop, test, and monitor your code in production autonomously and reliably
  • Work with the Engineering Manager to design solutions and be accountable for their execution
  • Obtain a good understanding of the business to provide relevant solutions to users and clients
  • Be a facilitator and contribute to the information flow to the relevant stakeholders. 
  • Stay up-to-date on new technologies and architectures, demonstrate good judgment in their potential Swile applications
  • Provide positive, constructive and qualitative feedback during code reviews.
  • Mentor and promote tech growth within the team.

title: Android Developer (f/m/d)
description:
ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities.

Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations.

The Role

As our Android Developer, you will join one of our cross-functional domain teams and help shape the future of our digital lottery experiences across platforms.

You will play a key role in evolving our Android app, by implementing cutting-edge features with Jetpack Compose, and creating accessible experience that millions of customers trust.

At the same time, our domain teams take end-to-end ownership of the customer experience across Android, iOS, and web. We believe great developers are curious beyond the boundaries of a single platform. You’ll therefore have the opportunity and willingness to contribute to our Angular/TypeScript based webshop and Swift based iOS app, collaborating closely with engineers across technologies to deliver the best solution for our customers.

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

title: Senior Product Design Engineer
description:
At Rohlik Group, we are building the future of e-grocery for over a million active customers across the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania. We own our entire technology stack — from storefronts and apps to automated fulfillment centers and last-mile logistics.

Within the Customer Experience (CUEX) domain, we own every touchpoint a customer interacts with, from the homepage to checkout and real-time order tracking across web, iOS, and Android. Our five storefronts run on a single product spine with localized content, pricing, and brand layers. We operate as a deliberately tight-knit, high-performing team where a Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, two Product Designers, and a dedicated full-stack engineering team ship fast, iterate constantly, and take full ownership of the end-to-end user journey.

Most interface failures in e-commerce aren’t layout issues — they are communication problems: what is said, in what order, and on which screen. As Senior Product Design Engineer, you will own the end-to-end design of all customer-facing surfaces across five markets. You will also manage our design system, Maia (our AI shopping assistant), and provide the design guidance that powers our automated coding workflows.

Why this role is exciting

  • High-impact Group scope: Design every customer-facing touchpoint across web, iOS, and Android for five international markets, impacting millions of orders.

  • True end-to-end ownership: Lead the complete lifecycle of product design — from initial problem definition and customer research to shipped A/B tests and real-world performance analysis.

  • AI-first execution: Rohlik is an AI-first company

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

title: Lead Tech SRE
description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra Cloud is our fully managed SaaS edition of Kestra. Each customer gets a dedicated Kestra instance on dedicated infrastructure, so the platform is a fleet of isolated stacks rather than one shared cluster. It is in Beta today, running production workloads for early customers, with General Availability planned for 2027. Each instance runs arbitrary user code (scripts, containers, queries against their own systems) through hundreds of plugins, and the fleet grows with every new customer. Provisioning, upgrading, and observing dozens to hundreds of identical stacks without drift is the core problem.

We're looking for a Lead Tech SRE to own Kestra Cloud end to end: the architecture and specs, the delivery, the monitoring, and the continuous improvement of the platform. You decide how the platform should evolve, write it down, split it into work, and ship it with your team.

You would lead a team of three, yourself included. That means you stay hands-on (a large share of your week is Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, and incident work) while setting the technical direction, reviewing designs, and dispatching work to two SREs.

You work closely with the CTO, the platform

title: Software Development Engineer III, Maps API
description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps. Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of.

Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes.

Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps!

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

Die wissen, wie wichtig Energie und Infrastruktur sind und wie groß die Möglichkeiten, mit ihnen Zukunft für alle zu gestalten. Denn wir sind genauso: Ein großes, tatkräftiges Unternehmen, das die Tür weit aufmacht für Menschen, die mit uns gemeinsam aus Ideen echte Veränderungen machen.   Unser Angebot   Wir möchten, dass sich unsere Mitarbeiter*innen sicher fühlen - in jeder Hinsicht. Deshalb legen wir Wert auf beständige Zusammenarbeit, sicher ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, regelmäßige Gesundheitschecks sowie individuelle Einarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung. Finanzielle Extras und Zulagen sorgen für zusätzliche Sicherheit.   Weitere Benefits     30 Tage Urlaub  Finanzielle Extras wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld, Erfolgsbeteiligung, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Energiepreisermäßigung und Kinderzulage  Leasing-Angebote für Mobilgeräte und Fahrräder  Vergünstigtes Deutschland-Ticket  Flexible Arbeitsmodelle wie Teilzeit und Homeoffice  Mehr zu unseren vielfältigen Arbeitgeberleistungen im Überblick     Vielfältige Aufgaben     Als Customer Relationship Manager*in entwickelst du Cross- und Upselling-Maßnahmen, um unsere Bestandskund*innen und Interessent*innen für die Angebote der vernetzten Energiewelt der EnBW zu gewinnen. Dazu gehören Produktkombinationen rund um Commodity (Strom, Gas, Wärme), E-Mobilität sowie unser Heim-Energie-Management System EnBW Mavi.  Du vermarktest unsere Produkte und Services und bringst deine Perspektive frühzeitig in die Entwicklung von Vertriebs- und Vermarktungsstrategien ein – auch mit Blick auf den Einsatz von Predictive Modellen, Automatisierung und KI-basierten Empfehlungen.  Du konzipierst, planst und steuerst performante CRM- und Leadkampagnen, die mithilfe von Datenanalysen, Segmentierungslogiken und KI-gestützter Ansprache zusätzliche Abschlüsse generieren, Kund*innen stärker an die EnBW Energiewelt binden und den Kund*innenwert nachhaltig steigern.  Dabei entwickelst du vertriebliche Use Cases, z.B. für Produktkombinationen aus E-Mobilität, Commodity und EnBW Mavi, bewertest diese anhand fundierter Business Cases und sorgst für eine strukturierte Umsetzung.  Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Kund*innen das passende Angebot zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Touchpoint erhalten und identifizierst gezielt diejenigen Segmente mit der höchsten Abschlusswahrscheinlichkeit.  Du stellst sicher, dass Maßnahmen wirksam sind, indem du kontinuierlich das Kund*innenverhalten, Kampagnenperformance und Conversion-Daten analysierst und daraus konkrete Optimierungen für unsere CRM- und Kampagnenmaßnahmen ableitest.  Du behältst alle relevanten Performance-KPIs (z.B. Leads, Conversion Rates, Abschlüsse, Kund*innenwert) im Blick und treibst aktiv Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Kampagnenerfolg und Vertriebsergebnissen.  Darüber hinaus unterstützt du die Product Lead

Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.

We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

Each change must be formally proposed, assessed, negotiated, and recorded in the contract before it can be executed and paid for.

As Contract Manager, you will own the change lifecycle for your assigned contracts. You will drive Contract Change Notices (CCNs) from initial request to signature, protect the company's position on scope, cost, and schedule, and keep the contract baseline accurate for the program team.

Het Succesteam verzorgt het contact met gasten, huiseigenaren en beheerders over alles rondom een vakantiehuis en een reservering: van vragen vooraf tot ondersteuning tijdens het verblijf en de afhandeling achteraf.     De basis en de goede werksfeer staan. Jouw opdracht is om de afdeling verder te professionaliseren, zodat medewerkers hun werk goed, zelfstandig en met plezier kunnen doen. Je bewaakt zowel de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening als de werkbaarheid voor medewerkers. Processen moeten duidelijk, eenvoudig en menselijk uitvoerbaar blijven, ook wanneer de organisatie groeit.      Over Villa for You      Villa for You is een vernieuwend en ambitieus bedrijf dat gespecialiseerd is in de verhuur van unieke vakantiehuizen in Europa. Persoonlijke aandacht, goede service, kwaliteit en slimme oplossingen vormen de basis van ons werk. We streven naar langdurige relaties met onze gasten, huiseigenaren en medewerkers. Dat doen we met een betrokken team waarin samenwerken en een prettige werksfeer belangrijk zijn.      Wat ga je doen?      In de eerste periode ligt je nadruk op meewerken in alle onderdelen van de afdeling. Je behandelt zelf vragen en dossiers, leert de systemen en werkprocessen kennen en ervaart wat medewerkers dagelijks tegenkomen. Zo leer je ook de mensen en de gedachte achter bestaande keuzes goed kennen. Vanuit die praktijkkennis neem je geleidelijk meer ruimte om als manager de afdeling verder te ontwikkelen.     Ook daarna blijf je actief meewerken bij complexere dossiers en lastige situaties waarin jouw managementkwaliteiten het verschil maken. Je ondersteunt medewerkers, helpt afwegingen maken en neemt waar nodig besluiten. Zo versterk je hun zelfstandigheid en blijf je verbonden met de dagelijkse praktijk.     Samen met de teamleads geef je richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het Succes Team. Met een frisse blik kijk je naar de inrichting van het team en hoe deze het beste aansluit bij de ambities en toekomstige behoefte van de organisatie. Daarbij benut je de specifieke kwaliteiten en expertise van iedere teamlead, zorg je voor heldere verantwoordelijkheden en ondersteun je hen in hun ontwikkeling. Je stimuleert eigenaarschap, zelfstandigheid en onderlinge samenwerking.      Je draait ook mee in avond-, weekend- en nooddiensten, juist tijdens drukke periodes. Bij uitzonderlijke of complexe situaties ben je volgens heldere bereikbaarheidsafspraken beschikbaar voor collega’s die buiten kantooruren vastlopen.     Daarnaast:    Stuur je op data:  je richt bruikbare rapportages in en vertaalt inzichten over kwaliteit, bereikbaarheid, doorlooptijden en werkdruk naar concrete verbeteringen.   Plan je vooruit:  je organiseert samen met de teamleads de bezetting op basis van verwachte drukte, seizoenspatronen en benodigde vaardigheden.   Professionaliseer je onboarding en ontwikkeling:

title: Customer Success Representative
description: About the role:      This role sits at the intersection of sales, customer success and support, within our broader Customer Success and Revenue Operations team. Your focus is helping prospective members confidently join Everlab, supporting them through onboarding and making sure the experience lives up to what we've promised.     You'll be one of the people closest to our members. Every conversation is an opportunity to understand what matters to them, what's holding them back and where we can do better. That makes this more than a calls-and-inbox role: the insights you uncover will help improve our communications, systems and product.     A great product isn't enough if the journey into it is confusing. After a consult, prospective members can be left with unanswered questions, unclear next steps or practical blockers that stop them from joining. Often, a thoughtful conversation and the right follow-through are all it takes to help someone move forward. Your job is to understand those blockers, resolve them and help us stop them happening again.     The goal is to drive conversion and revenue through clarity and trust, never pressure, in a way that reflects our north star: be your healthcare partner for life. Initially the split will be roughly 80% member conversations on the phone or in Google Meet, and 20% detailed revenue operations work. That will evolve with volume and what the team needs most.     This is a full-time hybrid role based in Sydney or Melbourne. Our team works from the office three days per week. Follow up with prospective members after consults to understand what's preventing them from joining and help resolve it. Member support:    Own the member journey between saying yes and becoming fully onboarded, making sure nothing falls through the cracks before their first appointment.  Manage member communications over phone, Google Meet, SMS and email, including the sales and payments inboxes.  Resolve queries end to end, coordinating with Clinical Ops, Support and Sales rather than leaving members to chase answers.  Help with urgent member issues and technical troubleshooting, escalating anything outside your scope while maintaining ownership of the follow-through.       Revenue operations:    Support payment enquiries, failed payments, refunds, plan changes, upgrades, downgrades and program exchanges, following the relevant processes and approval requirements. title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.

Was wir lösen

Die Energiewende ist relevanter denn je: Solaranlagen, Wärmepumpen und Wallboxen werden in Deutschland so schnell gebaut wie noch nie. Aber es gibt eine Bremse, die kaum jemand kennt - Bürokratie.

Was heißt das konkret? Jede einzelne Anlage muss beim Netzbetreiber angemeldet werden, bevor sie laufen darf.
Klingt einfach? Ist es nicht: In Deutschland gibt es über 850 Netzbetreiber - jeder mit eigenen Formularen, eigenen Prozessen, eigener Auslegung der Regeln. Kein Standard.
Für Installationsbetriebe heißt das drei bis vier Stunden pro Anlage, in denen ein Handwerker Formulare ausfüllt statt zu bauen.

Wir lösen das mit Software. Unsere Plattform erzeugt die Unterlagen aus den Daten des Installateurs und reicht sie automatisiert beim richtigen Netzbetreiber ein.
Unter unseren Kunden sind die größten Player der Solar- und Wärmepumpenbranche in Europa.
Und weil dieses Problem den Installationsbetrieben so weh tut, konnten wir im letzten Jahr von null auf über 1 Mio. € Umsatz gewachsen - bootstrapped, profitabel und ohne Investorengeld.

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Join our LCA team as a Working Student (10-20 h/week) and support the work that sits underneath every Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) we produce. You'll gain hands-on experience supporting the day-to-day LCA team, who are responsible for the correct calculation of LCA results in the Emidat App.
At the same time, you'll dive into the building materials industry itself — getting to know manufacturers of cement, steel, windows, construction chemicals, asphalt, electronic building equipment, and many more, and understanding how differently each of them approaches EPDs and LCAs. title: Investor in Residence
description:
About the role

You've built a company, run a team or invested for a few years, and you're between chapters. Maybe you've exited, left a role, or wound something down. You want time to work out what comes next without stepping out of the venture world while you do.

We're offering a seat in our Berlin office for six to nine months. You'll work as part of the investment team on real deals and real portfolio problems, and you'll have room to explore your own next move, whether that's founding again, joining a startup or going deeper into investing.

About PT1

PT1 is an independent early-stage VC with offices in Berlin and London. We invest in companies that electrify energy and buildings, automate construction and industry, and make infrastructure more resilient.

Our portfolio includes Voltfang, ecoworks, PlanRadar, Wunderflats, Terra One, Gendo, Beagle, Climate X and AUAR. We've invested alongside Visionaries, ForwardOne, Daphni, Insight Partners, Google Ventures, Zacua Ventures and Aenu.

How we work

We're a small team, and PT1 feels more like a well-funded startup than a classic fund. Everyone here has shaped the firm, from how we run diligence to which theses we chase to the tools we've built. We run on our own stack for sourcing, diligence and portfolio work, and people who've seen it call it the most advanced VC stack they know.

What you'll do

  • Work on live deals from the first call to IC, and bring an operator's or investor's judgement to them

  • Shape investment theses in the markets you know best

  • Work with portfolio founders on the problems you've already solved: hiring, product, go-to-market, their next round

  • Help build the platform. If you think in systems or write code, there's a lot to push further.

  • Use the time and the network to work out your own next step. If that turns out to be a company we'd back, even better.

title: Visiting Analyst (Technical)
description:
About the role

We're looking for a Visiting Analyst to join our Berlin office for six to nine months.

You're a student or recent graduate with a technical background: engineering, computer science, maths, physics or another science. You want to see what early-stage investing is like from the inside, and you can build things.

That second part matters. A large part of this role is building how PT1 works. We run on our own stack for sourcing, diligence and portfolio work, and people who've seen it call it the most advanced VC stack they know. You'll help us push it further.

About PT1

PT1 is an independent early-stage VC with offices in Berlin and London. We invest in companies that electrify energy and buildings, automate construction and industry, and make infrastructure more resilient.

Our portfolio includes Voltfang, ecoworks, PlanRadar, Wunderflats, Terra One, Gendo, Beagle, Climate X and AUAR. We've invested alongside Visionaries, ForwardOne, Daphni, Insight Partners, Google Ventures, Zacua Ventures and Aenu.

How we work

We're a small team, and PT1 feels more like a well-funded startup than a classic fund. Everyone here has shaped the firm, from how we run diligence to which theses we chase to the tools we've built. That includes people who were only with us for a few months.

The job

  • Improve our platform. Build and extend the tools, data pipelines and AI workflows the team uses every day. You'll own projects, not tickets.

  • Research markets and help develop investment theses. We start from a view on where a market is going, then look for the companies that fit it.

  • Work on live deals with the team: screening, market and competitor research, first models, memo sections.

About you

title: Senior Hardware Engineer - Drone Port (m/f/d)
description:

  • Support Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering and Manufacturing with hardware expertise.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it.

We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact.

Your mission

As our Commercial Lead, you will be responsible for growing Klim's business in the UK. You'll source, win and expand partnerships with a wide variety of food companies operating in the UK, helping them build more profitable, resilient supply chains, and scale Klim’s business in a key strategic market.

You'll build our UK sales pipeline and help grow our presence in the market with a focus on generating leads, scoping consultative programmes, negotiating partnerships and managing key customer relationships.

You'll also play a leading role in identifying market opportunities, customer needs and emerging trends that can inform Klim’s UK strategy, go-to-market engine, marketing, and product roadmap.

This role is based in the UK, and we have a coworking space in London where the team meets to collaborate. Expect mostly UK-based travel, with occasional trips to our Berlin office for company-wide get-togethers.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We're looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our engineering team in London. This is a hybrid role, with a minimum of three days a week in our London office. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to grow quickly, work on real production systems, and learn how a high-growth fintech operates from the inside.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers who will support you through code reviews, pairing and mentorship. We maintain a culture of ownership, and we value engineers who are curious about the business and keen to work with stakeholders to improve processes and the customer experience.

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. You'll work on our agentic learning environment: the loops that turn human corrections and agent outcomes into better knowledge and instructions over time. title: AIT Systems Integration Engineer

Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

title: Senior Compliance Associate - Automation & Systems
description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

 

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Compliance team at Payward plays a critical role in enabling the company to grow responsibly while navigating a rapidly evolving regulatory environment. Our teams work across jurisdictions and product lines to design and maintain scalable compliance frameworks that support Payward’s mission while ensuring regulatory obligations are met.

The Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Scale Team is responsible for ensuring the FIU can scale, across new operating jurisdictions and new products, effectively and efficiently. The team leads AML transaction monitoring and blockchain monitoring to ensure thresholds are appropriately set, tested, and governed while reducing false positives and maintaining strong oversight. In addition, the team focuses on identifying efficiencies in process workflows and implementing automation across the FIU. Scale works closely with external vendor, Compliance, and internal technology teams.

description:

title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

title: Senior Sales Engineer
Product Designer
description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our first Designer on Parallel’s design: the app used every day by hospital coding teams, as well as the brand. You’ll work daily with Product Managers, Engineers and the Ops team.

You’ll work on complex, domain-specific topics, with demanding users.

Your mission

  • Own product improvements end to end, including some product management: understand the need, frame and define the problem, prioritize, design the solution, then follow it through to production. You own the whole chain, from the need to delivery.

Damit wir weiterhin auf Kurs bleiben, brauchen wir eine Person, die gerne Herausforderungen meistert und unsere Mission vorantreibt. In dieser verantwortungsvollen Führungsrolle kannst du richtig anpacken und Voraussetzungen schaffen, damit dein Team unsere Kundinnen und Kunden jeden Tag aufs Neue mit überzeugendem Service begeistert.   So sieht dein Alltag aus     Zum Herzstück: Du verantwortest die organisatorische und personelle Führung eines Teams im Kundenservice.   One Team: Du führst und entwickelst deine Mitarbeitenden klar, reflektiert und mit Coaching-Kompetenz weiter.  Du spielst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Rekrutierung von neuen Mitarbeitenden und unterstützest bei deren Einarbeitung.  Du erkennst gemeinsam mit deinem Team, welche Handlung im jeweiligen Kundenkontakt den grössten Mehrwert schafft. Dabei verbindest du Kundenbedürfnisse, fachliche Expertise und verfügbare Daten, um die jeweils passende Next Best Action abzuleiten und umzusetzen.  Performance Kennzahlen analysierst du täglich und überprüfst die Zielerreichungsgrade. Bei Abweichungen ergreifst du frühzeitig Massnahmen und führst dein Team zum Erfolg.  Du schaust proaktiv über den Tellerrand und übernimmst Zusatzaufgaben oder Projektarbeiten nach Absprache mit dem Regionenleiter.     Das bringst du mit     Das Wichtigste zuerst: Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen und begegnest ihnen offen, wertschätzend und auf Augenhöhe. Deine positive Art ist ansteckend, du motivierst dein Team und entwickelst es gezielt weiter.  Idealerweise bringst du bereits erste Führungserfahrung und eine Weiterbildung in Leadership mit.  Du führst klar, reflektiert und verbindlich und setzt deine Coaching-Kompetenz gezielt ein, um Mitarbeitende in ihrer Entwicklung zu unterstützen.  Deine fundierte Praxiserfahrung in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld helfen dir in dieser Funktion. Konntest du diese Erfahrungen in einem Kundenservice-Center sammeln? Dann ist dies definitiv ein Vorteil.  Du hast den Überblick, siehst strategische Zusammenhänge und kannst das mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen auch challengen.  Du hast eine hohe technische und digitale Affinität, mit der du dein Team für den kompetenten Umgang mit modernen Technologien und KI-Tools stärkst. Erfreue dein Portemonnaie   Benefits wie Bonus, CSS Coins, vergünstigte Krankenkassenprämie und weitere, die schnell einmal ein paar Tausender im Jahr ausmachen. title: Tour Guide & Guest Support Manager
description: About the Role   WalksDevour is a high-end tour operator, delivering best-in-class food tours, special access sightseeing tours, and day trips across Europe and North America. Our team is remote and geographically-dispersed, but connected by a passion for creating core memories for our guests.      Travel is an exciting industry but one of constant disruption. On any given day we're dealing with tour guides calling in sick last minute, site closures at major attractions, or rough waters on the Amalfi Coast. Our Guide & Guest Support Team are at the forefront of resolving these problems. They find replacement guides, work with guests to find alternative tours and times, or with operations to find and communicate alternative itineraries – all so our guests’ experiences are smooth on the surface (no matter how hard we paddle underwater). They also interface directly with guests on standard issues such as, helping them find their meeting points or reunite with their guides when lost.      We're looking for an experienced leader to take ownership of this function. You'll work in a complex system of stakeholders including local operations, sales, marketing and technology. This is a service and operations role, not a sales role: your focus is resolving customer issues quickly, consistently and well.   You will own the Guide & Guest Support Team end to end — people, processes, workforce planning and the Zendesk, Tour Optima and Talkdesk platforms that underpin them. You will turn data into decisions, keep service levels on target, and build a team that customers and colleagues can rely on. Guide & Emergencies Support   •        Work with operations to ensure coverage for guide emergencies via Whatsapp and other communication channels  •        Ensure we are fully up to date with all processes, workflows and documentation to ensure optimal resolution of all issues. title: Customer Service Manager
description: Siamo alla ricerca di un/una  Customer Service Manager  che, riportando al Supply Chain Manager, sia responsabile della gestione e del coordinamento delle attività di Customer Service, garantendo un'efficace gestione degli ordini e un elevato livello di soddisfazione del cliente.  La persona avrà inoltre la responsabilità di coordinare e sviluppare il team Customer Service Representative, lavorando a stretto contatto con le altre funzioni aziendali coinvolte nel processo.     La persona si occuperà di:    Supervisionare e coordinare il team Customer Service Representative , supportandolo nella gestione delle attività quotidiane e occupandoti della formazione e dello sviluppo delle persone.  Collaborare con le diverse funzioni aziendali coinvolte nel processo d'ordine per assicurare la corretta definizione dei capitolati di produzione e la regolare evasione degli ordini.  Collaborare con il  team Sales  per monitorare il flusso degli ordini ed evidenziare eventuali scostamenti rispetto al budget.  Lavorare con la pianificazione nell'analisi del portafoglio ordini, facilitando la risoluzione delle eventuali criticità.  Monitorare le performance  OTIF (On Time In Full)  dei clienti e definirai, in collaborazione con le funzioni coinvolte, eventuali piani di miglioramento.  Collaborare con i  Project Manager  per ottimizzare le tempistiche e assicurare la completezza delle informazioni necessarie alla definizione dei capitolati.  Analizzare i processi più critici all'interno del team Customer Service, identificando opportunità di miglioramento e proponendo soluzioni.      Requisiti   Laurea triennale o magistrale; in alternativa, diploma accompagnato da una consolidata esperienza nel ruolo.   3–5 anni di esperienza  in un ruolo analogo.  Ottima conoscenza della lingua  inglese,  la conoscenza del francese costituisce un plus.  Ottime capacità di  teamworking e people management .  Spiccate capacità organizzative e di gestione delle priorità.  Forte orientamento al  problem solving  e alla ricerca di soluzioni.  Capacità di prendere decisioni in modo pragmatico.  Proattività, precisione e attenzione ai dettagli e ai numeri.

title: Key Account Manager – Energy Division
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.    As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.    About The Job   As Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and strengthening Alfa Laval’s relationship with one of its key strategic energy customers in Norway. Based in the Service Sales team within the Energy Division, you will take a holistic view of the customer relationship and identify opportunities across both Service Sales and Capital Sales.  You will turn customer insight into commercial opportunities by understanding the customer’s business priorities, mapping stakeholders and building trusted relationships at every level, from maintenance and technical teams to senior and executive management. Working closely with Alfa Laval’s Business Units, Capital Sales, Service Sales and Nordic service organization, you will develop and execute a long-term account strategy that supports sustainable growth.   Key Responsibilities     Conduct market and customer analysis to identify business potential, customer priorities and growth opportunities.  Map the customer’s organization, stakeholders and decision-making processes across relevant business areas and locations.  Develop account strategies that define which relationships to build, with whom and for what purpose.  Develop and maintain a two- to four-year Key Account Management plan, including customer segmentation, prioritization and commercial objectives.  Identify opportunities across the full customer lifecycle, including service agreements, maintenance, upgrades, replacements, new equipment and capital projects.  Develop, implement and follow up local sales activities with relevant customer stakeholders and markets to achieve sustainable growth.  Develop a close relationship between Sales and Service Operations to ensure projects are executed according to plan and meet customer expectations.  Plan and coordinate customer engagement to ensure that the right stakeholders are involved at the right time.  Systematically follow up each stage of the KAM sales process to ensure that relevant opportunities are identified and captured.  Proactively coordinate with Alfa Laval Business Units, Capital Sales, Service Sales, service operation and other internal stakeholders to ensure aligned customer and market strategies. title: Key Account Manager
description: About the Role:   Are you a self-driven, analytical and  relationship-oriented  individual who enjoys working with  strong well-known brands ?  Are you looking for a new challenge and want to join a  global family owned   company ?  Ferrero Scandinavia is looking for a  Key Account Manager  to join the  Norwegian Sales Team in   Oslo, or our Nordic HQ in Malmö, Sweden.    Your Main Responsibilities:   As one of our Key Account Managers in Ferrero you will  lead   customer partnerships  and contribute to the  growth of our iconic brands . You will be responsible for executing Ferrero Scandinavia’s  sales strategy , managing key accounts, and ensuring  strong commercial performance  across your portfolio.  You will manage and develop  customer-specific sales strategies ,  negotiate annual agreements , and oversee  forecasting and budget planning . Delivering volume and net sales targets,  optimizing promotional investments , and ensuring  accurate reporting  and  ROI analysis  are key elements of the role. You’ll  collaborate  with Field Sales, Trade Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and Marketing teams to ensure effective execution of activities and maintain Ferrero’s freshness and visibility in stores. You will also  monitor   trade developments  and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and support our category management initiatives .   About You:   To succeed in this role, we believe you hold an academic degree and have  experience from the Norwegian trade in a similar role , ideally within  FMCG . You are  fluent in   Norwegian and English , literacy in other Scandinavian languages is considered a merit. Experience in  Trade Marketing and/or Category Management  is an advantage, as is familiarity with  SAP  .  You bring strong analytical and negotiation skills, a proactive mindset, and a passion for building lasting customer relationships.   Your Application:   This is a continuous recruitment process, where the most relevant candidates will be contacted directly.  You are welcome to submit your application in English as soon as possible,  latest by 20th   of November.   In order to ensure compliance to GDPR we do not accept applications via email.   What We Offer:   Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here.   About Ferrero:   Ferrero is a family-owned company with a truly progressive and global outlook and iconic brands such as Nutella®, Tic Tac®, Ferrero Rocher®, Raffaello®, Kinder Bueno® and Kinder Surprise®. As the love for our brands continues to grow, so too does our global reach. Represented in 55 countries, with products sold in more than 170, the Ferrero Group is loved by generations around the world. The secret to our global success? Nearly 35,000 dedicated employees who celebrate care and quality to craft a business, careers and brands we are proud of. Join us, and you could be one of them. description: Bygg relationer, skapa affärer och driv utveckling. Hos Holmris B8 får du kombinera din passion för affärer, människor och inredning i en roll där du aktivt skapar nya affärsmöjligheter – med en internationell koncern i ryggen.     Holmris B8 Group satsar stort i Sverige och söker en Key Account Manager till Stockholm. Vi söker dig med starkt kommersiellt driv som förstår kundens verksamhet, bygger förtroende och har affären i centrum.      Från lokal expertis till nordisk styrka   Lindelöf har varit en etablerad aktör inom svensk inredning i över 70 år och har bland annat skapat kontorsmiljöer för Vinge, Eidra, EY, Zettle by PayPal och Red Bull. Med en stark lokal Stockholmsförankring och långvariga kundrelationer har bolaget byggt upp en gedigen erfarenhet av att skapa inspirerande och funktionella miljöer för företag och offentlig verksamhet.     Under 2024 blev Lindelöf en del av danska Holmris B8 Group, en av Nordens ledande inredningskoncerner. Året därpå förvärvades även Malmöbaserade Addentity Interiör, och tillsammans med en satsning i Göteborg tar nu en gemensam svensk organisation form under varumärket Holmris B8.     Vi kombinerar lokal expertis, nära kundrelationer och lång erfarenhet med en internationell koncerns resurser, egna designkollektioner, produktion och ett nätverk med över 1 000 leverantörer. Det ger oss möjlighet att tänka större, utveckla samarbeten och skapa hållbara, skräddarsydda inredningslösningar för våra kunder.      Att arbeta på Holmris B8   På Holmris B8 skapar vi rum för människor. För oss handlar inredning om så mycket mer än möbler och design. Det handlar om att förstå människorna som ska vistas i miljöerna vi skapar, hur de arbetar, möts och inspireras – och att tillsammans hitta lösningar som är hållbara och i tiden.     Vi drivs av en genuin passion för design, en nyfikenhet på nya idéer och en entreprenörsanda som funnits med oss i över hundra år. Här möts gedigen branschkunskap och kreativitet, personlig service och innovativa lösningar. Vi värdesätter nära samarbeten, långsiktiga relationer och modet att utmana hur saker alltid har gjorts.  Vi befinner oss i en spännande fas och investerar långsiktigt i Sverige. För dig som vill påverka, utveckla affären och bidra till vår fortsatta tillväxt finns stora möjligheter.      Se vår film!       Om rollen   Som Key Account Manager får du en viktig roll i att utveckla Holmris B8:s affärer. Du bygger upp en egen kundportfölj, utvecklar långsiktiga relationer och skapar nya affärsmöjligheter. Tapaat säännöllisesti asiakkaitamme, huolehdit palveluiden jatkuvuudesta ja varmistat, että paloturvallisuuden hoitaminen on asiakkaalle mahdollisimman vaivatonta. Työpisteesi sijaitsee uudessa modernissa toimistossamme osoitteessa Valokaari 8, 00750 Helsinki, johon muutamme marraskuussa. Työskentelemme hybridimallin mukaisesti vähintään 2–3 päivää viikossa toimistolla. Työ edellyttää aika ajoin liikkumista.   Arvostamme     vähintään muutaman vuoden kokemusta myynnin tehtävistä b-to-b-asiakkaiden parissa  tuloshakuista työotetta ja näyttöjä onnistumisista  asiakaslähtöistä työskentelytapaa  halua kehittyä ja oppia uutta  ongelmanratkaisukykyä  hyviä yhteistyö- ja tiimityötaitoja  sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, ruotsin kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi    Koulutuksesi ei ole ratkaiseva tekijä, vaan asenteesi, innostuneisuutesi sekä aikaisemmat näyttösi onnistumisistasi myynnissä.   Tarjoamme   Tarjoamme merkityksellisen myyntiroolin turvallisuuden parissa, vakaassa ja kasvavassa kansainvälisessä yrityksessä. title: CX Development Manager
description: Every NOBA customer relationship starts with an application. You will make it count.   As  CX Development Manager , you will lead the development of our digital customer journeys across our brands and products. Your main focus is the path from started application to onboarded customer, and your scope also includes other digital customer interfaces, such as logged-in customer pages and apps. You are the front door for change. You drive what gets prioritized, make sure it is built right, and work with experimentation and tracking to prove with data that it worked. Our systematic, data-driven approach has already delivered clear results at Bank Norwegian, and now we are taking it to more brands and products. You will help define how that works in practice, in a regulated environment where every change must be both effective and compliant, and with many stakeholders pulling in different directions. Align with the business: make sure priorities for the digital customer interfaces fit with the commercial product roadmap and goals.  Find and size the opportunities: use data and analytics to see where customers drop off or run into friction, quantify the problem, and build business cases with expected impact. title: Palvelujohtaja

Keskeisiä vastuitasi ovat:      Johdat ja kehität konsultoinnin, asiakaspalvelun ja Oscar Talousosaston muodostamaa noin 55 henkilön organisaatiota yhdessä sen esihenkilöiden kanssa.  Parannat palvelujen kannattavuutta, tuottavuutta ja laatua sekä vahvistat tiedolla johtamista.  Selkeytät tavoitteet, vastuut, mittarit ja johtamisrytmin sekä viet sovitut toimintamallit käytäntöön. title: People & Delivery Lead, Technology & Operations
description: Vil du lede 15 specialister i drift, cloud og sikkerhed for fremtidens landbrug?      SEGES Innovation søger en erfaren IT-leder til Technology & Operations. Du får personaleansvaret for et stærkt og uformelt team, der driver både on-premise og Azure-baserede services for hele SEGES Innovation og vores kunder.     Rollen kombinerer ledelse af mennesker med ansvaret for at levere stabil, sikker og skalerbar drift. Du refererer direkte til Senior Vice President for Digital Delivery & Operations og indgår i et ledelsesteam af People & Delivery Leads på tværs af SEGES Digital. Her er du med til at sætte retningen for hele den digitale afdeling, med et særligt ansvar for den tekniske retning.      Om SEGES Innovation   SEGES Innovation er Danmarks største videns- og innovationshus for landbruget med omkring 500 kolleger. Vi udvikler løsninger til fremtidens bæredygtige landbrugs- og fødevareproduktion og bygger bro mellem forskning og praksis. Her udvikler vi digitale løsninger, der styrker landmændenes produktion, klimaaftryk og konkurrenceevne. Dine opgaver   Du får det samlede ansvar for, at Technology & Operations leverer stabile og sikre services, og for at teamet trives og udvikler sig.    Personaleledelse:  Du leder og udvikler 15 specialister med fokus på trivsel, kompetencer og ejerskab   Drift og cloud:  Du sikrer stabil drift på tværs af on-premise og Azure og driver den videre cloud-transformation   Samarbejde på tværs:  Du bygger bro til de agile value streams, så nye løsninger lander sikkert i stabil drift   Governance og sikkerhed:  Du sætter klare rammer for IT-governance, risikostyring og informationssikkerhed   Økonomi, leverandører og kunder:  Du har ansvaret for budget, cloudomkostninger, licenser og leverandøraftaler og for de IT-services vi leverer til udvalgte kunder   Strategi og roadmap:  Du omsætter forretningens behov til en prioriteret teknisk retning, herunder brugen af AI og automatisering       Din profil   Du er en erfaren leder af tekniske teams

title: Leder til Vedligeholdelsesområde for Jordbaseret Luftforsvar ved Flyvstation Tirstrup
description: Leder til Vedligeholdelsesområde for Jordbaseret Luftforsvar ved Flyvestation Tirstrup   Brænder du for at udvikle komplekse organisationer, skabe motiverede teams og omsætte visioner til handling? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som leder af Vedligeholdelsesområde Vest ved Flyvestation Tirstrup, hvor du får en central rolle i områdets etablering og udvikling.   Om os   Danmarks nye Jordbaserede Luftforsvar er en af Forsvarets helt nye og mest avancerede materielkapaciteter. Kapaciteten, der er placeret på Flyvestation Tirstrup og Flyvestation Skalstrup ved Roskilde, har afgørende betydning for styrkelsen af det danske luftforsvar, Forsvarets generelle kampkraft og Danmarks sikkerhed.  Forsvarets Vedligeholdelsestjeneste kommer til at spille en central rolle i opbygning såvel som i drift og vedligeholdelse af det Jordbaserede Luftforsvar. Dette indebærer blandt andet opbygning af nye værkstedskapaciteter i både øst- og vest Danmark.  Vi er en kvalitetsledelses- og arbejdsmiljøbevidst servicevirksomhed, hvis vigtigste opgave er at sikre, at Forsvarets materiel er pålideligt og altid klar til kamp. Som værnsfælles myndighed har vi højt specialiserede værksteder fordelt i hele Danmark, der servicerer, vedligeholder og modificerer alt fra kampvogne til helikoptere, kanoner og langtrækkende luftforsvarssystemer.  Vi består desuden af en Planlægnings- og Koordinationsdivision med geografisk placering i Brabrand, Aarhus. I alt beskæftiger myndigheden cirka 1700 medarbejdere og udlåner herudover fagligt militært personel til Forsvarets operative enheder og operationer.   Om stillingen   Som leder af Vedligeholdelsesområdet, Jordbaseret Luftforsvar på Flyvestation Tirstrup, får du ansvaret for at:    Forvalte og optimere forsyningskæden og vedligeholdelsen  Sikre rettidig tilgængelighed af varer og materiel  Sikre opgaver udføres i overensstemmelse med områdets mål og gældende krav til effektiv, sikker og kvalitetsmæssig korrekt drift  Sikre effektiv gennemførelse af vedligeholdelsesarbejdet og kvaliteten i leverancerne  Varetage organisatorisk udvikling, strukturelle tilpasninger og transformationer  Sikre motivation, performance og gode resultater i Vedligeholdelsesområdet  Lede og udvikle områdets medarbejdere og deres kompetencer  Sikre overholdelse og optimering af bestemmelser, direktiver, interne politikker og procedurer  Optimere på ressourceanvendelsen og omkostningerne  Understøtte Vedligeholdelsesområdets strategiske og operationelle mål  Tage aktivt ansvar for løsning af incidents/major incidents    Da vi er i en opbygningsfase, vil du indledningsvis være med til at opbygge kapaciteten og kompetencerne for Vedligeholdelsesområde, så vi møder de operative- og planlægningsmæssige milepæle. I denne fase vil du således skulle bidrage aktivt og med initiativ til etableringen i samarbejde med det Jordbaserede Luftforsvars ledelse.   Om dig   Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant teknisk baggrund og erfaring. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfarin

title: Customer Success Lead
description: 포지션 소개 (About the Role)  한국 시장의 Enterprise 고객을 대상으로 Customer Success를 총괄할 Customer Success Lead를 찾고 있습니다.  본 포지션은 단순한 고객 관리나 사후 지원을 넘어, 고객의 비즈니스 목표와 데이터 환경, 기술 아키텍처를 이해하고 Pre-Sales부터 POC, Implementation, Adoption, Renewal 및 Expansion까지 고객 라이프사이클 전반을 관리하는 역할입니다.  고객사의 Manager, Director, CTO 등 주요 의사결정권자와 긴밀하게 협업하고, 내부 기술·제품·영업 조직과 협력하여 고객 맞춤형 솔루션을 제안하고 성공적인 프로젝트 수행을 이끌어야 합니다.  또한 한국 시장의 Customer Success 조직을 관리하고 업무 프로세스를 구축·개선하는 역할도 담당합니다.     주요 업무 (Key Responsibilities)  1. Enterprise Customer Success   한국 내 Enterprise 고객 관계 및 Customer Success 총괄  고객의 비즈니스 목표와 데이터 활용 니즈 파악  주요 의사결정권자와 장기적인 파트너십 구축  고객사의 제품 Adoption 향상 및 Business Review 진행  Renewal, Expansion, Upsell 기회 발굴   2. Solution Consulting & Pre-Sales   고객 대상 제품 Demo 및 Technical Workshop 진행  고객의 비즈니스 요구사항 분석 및 맞춤형 솔루션 제안  SDK, API, Data Architecture 등 기술적 논의 지원  POC 설계 및 실행, 결과 보고  고객 요구사항을 내부 제품·기술팀과 협의하여 실행 가능한 계획으로 구체화   3. Project Management & Technical Support   POC 및 Implementation 프로젝트 전반 관리  프로젝트 일정, 주요 마일스톤 및 리스크 관리  고객사와 내부 기술·제품·영업팀 간 협업 조율  기술적 이슈 분석 및 해결 과정 주도  고객에게 기술적 문제와 해결 방안을 명확하게 설명   4. Business & Data Consulting   고객의 비즈니스 과제와 데이터 활용 목적 분석  데이터 분석을 통한 고객 Retention 및 Marketing Performance 개선  LiveOps, A/B Testing, Conversion 등 비즈니스 성과 향상 지원  Data / AI 솔루션을 통한 고객의 비즈니스 가치 및 ROI 창출   5. Team Leadership   Customer Success / Solution / Analyst 팀 관리 및 육성  고객 및 프로젝트 배분, 업무 프로세스 구축  Enterprise 고객 관리 Best Practice 수립  팀 목표 및 고객 만족도 관리      자격 요건 (Requirements)   관련 분야 경력 5~10년 이상  B2B Enterprise 고객 관리 및 Customer Success 경험  팀 관리 및 리더십 경험  Manager, Director, CTO 등 주요 의사결정권자와의 커뮤니케이션 역량  Event Data, User Data, BI, Data Analytics에 대한 이해  비즈니스 요구사항 및 ROI 분석 역량  POC 및 Implementation 프로젝트 관리 경험  뛰어난 프로젝트 추진력 및 유관 부서 협업 능력  한국어 Native 또는 Fluent 수준  중국어 비즈니스 커뮤니케이션 가능자  높은 책임감(Ownership)과 문제 해결 능력

title: [flex] Account Management Lead
description: 플렉스팀의 Account Management Lead는 Account Management 팀을 이끌며, 고객 유지와 확장 성장 전반을 책임지는 리더입니다.      AM팀은 성격이 다른 두 고객 테리토리를 담당합니다.        하나는 Mid-Market 이상 규모의 Key Account로, 제품을 중심으로 복잡한 이해관계자 구조 속에서 데이터 기반으로 고객 여정을 설계하고 갱신·확장을 리딩해야 하는 고객군입니다.     다른 하나는 조직 규모는 SMB지만 HR Partners/Payroll Partners 등 People Service가 결합되어 대표·C-level과 직접 소통하며 복합 서비스 계약을 비즈니스 관점에서 조율해야 하는 고객군입니다.       AM Lead는 규모와 계약 구조, 요구 역량이 전혀 다른 이 두 테리토리를 깊이 이해하고, 하나의 팀 전략과 일관된 운영 체계로 통합해내는 역할입니다. 단순한 팀 관리를 넘어, 리텐션·확장 매출 목표에 대한 최종 오너십을 갖고 플레이북과 지표 체계를 설계하며, 팀원 개개인이 각자의 테리토리에서 성과를 낼 수 있도록 코칭하며 전략과 실행을 오가는 플레잉 리드로서 주요 고객을 직접 다루는 역할도 함께 수행합니다.         이런 일을 함께 하게 됩니다.      팀 리딩 & 전략     AM 팀의 리텐션, 업셀/크로스셀, 리뉴얼 목표를 설계하고 달성을 책임집니다.    Key Account와 Partners 테리토리 각각의 특성에 맞는 KPI·헬스스코어·운영 지표 체계를 설계하고, NRR 관점에서 팀 성과를 통합 관리합니다.    고객 세그먼트별 플레이북(갱신, 이탈 방어, 업셀/크로스셀 제안)을 표준화하고 지속적으로 고도화합니다.    팀원별 테리토리·어카운트 배분, 목표 설정, 1on1 코칭, 채용을 통해 팀의 성장을 이끕니다.        고객 & 매출 오너십     전사적으로 중요한 Key Account 및 전략 고객을 직접 담당하거나, 주요 갱신·확장 협상에 에스컬레이션 파트너로 참여합니다.    이탈 리스크 시그널을 팀 차원에서 조기에 식별하는 체계를 만들고, 대응 전략의 실행을 리딩합니다.    복잡한 계약 구조(제품 + People Service 조합, 가격 정책, 리뉴얼 조건)에 대한 협상 기준과 가이드를 수립합니다.        크로스펑셔널 협업     Implementation Team에서 온보딩을 마친 고객을 AM 팀이 안정적으로 인계받는 핸드오프 체계를 정비하고 운영합니다.    Product, CXM, Partners Service(HR/Payroll), Sales 등 유관 조직과의 협업 구조를 설계하고, 고객 인사이트가 제품·서비스 개선으로 이어지는 루프를 만듭니다.    고객 데이터(MRR, 사용률, 헬스스코어, 계약 구조)를 기반으로 경영진에 리텐션·확장 현황과 전략을 보고합니다.          이런 분과 함께 하고 싶습니다.       B2B SaaS 또는 IT 서비스 업계에서 풍부한 Account Management / Customer Success / Sales 경험을 갖고 계신 분     리텐션·NRR·확장 매출 등 정량 목표에 대한 최종 오너십을 갖고 팀 단위 성과를 만들어본 분    서로 다른 고객 테리토리(Mid-Market 이상, SMB)를 동시에 운영하거나, 테리토리 설계·배분을 직접 해본 경험이 있는 분    헬스스코어, 이탈 지표 등 데이터 기반으로 고객 운영 체계를 만들고, 플레이북으로 팀에 정착시켜본 분    대표·C-level 등 최고 의사결정자와의 협상과, 실무~의사결정자에 걸친 복잡한 이해관계자 관리 모두에 능숙한 분    플레잉 리드로서 직접 고객을 다루는 것과 팀을 통해 성과를 내는 것 사이의 균형을 잡을 수 있는 분    제품, 서비스 운영, 고객지원 등 유관 조직과 협업 구조를 설계하고 조율해본 분          이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋겠습니다.       HR SaaS 또는 HR/Payroll 도메인에 대한 이해가 있는 분    제품과 운영 서비스(BPO, 컨설팅, 매니지드 서비스)가 결합된 비즈니스 모델을 경험해본 분    체계가 잡힌 조직에서 AM/CS 팀을 운영해본 경험이 있고, 검증된 운영 체계(목표 관리, 코칭, 평가 등)를 성장 단계의 조직에 맞게 이식할 수 있는 분    복잡한 계약 구조(멀티 프로덕트, 서비스 조합, 갱신 조건)의 협상을 직접 리딩해본 분    Salesforce, Pipedrive 등 CRM 기반의 세일즈/CS 운영 체계를 구축해본 분          합류 여정을 안내드립니다       서류 전형 >  Pre-Interview(화상)> Job Interview > Peer Interview > Fit Interview > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 순서로 진행됩니다.

title: Industry Engagement Manager
company: HITO - Hairdressing, Barbering and Beauty Therapy Apprenticeships
company_normalized: hito - hairdressing, barbering and beauty therapy apprenticeships
description: HITO is New Zealand’s largest industry training organisation for hairdressing, barbering and beauty. HITO apprentices learn on the job, in salons, barbershops and clinics, the length of the country, and our Sales and Training Advisors are the people who make that happen —Build relationships with employers, meet sales targets, set training plans, and support apprentices through their qualification journey.      About the role    You will lead our Sales and Training Advisors (STAs) to foster a collaborative and high performing team environment, providing operational guidance to support and enhance professional growth and team efficiency. Working with individual STAs to increase learner enrolments through business development, the go to person for industry support and guidance, drives the team to meet KPIs and sales targets and is a point of escalation for internal and external matters as the arise. Strong stakeholder engagement and experience in these industries is key to drive the organisation forward.       Key responsibilities    Support STA business development by working with individual STAs and their regions to identify ways to increase learner enrolments and work with Marketing on collateral and communications as required  Monitor regional and national KPIs including new enrolments, learner retention, completion rates.  Collaborate with other department managers to resolve operational issues and improve service  Lead and coach and mentor STAs on sales skills, pastoral care, and account management  Work directly with Corporate Services staff, such as Finance, Marketing and Industry Support to address concerns from industry stakeholders.  Provide back-up for Advisors on leave to ensure stakeholders are provided with timely actions and services  Provide account management for HITO key employers and growth accounts as required  Represent HITO at national events such as Graduation, Awards ceremonies and conventions as required.       About you    Experience in sales and business development, preferably in an education environment  Ability to develop strong and lasting relationships efficiently and effectively internally and externally  Knowledge and understanding of work-based training or tertiary education, desirable  Knowledge and understanding of employers in hairdressing, beauty therapy or barbering industries  Experience managing people, and a genuine appetite for developing a team  Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills  A track record of managing KPIs and targets  Excellent relationship management and team skills      Whilst this position is advertised as Wellington based, we are open to this position being located outside of the Wellington region for the right candidate with travel into the Wellington Office when needed.     This is a full-time, fixed term position for 12 months, with a possibility of becoming permanent.
