title: Ekonom med intresse för system och kundrelationer
description: Vi tror på ett samhälle format av framgångsrika företag där entreprenörskap och samhällsnytta går hand i hand. Att vara en del av Fortnox är att vara en del av en ständig förändring - en förändring där du själv bestämmer hur långt du vill nå. Vårt största fokus är att ge dig rätt förutsättningar att få leva din passion tillsammans med oss. Var du kommer ifrån är inte relevant - det är vart du är på väg som är intressant för oss. Precis som vi igår inte kunde drömma om det Fortnox som finns idag, så kan du vara med och forma vilka vi är imorgon.     Om tjänsten   Som Professional Services Specialist hos oss är du en  nyckelperson för våra kunder.  Din huvudsakliga uppgift är att säkerställa en framgångsrik onboarding och hjälpa kunderna att få ut maximalt värde av våra produkter. Du kommer bli specialist inom en rad områden som exempelvis koncernkonsolidering, rapportering och finansiell analys. Du kommer få tillfälle att arbeta med många bolag och koncerner inom olika branscher och storlekar med varierande komplexitet. Målet är att du, genom din expertis, hjälper dem att ta fram ett bra underlag för deras beslut och analyser.  Dina dagar kommer att vara fyllda med kundmöten, främst online, där du onboardar och stöttar våra kunder i våra produkter. Du kommer även:    Hålla i utbildningsforum för större byråer med många konsulter.  Agera expertstöd till säljorganisationen vid workshops och demonstrationer.  Samarbeta tätt med våra produktchefer och utvecklare genom att testa nya funktioner och rapportera eventuella buggar.  Vara en viktig länk mellan kunden och vår interna organisation.      Om dig   Vi tror att du har en stark grund inom ekonomi, antingen via utbildning eller tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet.  Du trivs i en konsultativ roll  där du får kombinera din ekonomiska expertis med ett stort intresse för kundvård och teknik. Du är lugn, pedagogisk och har en förmåga att anpassa dig efter olika kunders behov. För att lyckas ser vi gärna att du har:    En utbildning inom ekonomi eller motsvarande.  Minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet från en roll som exempelvis controller, redovisningsassistent, ekonom, ekonomiassistent eller liknande.  Ett stort intresse för att bygga relationer och förstå kundens behov.  En teknisk nyfikenhet och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya system.      Fortnox - mitt i företagslivet    Fortnox hjälper företag att starta, växa och utvecklas. Med smarta tekniska lösningar för företag och redovisningsbyråer, smidig finansiering och ett ekosystem av starka partnerskap är Fortnox ett nav för företagande i Sverige. Vi drivs av visionen om ett välmående samhälle format av framgångsrika företag.     Fortnox grundades 2001 med huvudkontor i Växjö. Läs mer på www.fortnoxgroup.com.    Välkommen med din ansökan!    Behandling av personuppgifter   Vi på Fortnox värnar om din personliga integritet. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss kommer vi att behandla dina personuppgifter för att administrera rekryteringsprocessen. Perso

title: QA and Security Manager
location: Odense Kommune, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Er du stærk i softwaretest og sikkerhed og klar til at tage ansvar for kvaliteten og for et mindre team?     Hos MAKIN søger vi en QA and security Manager, der vil stå i spidsen for vores testteam og selv være med i det daglige testarbejde. Du får ansvaret for hele testområdet og for kvalitetssikringen af vores Android-applikation MAKIN3D, som bruges til maskinstyring i bygge- og anlægsbranchen.     Derudover skal du drive det daglige arbejde med vores informationssikkerhed i samarbejde med vores CTO, herunder arbejdet med relevante certificeringer, sikkerhedspolitikker og dokumentation. Det er en praktisk lederrolle, hvor du også kommer til at løfte din del af det udførende testarbejde. Du trives med selv at teste, undersøge fejl og følge op på rettelser. Du tager fat, når der er brug for det, og bruger din testerfaring aktivt i sparringen med teamet.     Du får personaleansvar for foreløbig to medarbejdere i QA teamet. Du støtter deres udvikling og trivsel, prioriterer opgaverne og skaber gode rammer for samarbejdet. Du refererer til Engineering Manager for Application Development.     Derudover får du ansvar for udvalgte opgaver inden for IT-sikkerhed i udviklingsafdelingen. I direkte samarbejde med CTO er du med til at styrke sikkerheden i afdelingens arbejdsgange og følge op på aftalte forbedringer.      Dine opgaver    Deltage i test af nye funktioner og regressionstest samt dokumentere og følge op på fejl.  Tage ejerskab for teststrategi, testplanlægning og den løbende forbedring of vores kvalitetssikring  Sikre et godt samspil mellem manuel, automatiseret og scriptbaseret test.  Skabe overblik over testresultater og kvalitetsrisici i forbindelse med releases.  Lede og udvikle testteamet og samarbejde tæt med udviklerne om at forebygge fejl.  Varetage opgaver inden for informationssikkerhed i udviklingsafdelingen.       Din baggrund   Du har solid og bred erfaring med softwaretest og ved, hvordan man både opbygger og udfører en testindsats, der fungerer i praksis. Du har også prøvet at være leder med personaleansvar. Det behøver ikke være gennem mange år, men du skal have lyst til at udvikle dig som leder og tage ansvar for andre.     Erfaring med maskinstyringssystemer er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det samme gælder erfaring med test af Android-applikationer og kendskab til informationssikkerhed i et udviklingsmiljø.      Det er virkelig fedt, hvis du    Arbejder systematisk og kan prioritere test ud fra risiko og betydning for brugeren  Har forståelse for både manuel test og mulighederne i testautomatisering  Er en nærværende leder, der giver tydelig

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara’s platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

title: Field & Event Marketing Manager, APAC (Singapore)
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Team Overview

Deepgram recently opened its APAC headquarters in Singapore, and the region is one of our fastest-moving markets. You’ll build the APAC marketing function from zero, partnering closely with the APAC GM and regional sales leadership to shape and execute the regional plan. As part of the global Events & Field Marketing team, you’ll get the playbooks, brand assets, budget framework and coaching to help you move fast.

Your job is to make Deepgram visible and credible across the region through technical community and partner motions, and to turn that presence into pipeline. As the senior marketer in region, you're also marketing's local point of contact: you'll work with our APAC PR agency and partner with global Brand, Web, and Product Marketing to keep regional messaging local and consistent.

  • Ship an APAC field and events plan and budget, agreed with regional sales

title: Team Leader till vår kommande etablering i Eskilstuna
description: Vi öppnar nu vår andra butik i Eskilstuna och ser fram emot att få in team ledare som kan vara med och starta upp och driva en mycket efterlängtad butik i Tuna Park. Här får du en otroligt spännande och lärorik möjlighet där du är med från start.  Vi kommer att hålla löpande rekrytering i november och december för team leader-rollerna och efter årsskiftet kommer rekryteringen för butikssäljare att öppnas upp.  Butiken öppnar i  april 2027.    Ända sedan starten för mer än 100 år sedan har vi på Clas Ohlson haft en stark företagskultur som präglas av en vilja att göra kunden nöjd. Vi är lagspelare som bryr oss om varandra, våra kunder och resultatet av det vi gör, och vi har ett uttalat mål om att vara ledande inom hållbarhet. Om du delar vår ambition att hela tiden åstadkomma mer kan vi erbjuda dig fantastiska möjligheter att växa både personligen och professionellt. Vi tror på dig.    Kom och väx med oss!   En Team leader på Clas Ohlson har som främsta uppgift att leda, coacha och utveckla sina kollegor för att skapa en positiv kundupplevelse. Som en god förebild deltar du och butikens resterande ledningsgrupp i arbetet på butiksgolvet med att leverera kundservice i världsklass till våra kunder. Ditt dagliga arbete omfattar också uppgifter som säljare där du aktivt hjälper och möter våra kunder, står i kassan och fyller på varor.  Som Team leader hos oss tillämpar du ett coachande ledarskap där du inspirerar medarbetarna till att skapa positiva kundupplevelser och att våga utmana sig själva. Du värnar och uppmuntrar till ett öppet arbetsklimat där dina kollegor delar kunskap, nytänkande och möjligheter till förbättring. Att jobba som Team leader innebär att du genom ditt ledarskap har fokus på att skapa resultat och ett engagerat team som bidrar till de gemensamma målen.   För att lyckas arbetar du bland annat med att:     Utveckla medarbetarna genom uppföljning, coachning och utbildning  Samarbeta tätt med avdelningsansvariga för att skapa en bra struktur i den dagliga driften  Säkerställa medarbetarnas introduktion, utbildning samt löpande kompetensutveckling tillsammans med butikschef  Vid behov säkerställa att rutiner för öppning/stängning av butiken efterföljs  Följa upp och analysera definierade nyckeltal samt beslutar åtgärder för dessa     Vem söker vi?     Avklarad gymnasieutbildning, meriterande med utbildning inom Försäljnings- och serviceprogrammet (tidigare Handel- och administration) och/eller butiksledning  Minst ett års arbetslivserfarenhet inom handel eller serviceyrken, meriterande med arbetslivserfarenhet från ledande positioner inom detaljhandeln  Grundläggande färdigheter inom MS Office  Goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift  Du måste vara 18 år för att arbeta hos oss    För att trivas i rollen som Team leader är du en trygg ledare som drivs och inspireras av att få både verksamheten och medarbetare att utvecklas. Du har förmågan att vara lyhörd och lösningsorienterad samt har en mycke

title: [제주] Department Manager
description: Job Description    1. Customer Experience & Prioritization​ - 고객 경험 및 우선 순위      팀과 협력하여 맡고 있는 컨셉의 전반적인 OMNI 고객 경험에 주인의식을 가지고 후속 조치를 취합니다. 비주얼, 커머셜 가이드라인에 맞춰 상품을 구성하고 관리하여 고객에게 높은 패션 영감을 제공 합니다. 이는 매장 내 전체 고객 경험에 기여합니다. ​      일관되게 팀에 모범을 보이며 헬리콥터 오버뷰를 합니다. 특히 팀이 피크 시간에 고객 서비스를 우선하여 고객을 잘 응대 할 수 있게 합니다. ​      지속적으로 팀에게 피드백을 주고 후속 조치를 취하며, 동기부여 하여 로열티 프로그램(H&M 멤버쉽), 스토어 내 지속가능성 활동과 오퍼 상품 등을 고객에게 안내하도록 합니다. ​      Store Management Team과 함께 업무량과 커머셜 플랜에 따라 스토어 팀 플래너를 수립하며, 비즈니스 상황에 따라 유연하게 조정합니다. 최신 캠페인과 액티비티가 제 때에 시행되며, H&M 브랜드 기준에 부합하도록 합니다. ​      2. Customer Offer (stock) and Commerciality - 상품 재고 관리 및 상업성      제안 상품(재고), 커머셜리티, 세일즈 및 버젯과 관련하여 맡고 있는 컨셉의 강점과 기회를 분석하고, 결과를 최적화 하기 위한 계획을 수립합니다. ​      판매 분석을 바탕으로 재고에 대해 Area Team에 적극적으로 의견을 제공하여 스토어 및 컨셉에 적정한 재고 수준을 유지합니다.​      스토어 전체에 강력하고 일관된 가격 전략을 보장하기 위해 가이드라인에 따라 프라이스 사인을 설치하고 관리합니다. ​      자신의 스타일을 패셔너블하게 표현하여 다른 사람들에게 영감을 주며, 최신 트렌드를 파악하고 이를 Window, A-area 및 전체 컨셉에 반영합니다. 이는 트렌드를 구성하는 일곱 가지 요소 -스타일, 키 아이템, 색상 및 프린트 스토리, 실루엣, 원단 및 텍스처-를 아는 것을 포함합니다. ​      3. Hours Planning & Scheduling​ - 아워 플래닝 및 스케줄링      세일즈 플랜과 효율성을 분석하고 후속조치를 취하며, 가능한 한 정확하게 아워플래닝과 스케줄링을 하여 컨셉을 효율적으로 관리합니다. ​      강력한 팀 플래닝과 스케줄링을 통해 팀을 적시에 적절한 펑션에 배치하여 각 서비스 영역에서 고객을 따뜻하게 맞이하고 응대할 수 있도록 합니다.      4. Retail Operations (all areas)​ - 전 영역의 리테일 오퍼레이션      SA의 일상적인 리테일 오퍼레이션을 총괄하고 코칭하며, 피드백을 제공하여 스토어 루틴과 프로세스가 보안 규정을 준수하도록 보장합니다. ​      팀이 높은 수준으로 스토어 내 OMNI 서비스 및 기술(인스토어 케어 앱, 스캐너 등)의 베스트 프랙티스를 유지하도록 합니다. ​      팀과 함께 고객을 위해 플로어를 높은 수준으로 유지하고, 직원을 위해 BOH구역에 중요 정보나 건강 및 안전 관련 사항을 업데이트 합니다.      5. Talent Acquisition & Management​ - 인재 채용 및 개발      스토어와 컨셉의 성공이 팀에 달려 있음을 이해하고 책임감을 갖습니다. 팀 채용, 온보딩, 역량 강화 및 개발을 적극적으로 관리하며 관련된 절차, 루틴 및 법적 요구 사항을 준수합니다. ​      적합한 탤런트를 적합한 포지션에 배치하여 팀이 효율적으로 잘 운영될 수 있도록 합니다. ​      팀에게 정보를 제공하고 동기부여와 영감을 주기 위해 정기적인 소통(브리핑, 위클리 미팅, 등)을 계획하고 수행합니다. 팀이 성공할 수 있도록 역량에 대해 적극적으로 코칭합니다.​      컨셉의 상업성을 유지하고 보장하기 위해 적극적으로 VM과 협력하며, 이는 컨셉의 전반적인 결과를 더 나은 방향으로 이끄는데 중요하다는 것을 이해합니다.

description: Kan du omsætte teknisk indsigt til stærke kunderelationer og konkrete projekter?   Hos Coromatic søger vi en Senior Account Manager, der vil udvikle salget til offentlige kunder med særligt fokus på nødgeneratoranlæg, UPS og køleløsninger, der understøtter kundernes forsyningssikkerhed og drift.  Din rolle – fra behov til aftale  Du får ansvar for både eksisterende nøglekunder og udviklingen af nye muligheder hos offentlige kunder. Med teknisk forståelse og kommercielt overblik driver du salgsprocessen fra den første dialog og behovsafdækning til tilbud, forhandling og aftale. Du agerer som kundernes  Trusted Advisor  og arbejder langsigtet med komplekse organisationer og beslutningsprocesser med både tekniske, driftsmæssige og kommercielle interessenter.  Du bliver en del af et dedikeret salgsteam og arbejder tæt sammen med Coromatics  servicesalgsorganisation  samt vores stærke  Project Design / Tech Design-miljø , hvor specialister i Danmark og Sverige understøtter dig i både tilbuds- og løsningsdesign. Du refererer til  salgsdirektør Kennet Pedersen .  Dine vigtigste opgaver    Opsøge nye kunder og projektmuligheder i det offentlige samt udvikle eksisterende kunderelationer.  Rådgive kunder om nødgeneratoranlæg og relaterede løsninger inden for kritisk infrastruktur, fx UPS, køl, tekniske anlæg og serviceaftaler.  Opbygge relationer til beslutningstagere, tekniske rådgivere og øvrige interessenter.  Deltage i udbud, markedsdialog og partnerskaber samt håndtere offentlige indkøbsprocesser, rammeaftaler og compliancekrav.  Drive forhandlinger med fokus på kundeværdi, lønsomhed og tydelige aftaler.  Koordinere interne ressourcer i salgs-, service- og designorganisationen og sikre en grundig overdragelse til projektorganisationen.  Arbejde struktureret med salgsaktiviteter, pipeline og opfølgning i CRM.    Din profil – teknisk fundament og kommercielt drive  Du har en teknisk baggrund som elektriker, maskinmester, ingeniør eller tilsvarende og erfaring med teknisk B2B-salg eller projektsalg. Vi ser gerne, at du har arbejdet med salg af nødgeneratoranlæg eller beslægtede løsninger inden for nødstrømsforsyning og kritisk infrastruktur. Det vigtigste er, at du kan kombinere teknisk indsigt med forståelse for kundens forretning og drive en salgsproces frem til en aftale.    Du kan sætte dig ind i tekniske krav og omsætte dem til forståelige og relevante løsningsforslag.  Du har gerne erfaring med offentlige udbud, rådgiverdialog og længere salgsforløb med flere beslutningstagere, gerne erfaringer med hospital og forsvaret.  Du er proaktiv, struktureret og stærk i relationsopbygning og formår at positionere dig som kundens Trusted Advisor.  Du arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret, men ved også, hvornår du skal bringe kollegernes ekspertise i spil.  Du kommunikerer klart på dansk og kan anvende engelsk i teknisk og kommerciel dialog.    En rolle med teknisk dybde og kommercielt ansvar  Stillingen er for dig, der vil mere end at sælge et produkt. Du

title: Technology Services Manager

description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     Direct Sales Team은 전국 가맹점에 토스플레이스의 결제 단말기와 매장 관리 솔루션을 설치하고, 매장 사장님들이 토스플레이스 서비스를 가장 빠르게 경험할 수 있도록 모든 과정을 책임지는 팀이에요.  사장님들의 목소리에 귀기울이며, 오프라인 비즈니스의 문제를 기술로 해결하는 최전선에 있어요.  지금 Direct Sales Team은 빠르게 성장하는 시기예요. 세일즈 담당자들이 현장에서 더 빠르고 효율적으로 영역을 전개할 수 있도록, 세일즈 전후의 프로세스, 팀의 성과 점검 체계, 타 조직과의 협업 방식 등 구조와 방향성을 함께 만들어야 합니다.       합류하면 함께 할 업무예요     팀의 영업 성과 향상을 위해 최적의 영업 동선을 짜고, 지역·업종을 고려한 우선순위와 방문 시간대 등 영업 전략을 만드는 역할을 담당해요.  영업 전 단계에서 참고할 수 있도록 매장 환경과 상권 특성, 사전 확인사항을 파악하여 세일즈 담당자에게 전파해요.  영업 성공여부, 거절 사유 등을 분석하여 팀 내 우선순위를 조정하거나 가맹점의 동의를 얻어낼 수 있는 영업 방식을 Direct Sales Manager와 함께 고민해요.  가맹점별 VAN대리점 배정부터 설치 완료까지 영업 전후를 포함한 전체 프로세스를 설계하고 운영해요.  설치 지연 패턴을 분석하고 병목 구간을 찾아, 데이터 기반으로 프로세스를 지속적으로 개선해요.  Enterprise Sales Team, Channel Sales Team 등 타 세일즈 조직과 협업하며, 최선의 의사결정을 주도하고 빠르게 가맹점 설치·결제가 일어날 수 있도록 소통해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     세일즈 조직에서 영업 전략·영업 관리·영업 기획 등의 업무를 5년 이상 수행해 오신 분을 찾고 있어요.  가맹점주, 세일즈 조직, 세일즈 이네이블먼트 조직 등 여러 이해관계자와 동시에 소통하며 업무를 조율하고, 매끄러운 협업 경험을 만들어 오신 분이 필요해요.  POS, 키오스크, 결제 단말기 등 오프라인 디바이스에 대한 이해를 갖추셨거나 매장 환경에 대해 이해하고 계신 분이면 더 좋아요.  배달 플랫폼, 결제사, 포스사, 오더사 등 매장 관련 도메인에서 일해보신 분이라면 더 빠르게 적응하실 수 있을거에요.  현장의 목소리와 정량적 수치 양쪽에 모두 관심을 가지고 현상을 파악하실 수 있는 분이여야 해요.       이력서는 이렇게 작성해 주세요     팀의 영업 전략을 수립한 경험을 공유해 주세요. 어떤 문제의식이 있었고, 어떤 해결방법을 택하셨는지, 어떤 지표로 성과를 측정했는지 구체적으로 적어주세요.  이해관계자 간 이견이 있을 때 어떻게 조율했는지, 실제 사례를 들어 설명해주세요.  운영 프로세스를 개선해서 효율을 높인 경험이 있다면, Before/After를 수치로 보여주세요.  빠르게 변하는 상황에서 우선순위를 정하고 실행한 경험을 구체적으로 작성해주세요       토스플레이스로의 합류여정     서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사

title: Quality Inspector (m/f/d) in the Aviation Industry
description:
Your mission

Thanks to you the plane can take off: Help make tomorrow’s aviation even more efficient and safer and play an active role in the quality inspection of aircraft components.
 
As part of an experienced and dynamic team you’ll be responsible for ensuring product quality and compliance with our customers’ quality standards. With us you’ll shape the environment where you thrive—with work styles that suit you. You’ll remain flexible. And you’ll become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together.

  • Preparation, analysis and documentation of non-conformities

  • You have knowledge of quality assurance.
  • You have very good English skills and basic knowledge of German is a plus. 
  • You will work on-site in Hamburg-Finkenwerder and are willing to work early and late shifts.

title: (Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte (w/m/d) bei Dezernat Zukunft – Institut für Makrofinanzen
description:
Wer wir sind und was wir suchen

Ob die Energiewende gelingt, entscheidet sich nicht allein an Technologien, sondern an Kosten, Märkten und politischen Weichenstellungen. Genau dazu arbeitet das Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft – und um unsere Arbeit weiter zu vertiefen, suchen wir Dich. 

Das Dezernat Zukunft ist ein überparteilicher Berliner Think Tank an der Schnittstelle von Politik, Verwaltung und Forschung. Rund 30 Personen verfolgen gemeinsam das Ziel, Geld-, Finanz- und Wirtschaftspolitik neu zu denken und verständlich zu vermitteln. Geleitet von den Werten Würde, Wohlstand, Demokratie und Nachhaltigkeit suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – idealerweise ab dem 1. Januar – für unser Energy Lab eine Person als (Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte. 

In dieser Position konzipierst Du Analysen und Studien zu Energiemärkten – insbesondere zum Strommarkt – und führst sie eigenständig durch. Dabei betrachtest Du Energiekosten, Investitionsbedarfe, Gesamtsystemkosten sowie die Wechselwirkungen politischer Instrumente mit diesen Größen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Fragen, wie sich Energiepolitik mit Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und Bezahlbarkeit zusammendenken lässt, wie Energiekosten strategisch und gezielt gesenkt werden können, und wie das regulatorische Umfeld so ausgestaltet werden kann, dass es den Erfolg der „zweiten Hälfte der Energiewende“ und damit die Erreichung der Klimaneutralität ermöglicht.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst Energiemärkte und -preise, einschließlich Systemkosten, und koordinierst dazu Forschungsprojekte. Dabei betrachtest Du auch fiskalpolitische Auswirkungen sowie Wechselwirkungen mit dem Stromnetzausbau. 
  • Du entwickelst konkrete Politikvorschläge, Analysen und Positionen zu den oben genannten Themen, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen K

title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
description:

Die Hoppe Marine GmbH entwickelt und liefert Mess-, Überwachungs- und Steuerungssysteme für Schiffe weltweit. Mit IACS UR E26/E27, den Anforderungen der Klassifikationsgesellschaften und NIS2 ist Cybersecurity eine wesentliche Voraussetzung für Zulassung, Kundenakzeptanz und Lieferfähigkeit.

Als Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) verantworten Sie die Informationssicherheit der Hoppe Marine GmbH sowie die Cyber- und Systemsicherheit unserer Produkte und maritimen Systeme über den gesamten Lebenszyklus.

Organisation & Informationssicherheit

  • Steuerung von Zertifizierungs-, Kunden- und Überwachungsaudits sowie der erforderlichen Nachweisprozesse
  • Umsetzung relevanter Anforderungen aus NIS2
  • Identifikation, Bewertung und Behandlung von Informationssicherheits- und Cyberrisiken
  • Beratung der Geschäftsführung und Fachbereiche sowie Unterstützung bei Security-Anforderungen und Assessments
  • Koordination von Incident Response, Krisenmanagement und Business Continuity

  • Verantwortung für die Cyber- und Systemsicherheit unserer Produkte und maritimen Systeme über den gesamten Lebenszyklus
  • Umsetzung relevanter Anforderungen aus IACS UR E26/E27, IEC 62443 und den Regelwerken der Klassifikationsgesellschaften
  • Etablierung und Weiterentwicklung eines Secure Development Lifecycle
  • Begleitung von Cybersecurity- und Zertifizierungsvorhaben einschließlich Security-Konzepten, Risikoanalysen, Prüfungen und Abnahmen
  • Bewertung von Bedrohungen und Schwachstellen sowie Begleitung geeigne

title: (Senior) Performance Consultant (m/w/d) - Paid Social
description:
Dein Mission

Du schaust dir Ads im Feed genauer an als die meisten Menschen, und bei Suchanzeigen oder Display-Kampagnen geht es dir genauso? Du weißt, wann ein Euro bei Meta besser angelegt ist als bei Google oder in einer programmatischen Buchung? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Wir suchen eine Expertin oder einen Experten für digitale Kampagnen, deren Herz für Paid Social schlägt und die Programmatic, SEA und Werbung in KI-Umgebungen sicher mitdenken. Jemanden, der unsere Kunden und unser Team mit Wissen, Selbstbewusstsein und Begeisterung mitnimmt.


Deine Rolle

  • Du entwickelst Full-Funnel-Strategien für digitale Kampagnen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Meta (Facebook, Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn und YouTube. Dazu kommen Programmatic, SEA und neue Werbeumfelder in KI-Assistenten und KI-gestützter Suche (Generative Engine Advertising).
  • Du planst den Media Mix und verteilst Budgets so über die Kanäle, dass sie auf die Business-Ziele unserer Kunden einzahlen.
  • Du konzipierst, steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen mit hohen sechsstelligen Budgets. Dazu gehören komplexe Zielgruppen-Setups, A/B-Tests von Creatives, Gebotsstrategien und die Steuerung von Keywords und Placements.
  • Du bringst Creator- und Influencer-Content gezielt in die Paid Ausspielung, etwa über Meta Partnership Ads und TikTok Spark Ads. Mit Creators und Content-Teams stimmst du ab, welche Inhalte sich als Anzeige eignen und wie sie getestet werden.
  • Für App-Kunden planst und steuerst du App-Kampagnen über Meta, TikTok und Google App Campaigns , von der Installation bis zur In-App-Conversion.
  • Du sorgst für saubere Daten: Conversions API, serverseitiges Tracking und eine Messung, der der Kunde vertrauen kann.
  • Du analysierst in den nativen Plattform-Tools, in GA4 und in Looker Studio. Du kannst zeigen, welcher Kanal welchen Beitrag leistet und leitest daraus klare Empfehlungen ab, die du souverän beim Kunden präs

description:

As a Working Student People Business Partner, you will take ownership of the end-to-end employee journey for our working students and interns, from recruiting and onboarding to personal and professional development, as well as transitions into permanent positions or offboarding.
Our goal is to provide you with a comprehensive understanding of the People Business Partner role. You will take on responsibility from an early stage, contribute to both operational and strategic initiatives, and develop a deep understanding of modern people management within a growing aerospace company.
Become a deltaVisionary!

  • Support and guide our working students and interns throughout their entire journey at deltaVision
  • Act as the first point of contact for people-related topics and support employees and managers in their day-to-day work
  • Contribute to daily People Operations activities and help continuously improve existing processes
  • Support and independently drive People projects within a fast-growing organization
  • Actively shape our company culture through events, employee engagement initiatives, and employer branding activities
  • Collaborate closely with employees and managers to create an outstanding employee experience
  • Contribute your own ideas and support the further development of our People structures as we continue to grow


Your profile

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Business Psychology, Social Sciences, or a related field
  • Passion for modern people management and a genuine interest in learning about the role of a People Business Partner
  • Structured, independent, and reliable way of working
  • Strong communication skills and a genuine enjoyment of working with people
  • High level of discretion and professionalism whe

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

Our Data Scientists and AI/ML Engineers build AI solutions. You make them usable for everyone at EDRI. As a Full-Stack AI Engineer in our newly established AI UNIT within E.ON Drive Infrastructure (EDRI), a special unit built and run like a startup, you will build the internal platform that makes AI solutions accessible to hundreds of colleagues across EDRI. You will work across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI integration, taking full ownership from the initial architecture to reliable operation in production. Where this is heading: every colleague builds their own applications with AI coding tools, while login, backend, security, and hosting are set up automatically – and you design it. You report to our Head of AI Strategy. 

Your Responsibilities 

  • Build our internal AI platform from scratch and develop it into one central place for all AI solutions
  • Design a modular architecture that allows new AI solutions to be integrated and launched quickly
  • Develop intuitive frontends, including conversational, generative, and streaming interfaces
  • Build backend services and APIs, integrating models and services developed by our AI/ML Engineers
  • Implement authentication, role management, access controls, and secure system integrations – security by design
  • Ensure scalability and performance for hundreds of users and millions of requests through load testing, caching, and continuous optimization

title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

You turn data into decisions for a pan-European business. As a Senior Data Scientist in our newly established AI UNIT within E.ON Drive Infrastructure (EDRI), a special unit built and run like a startup, you will help transform complex business challenges into data-driven decisions. Working closely with stakeholders across the organization, you will develop analyses, experiments, and models that create measurable business impact and shape the future of AI-driven decision-making at EDRI. You report to our Head of AI Strategy. 

Your Responsibilities 

  • Translate business challenges into analyses, predictive models, and actionable recommendations
  • Build and validate statistical, machine learning, and optimization models to support strategic decision-making
  • Design experiments and measure real business impact, beyond correlation, using rigorous analytical methodologies
  • Collaborate with AI/ML Engineers to bring analytical models into production environments
  • Communicate insights, assumptions, and uncertainty clearly to stakeholders up to CEO level
  • Establish best practices and standards for analytics, experimentation, and model development
  • Evaluate emerging AI models, AI tooling, and agentic systems and use what works to accelerate analysis workflows
  • Drive data-informed decision-making across business functions and regions
  • Share knowledge and support the development of junior colleagues – this is a senior individual contributor role


Your profile

You are a commercially minded Data Scientist who combines strong analytical rigor

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

Most AI lives in a chat window. Ours will run physical infrastructure across a pan-European network. As a Senior AI/ML Engineer in our newly established AI UNIT within E.ON Drive Infrastructure (EDRI), a special unit built and run like a startup, you will be at the forefront of designing, building, and scaling AI systems that deliver real business impact. Working across the entire AI lifecycle, you will take solutions from experimentation to production and own them there, while helping define the technical foundation of our AI UNIT. You report to our Head of AI Strategy.

Your Responsibilities 

  • Shape the AI/ML architecture, technology stack, and engineering standards of the unit
  • Design, build, and operate production-grade AI and machine learning systems and own their reliability, quality, latency, and cost
  • Develop classical ML and GenAI solutions, including RAG, agentic systems, and AI-powered services
  • Productionize ML models developed by our Data Scientists and operate them at scale
  • Define and enhance MLOps and LLMOps practices for deployment, versioning, monitoring, evaluation, and retraining
  • Own our LLM gateway, including model routing, token limits, cost per use case, guardrails, and logging
  • Build scalable AI services and APIs for our Full-Stack and AI Deployment Engineers
  • Evaluate emerging AI mode

title: Senior AI Deployment Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

Are you passionate about bringing AI from experimentation into everyday business? Join our newly established AI UNIT within E.ON Drive Infrastructure (EDRI), a special unit built and run like a startup: trust instead of control, freedom instead of process, speed instead of committees. Working embedded with our business functions and regional teams across Europe, you will identify high-impact opportunities, build practical AI solutions that go live in days, not months, and drive measurable business value at scale. You report to our Head of AI Operations.
 
Your Responsibilities

  • Identify and prioritize AI use cases, working embedded with business functions and regional teams
  • Design, build, and deploy AI solutions, automations, and integrations in short sprints of under 10 person-days
  • Develop production-ready AI systems, including evals, monitoring, security, and access control
  • Integrate modern AI technologies and agentic systems into existing business processes
  • Drive AI adoption through training and enablement
  • Measure solution usage, user adoption, and business impact
  • Create reusable templates, playbooks, and best practices to accelerate scaling
  • Hand over solutions that need to scale to our Full-Stack and AI/ML Engineers
  • Evaluate emerging AI models, AI tooling, and agentic systems and bring valuable innovations into the business

title: (Senior) Legal Counsel (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

As (Senior) Legal Counsel at E.ON Drive Infrastructure (EDRI), you will play a key role in supporting our international growth journey. In this position, you will provide pragmatic legal advice, drive legal processes, and work closely with stakeholders across multiple markets to support the expansion of charging infrastructure throughout Europe.
 

Your responsibilities

  • Advise international teams, management, and leadership on a broad range of day-to-day legal matters
  • Draft, review, negotiate, and further develop commercial agreements and legal documents, including site, lease and usage agreements, supplier and service contracts, cooperation and partnership agreements, financing-related agreements, and claim matters
  • Analyze complex legal and regulatory issues related to e-mobility and charging infrastructure and develop pragmatic business solutions, working closely with technical teams to identify legal risks early
  • Advise on regulatory requirements in e-mobility, energy, infrastructure, and technology, including energy law, metrology and calibration law, the German Energy Industry Act, and Federal Network Agency requirements
  • Lead negotiations with business partners, authorities, landowners, and other external stakeholders and support strategic partnerships and innovative cooperation models
  • Enforce the company’s rights in disputes and contractual breaches, support court proceedings, and develop efficient conflict resolution strategies
  • Support permitti

title: Senior Consultant, Tracking Strategy & Insights
description:
Introduction:

As a Senior Consultant on our newly formed Tracking Strategy & Insights (TS&I) team, you will act as the key strategic partner accountable for the successful integration and value realization of our clients’ tracking programs. You will blend deep marketing research expertise (informed by the Ehrenberg-Bass Institute school of thought) with exceptional storytelling skills to convert tracking technology insights into actionable business strategy.

Are you curious and want to shoot for the stars, open to giving and receiving feedback, hungry for empowerment and always taking a hands-on approach? ClaimSorted helps insurers outsource claims end to end – a service called Third-Party Administration (TPA), a ~$200B industry. We combine a strong in-house claims team with our AI-enabled platform to deliver up to 3× faster claims, better service, and better economics for insurers.

You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.

Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.

As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service.

  • Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier.

  • Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies.

title: Senior BMS Software Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

In this BMS Software Engineer role, you will join the VÆRIDION Airborne Software team within the Technology division. You will be responsible to lead the design of software required for our propulsion battery management and power distribution for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. Your contributions will be instrumental in ensuring the safety, reliability, and performance of the High Voltage Propulsion Battery System at the core of VÆRIDION’s novel propulsion system.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of embedded software for propulsion battery and power distribution from prototypes to future airworthy systems.

  • Implement software development processes and toolchains in compliance with aviation standards and regulations.

  • Define and document software requirements, specifications, and interfaces for the high voltage electrical power system.

  • Collaborate closely with cell, electrical, and thermal engineers to integrate algorithms for battery state estimation, cell balancing, fault detection, power control, and thermal management.

  • Conduct thorough testing and validation of the software, including integration testing with other aircraft systems.

  • Support system integration, iron bird/field testing, and certification efforts, providing expertise on software functionality and performance.

title: Propulsion Design Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As a Propulsion Design Engineer, you will join the Propulsion team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ propulsion system. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the electric propulsion system and guide the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of one of the most advanced electric propulsion systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Mature the propulsion system installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

  • Design and detail mechanical components, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

  • Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies

title: Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

VÆRIDION is a pioneering electric aircraft Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) dedicated to revolutionizing regional air mobility and sustainable aviation. We are committed to designing and producing cutting-edge electric conventional take-off and landing (eCTOL) aircraft that provide safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions.

As a Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, development, and certification of the aircraft's high voltage systems. You will work as part of a multi-functional team, reporting to the HV Systems Team Lead, and covering HV system development and electrical integration, including battery systems, power electronics, HV EWIS, distribution equipment and associated sub-systems. Your daily tasks will include a variety of technical activities for the HV Electrical Systems team.

Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define performance, functional, installation and other applicable system requirements, allocate them to components, and plan and support their validation and verification (V&V) in line with standards such as ARP4754.

  • Define HV system functions, architecture, sizing and specifications, and integrate the aircraft HV distribution system to meet safety and performance requirements.

  • Develop interface control documents (ICDs) covering physical and functional interfaces with the a

title: Principal Structures Materials & Processes Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As a Principal Structures Materials & Processes Engineer (all genders) you will be responsible for developing and optimizing materials and processes to enhance the performance and safety of aerospace systems. You will be involved in the entire lifecycle of a product, from initial research and development to installation and final commissioning.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Conduct research to develop new and improved manufacturing processes.

  • Develop, modify, and test materials used in the design of aerospace systems.

  • Perform failure analysis and develop solutions to address them.

  • Monitor material performance and evaluate material deterioration.

  • Interpret materials and process specifications in aerospace manufacturing.

  • Research and develop innovative material processing techniques.

  • Ensure materials and processes comply with health, safety, and environmental regulations (e.g. REACH, RoHS)

  • Work closely with design engineers to integrate materials and processes into design.

  • Establish and maintain detailed documentation of materials and processes for future reference and regulatory compliance.

  • Provide technical advice to engineering and manufacturing teams on material selection and process optimization.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

We do not partner with search firms.

 

About

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build and improve the products and systems behind Lokalise. You'll work closely with Product, Design, other engineers, and stakeholders to identify and solve meaningful customer problems, improve existing experiences, and shape what we build next.

Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, uncover their pains and needs, define their own goals

title: Engineering Manager - Unified Platform

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Unified Privacy Platform team's mission is to earn the trust of every DoorDash user by upholding their right to privacy, consent, and transparency. We are building a common privacy foundation across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo so Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants can understand how their data is used, control their choices, and exercise their privacy rights through simple, consistent experiences.

Together, these capabilities turn fragmented, one-off compliance work into reusable platform primitives that can support new products, brands, and emerging regulations.

DoorDash is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Unified Privacy Platform team. description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Company

Help us build the world's most reliable, on-demand logistics engine for last-mile delivery! We're bringing on experienced engineers to help us create and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers the company's three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and riders.

About the Role

We are looking for experienced engineers to join the EU Traffic team, based at Deliveroo, part of DoorDash, and help build the next generation of DoorDash's Traffic platform. We are building a single, shared platform designed to serve DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, so your work will shape reliability and security for all three marketplaces. Our team owns the infrastructure that carries every request into and through that platform: the edge, where we manage Cloudflare (CDN, DNS, rate limiting, bot mitigation) and the ingress systems for external traffic, and service-to-service (S2S) communication, where we run the service mesh and the authentication that secures calls between thousands of services across multiple regions.

You will work on core components of our traffic stack, including our Cloudflare edge configuration (managed as code), and service-to-service authentication and authorization (workload identity, token issuance and validation at the mesh layer). This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and security. DoorDash's mission is to grow and empower local economies. At DoorDash, there are three audiences that are at the core of every decision we make - our Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. We bring their voices into the business in order to help set the strategic vision for all of DoorDash's current and future products.

You'll work as a peer to senior product, design, engineering, data science, and business leaders, and your work will directly inform roadmaps, investment decisions, and company-level strategy.

This role is built for a seasoned researcher who is equally comfortable in a living room interview, a survey dataset, and a leadership review, and who uses AI as a daily tool to move faster and see further, without giving up the judgment that makes research trustworthy. description:

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

We are growing our vascular team and building out the follow-up pathway that sits behind the Neko Body Scan. When a scan raises a vascular flag, such as a low ankle-brachial index, a difference in blood pressure between the arms, or asymmetry on our Spectrum Gen 2 imaging, a member is referred for a follow-up examination. You will carry out those examinations.

This is a senior role within a small, close team. You will scan and report your findings, work closely with our Vascular Specialist, who makes the clinical decisions and referrals, and help shape how the pathway runs as it scales. You will also be a vascular reference point for the doctors and operators who perform first-line measurements in our clinics.

What you will do

  • Perform and report arterial duplex ultrasound of the lower and upper limbs for members referred through the vascular follow-up pathway.

  • Carry out repeat ankle-brachial pressure index (ABPI) with Doppler, and toe pressures or toe-brachial index where the pathway calls for them.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion.

description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Architecture at Fractile isn’t a paper exercise — it’s built in constant collaboration with logical design, physical design, and verification teams, so that every architectural decision is grounded in what will actually perform in working silicon.

title: Member of Technical Staff - Security Engineering
description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The role

We build the control chain that powers on, monitors, updates, and protects devices and racks across bare metal, RTOS, and embedded Linux. We also build the communication mechanisms that connect devices to each other and to the host. Security runs through all of it. A chain of trust from the hardware up to the rack management plane: the root of trust each controller boots from, the signed updates that reach the fleet safely, the identity that lets a device prove what it is, the authenticated channels the controllers and devices talk over, and the runtime protections that keep the host Linux kernel and the on-die firmware trustworthy lon

The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. title: Client Account Manager
description: Who We Are   At ZayZoon, we are on a mission to save 10 million hardworking employees 10 billion dollars. We’ve created a financial empowerment platform that helps businesses of all sizes make a big impact on employee financial wellness.  We offer a variety of financial wellness services, like earned wage access, that allows employees to access their earned wages ahead of payday. With 74% of ZayZoon customers reporting reduced financial stress, we know our solutions help lead to happier and more productive employees. ZayZoon was also recognized for its growth in the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 50, 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500, and top-10 growth companies in Canada by CIX awards. You might see a few cities listed, but no need to be in any of them! You’ll get to know their business, their people, and what success looks like to them, then help them get the most out of ZayZoon. The work matters: when a client uses ZayZoon well, more of their employees can access their pay when they need it most. You’ll have real ownership over your accounts, a team that has your back, and room to shape how we manage and grow client relationships as we grow.   Your Impact     Be the go-to advisor for a portfolio of high-value clients, connecting what ZayZoon offers to their business goals and the needs of their teams  Grow your accounts by spotting where clients could get more from ZayZoon and building a plan for each one to increase usage and long-term value  Lead business reviews and planning sessions with decision makers to look at results, recognize progress, and find what’s next  Step in when tricky issues come up, including support queries and escalations, rallying the right people internally and seeing things through until the client is taken care of  Bring the client’s voice to Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Care by sharing feedback, testing new offerings, and helping improve how we work  Build lasting partnerships that keep clients with us, keep accounts in good standing, and turn into success stories worth sharing  Help the whole team get better by sharing what works, keeping our resources current, running training sessions, and smoothing out workflows     You Bring     2+ years in a client-facing role where you built relationships, grew accounts, and helped clients get more out of a product  Experience managing your own book of clients, finding upsell opportunities, and working with internal teams to solve problems  A track record of creating and running adoption plans that led to results you can point to  Comfort turn

title: Principal Competitive Intelligence Manager
description:
Headquarters:  United States
      URL:   https://6sense.com/ 
 

 
 
 6sense Product Marketing 
 Principal Competitive Intelligence Manager 
 Competitive Intelligence & Win/Loss 
  Team:  Product Marketing
 Reports to:  VP, Product Marketing
 Level:  Principal   
 
 About the Role 
 The market we compete in is being redrawn in real time. Point data providers are moving up the stack. Workflow and enrichment tools are repositioning as operating systems. Buyers are assembling their own stacks from components that used to be bought as a platform. Knowing what each competitor shipped last quarter is table stakes — the job is understanding what the pattern means and what we should do about it. 
 This role owns competitive intelligence and win/loss for 6sense. It sits on the Product Marketing team and exists so that our positioning, our roadmap conversations and our field enablement are built on evidence rather than assumption. You will be the person the company turns to when there is a disagreement about why we win, why we lose, and who we are actually competing against. 
 This is a senior individual contributor seat. The work is research, synthesis and judgment — and the willingness to tell the company something it would rather not hear, with the evidence to back it up. 
 
 What You'll Own 
 
 
  The win/loss program, end to end.  Interviews, coding, synthesis and the readouts that go to product and executive leadership. Not administering a program — making it the thing people trust when they disagree. 
 
 
  Competitive positioning and differentiation.  The evidence behind our claims about where we are stronger, and the honesty about where we are not. You partner with the pillar PMMs so competitive insight shapes positioning rather than trailing it. 
 
 
  Structural market analysis.  How buyers are assembling their stacks, where substitution is happening, which categories are converging, and what that means for us eighteen months out. 
 
 
  Field enablement for competitive situations.  Battlecards, objection handling, trap-setting questions and talk tracks that hold up in a live deal rather than in a deck. 
 
 
  Claims discipline for competitive material.  Sourcing every competitive number we put in front of a customer, and saying no to the ones we cannot stand behind. 
 
 
  Competitive monitoring and alerting,  including ownership of the tooling and of what reaches the field versus what stays internal. 
 
 
  Input to roadmap, pricing and packaging, and analyst relations.  Competitive evidence should shape what we build and how we price, not only how we sell. 
 
 
 
 What You'll Bring 
 
 
 8+ years in competitive intelligence, product marketing or research-heavy go-to-market roles in B2B SaaS. 
 
 
  Hands-on win/loss experience.  Designing the program, running the interviews and coding the results — not reading someone else's summary. 
 
 
 The ability to run primary research and be honest about what the data does and do
